name: March 7th
description: A girl who once slumbered in eternal ice and knows nothing about her past.\nTo find out the truth about her origins, she decided to travel with the Astral Express.\nAs of right now, she has prepared about <unbreak>67</unbreak> different versions of her life story for herself.

skills.name: Frigid Cold Arrow
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK to one enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: The Power of Cuteness
skills.description: Provides a single ally with a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's DEF plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nIf the ally's current HP percentage is <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> or higher, greatly increases the chance of enemies attacking that ally.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Applies a Shield</color> on a single ally.

skills.name: Glacial Cascade
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK to all enemies. Hit enemies have a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to be Frozen for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Frozen, enemies cannot take action and will receive Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to <color=#f29e38ff>all enemies</color>, with <color=#f29e38ff>a chance of Freezing them</color>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Girl Power
skills.description: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th immediately <u>Counters</u>, dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK. This effect can be triggered <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th <color=#f29e38ff>immediately launches a <u>Counter</u></color> against the attacker, dealing minor Ice DMG.

10000003.name: Counter
10000003.desc: An effect that automatically triggers when the target is attacked, which unleashes an extra attack on the attacker.\nCounter is also considered a Follow-Up ATK.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Freezing Beauty
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Freeze a random enemy for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a high chance of inflicting Freeze on a random enemy.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Memory of You
eidolons.description: Every time March 7th's Ultimate Freezes a target, she regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Memory of It
eidolons.description: Upon entering battle, grants a Shield equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of March 7th's DEF plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> to the ally with the lowest HP percentage, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Memory of Everything
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Never Forfeit Again
eidolons.description: The Talent's <u>Counter</u> effect can be triggered 1 more time in each turn. The DMG dealt by <u>Counter</u> increases by an amount that is equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of March 7th's DEF.

eidolons.name: Never Forget Again
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Just Like This, Always...
eidolons.description: Allies under the protection of the Shield granted by the Skill restore HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> at the beginning of each turn.

name: Dan Heng
description: A cold and reserved young man who is reticent about his past.\nTo avoid his kin, he decided to travel with the Astral Express.

skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: North Wind
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng's ATK to one enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: Torrent
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy.\nWhen DMG dealt by Skill triggers CRIT Hit, there is a <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce the target's SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Wind DMG to one enemy. Upon a CRIT Hit, there is a high chance of Slowing the enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Ethereal Dream
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy target. If the attacked enemy is Slowed, the multiplier for the DMG dealt by Ultimate increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Wind DMG to one enemy. If the enemy is Slowed, DMG multiplier dealt will be increased.

skills.name: Superiority of Reach
skills.description: When Dan Heng becomes the target of an ally's ability, his next attack's Wind <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can be triggered again after <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When this unit becomes the target of an ally's ability, this unit's next attack's <color=#f29e38ff>Wind <u>RES PEN</u> increases</color>. This effect can be triggered again after 2 turns.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Splitting Spearhead
skills.description: After Dan Heng uses his Technique, his ATK increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> at the start of the next battle for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After they use their Technique, their ATK is increased at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: The Higher You Fly, the Harder You Fall
eidolons.description: When the target enemy's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, CRIT Rate increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Quell the Venom Octet, Quench the Vice O'Flame
eidolons.description: Reduces Talent cooldown by 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Seen and Unseen
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Roaring Dragon and Soaring Sun
eidolons.description: When Dan Heng uses his Ultimate to defeat an enemy, he will immediately take action again.

eidolons.name: A Drop of Rain Feeds a Torrent
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Troubled Soul Lies in Wait
eidolons.description: The Slow state triggered by Skill reduces the enemy's SPD by an extra <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Himeko
description: The one who repaired the Astral Express.\nTo witness the vast starry sky, she decided to travel with the Astral Express.\nHer hobby is brewing hand-made coffee.

skills.name: Sawblade Tuning
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko's ATK to one enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Molten Detonation
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Heavenly Flare
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko's ATK to all enemies. Himeko regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> extra Energy for each enemy defeated.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to all enemies and regenerates Energy if enemies are defeated.

skills.name: Victory Rush
skills.description: When an enemy target is inflicted with Weakness Break, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge (max <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> points).\nIf Himeko is fully Charged when an ally target performs an attack, Himeko immediately performs 1 <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to all enemies, consuming all Charge points.\nAt the start of the battle, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of battle or when an enemy's Weakness is Broken, gains Charge.\nAfter any ally target performs an attack, if fully Charged, <color=#f29e38ff>launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> and deals Fire DMG to <color=#f29e38ff>all enemies</color>, consuming all Charge points.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Incomplete Combustion
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> second(s). After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase Fire DMG taken by enemies by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. After entering combat with enemies in the dimension, there is a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>increase Fire DMG taken by enemies</color>.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Childhood
eidolons.description: After "Victory Rush" is triggered, Himeko's SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Convergence
eidolons.description: Deals <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or less.

eidolons.name: Poised
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dedication
eidolons.description: When Himeko's Skill inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, she gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra point(s) of Charge.

eidolons.name: Aspiration
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Trailblaze!
eidolons.description: Ultimate deals 2 extra instances of Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG to one random enemy.

name: Welt
description: A seasoned member of the Express Crew.\nThe passion buried in his heart burns anew as he enjoys this fresh adventure.\nOccasionally, he would sketch the experiences in a notebook.

skills.name: Gravity Suppression
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Edge of the Void
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals 2 instances of DMG, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Welt's ATK to a random enemy. On hit, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> to reduce the enemy's SPD by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy. This attack can Bounce 3 times, with a chance of <color=#f29e38ff>Slowing</color> the hit enemies.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Synthetic <unbreak>Black Hole</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Welt's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for enemies hit by this ability to be Imprisoned for 1 turn.\nImprisoned enemies have their <u>actions delayed</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> and SPD reduced by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies, with <color=#f29e38ff>a high chance of Imprisoning them</color>.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Time Distortion
skills.description: When hitting an enemy that is already Slowed, Welt deals Imaginary <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK to the enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: When hitting a Slowed enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>additionally deals minor Imaginary <u>Additional DMG</u></color>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Gravitational Imprisonment
skills.description: After using Welt's Technique, create a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies in this Special Dimension have their movement speed reduced by <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>. After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Imprison the enemies for 1 turn.\nImprisoned enemies have their <u>actions delayed</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> and SPD reduced by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in this dimension have their movement speed reduced. After entering combat with enemies in the dimension, there is a <color=#f29e38ff>high chance for the enemies to become Imprisoned</color>.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Legacy of Honor
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate, Welt gets enhanced. Then, the next <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s) he uses Basic ATK or Skill, deals 1 extra instance of <u>Additional DMG</u> to the enemy target. The <u>Additional DMG</u> dealt when using Basic ATK is equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Basic ATK DMG multiplier. The <u>Additional DMG</u> dealt when using Skill is equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Skill DMG multiplier.

eidolons.name: Conflux of Stars
eidolons.description: When his Talent is triggered, Welt regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Prayer of Peace
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Appellation of Justice
eidolons.description: When using Skill, increases the <u>base chance</u> of reducing the attacked enemy target's SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Power of Kindness
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Prospect of Glory
eidolons.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to one random enemy.

name: Kafka
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters. A dashing, collected, and professional beauty.\nUsed the enchantment of Spirit Whisper to set up {NICKNAME} to absorb the Stellaron.\nHer hobby is shopping for and organizing her collection of coats.

skills.name: Midnight Tumult
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Kafka's ATK to a one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Caressing Moonlight
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Kafka's ATK to a target enemy and Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Kafka's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.\nIf the target enemy is currently receiving DoT, all DoTs currently placed on that enemy immediately produce DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their original DMG.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.\nIf the primary target is currently afflicted with a DoT effect, the DoT <color=#f29e38ff>deals DMG 1 extra time</color>.

skills.name: Twilight Trill
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for enemies hit to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current Shock state, equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of its original DMG. Shock lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Shocked, enemies receive Lightning DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>Shocking them</color>.\nIf the enemies are currently Shocked, the Shock status <color=#f29e38ff>deals DMG 1 extra time</color>.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Gentle but Cruel
skills.description: After Kafka's teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to that target, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate to the attacked enemy target, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turns. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.
skills.simpleDescription: After a teammate uses Basic ATK on an enemy, Kafka immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals Lightning DMG with a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>inflicting Shock</color> to that target. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per turn.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
skills.description: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate on every enemy target for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks all enemies within range. After entering battle, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, with a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>Shock</color> them.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Da Capo
eidolons.description: When the Talent triggers a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase the DoT received by the target by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Fortississimo
eidolons.description: While Kafka is on the field, DoT dealt by all allies increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Capriccio
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Recitativo
eidolons.description: When an enemy target takes DMG from the Shock status inflicted by Kafka, Kafka additionally regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Doloroso
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Leggiero
eidolons.description: The Shock state inflicted on the enemy target by the Ultimate, Technique, or the Talent-triggered <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> has a DMG multiplier increase of <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and lasts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) longer.

name: Silver Wolf
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters and a genius hacker.\nShe sees the universe as a massive immersive simulation game and has fun with it.\nShe's mastered the skill known as "aether editing," which can be used to tamper with the data of reality.

skills.name: System Warning
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Allow Changes?
skills.description:
There is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> to add 1 Weakness of an on-field character's Type to the target enemy. This also reduces the enemy's DMG RES to that Weakness Type by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). If the enemy already has that Type Weakness, the effect of DMG RES reduction to that Weakness Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be kept.
In addition, there is a <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to further reduce the All-Type RES of the enemy by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf's ATK to this enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: There is a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>apply additional Weakness</color> to one enemy and deals Quantum DMG to this enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: User Banned
skills.description: There's a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> to decrease the target enemy's DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). And at the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf's ATK to the target enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: There is a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>lowering one enemy's DEF</color> and deals massive Quantum DMG to this enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Awaiting System Response...
skills.description: Silver Wolf can create three types of Bugs: Reduce ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, reduce DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>, and reduce SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nEvery time Silver Wolf attacks, she has a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> to implant a random Bug that lasts for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s) in an enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: After this unit attacks, there is a chance of implanting the target with 1 random <color=#f29e38ff>Bug</color>.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Force Quit Program
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies, and ignores Weakness Types and reduces Toughness from all enemies. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor DMG to all enemies and reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Types.

eidolons.name: Social Engineering
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, Silver Wolf regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for every <u>debuff</u> that the target enemy currently has. This effect can be triggered up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) in each use of her Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Zombie Network
eidolons.description: When an enemy enters combat, reduces their Effect RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Payload
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bounce Attack
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, deals Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Silver Wolf's ATK for every <u>debuff</u> currently on the enemy target. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) during each use of her Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Brute Force Attack
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Overlay Network
eidolons.description: For every <u>debuff</u> the enemy target has, the DMG dealt by Silver Wolf to it increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, up to a max increase of <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Arlan
description: The head of Herta Space Station's Security Department.\nThis quiet boy hopes to protect the researchers who value their pursuit of knowledge, and to help them to complete their work.

skills.name: Lightning Rush
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Shackle Breaker
skills.description: Consumes Arlan's HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP to deal Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy. If Arlan does not have sufficient HP, his HP will be reduced to 1 after using his Skill.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes a portion of HP to deal Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Frenzied Punishment
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Arlan's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Lightning DMG to one enemy and Lightning DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Pain and Anger
skills.description: Based on Arlan's current missing HP percentage, gains DMG bonus, up to a maximum increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> DMG dealt by Arlan.
skills.simpleDescription: Gain DMG bonus <color=#f29e38ff>based on</color> <color=#f29e38ff>currently missing HP percentage</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Swift Harvest
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Arlan's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: To the Bitter End
eidolons.description: When HP percentage is lower than or equal to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max HP, increases DMG dealt by Skill by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Breaking Free
eidolons.description: Using Skill or Ultimate removes 1 <u>debuff</u> from this unit.

eidolons.name: Power Through
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Turn the Tables
eidolons.description: When struck by a killing blow after entering battle, instead of becoming <u>knocked down</u>, Arlan immediately restores his HP to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP. This effect is automatically removed after it is triggered once or after <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) have elapsed.

eidolons.name: Hammer and Tongs
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Self-Sacrifice
eidolons.description: When the current HP percentage drops to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> or below, Ultimate deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG, and the DMG multiplier for adjacent targets is raised to the same level as that for the primary target.

name: Asta
description: The lead researcher of Herta Space Station and a lady from a renowned family.\nShe's an astronomer overflowing with curiosity, and excels at managing the disparate staff of the space station.

skills.name: Spectrum Beam
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Meteor Storm
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Asta's ATK to one designated enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to single enemy targets with 5 Bounces in total.

skills.name: Astral Blessing
skills.description: Increases SPD of all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Increases SPD</color> for all allies.

skills.name: Astrometry
skills.description: Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.\nFor every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).\nStarting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> at the beginning of every turn.
skills.simpleDescription: The character will receive 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy they hit, for a maximum of 5 stacks. Every stack of Charging increases ATK for all allies. At the beginning of their turn, reduce Charging stacks.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Miracle Flash
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Asta's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
eidolons.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

eidolons.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate, Asta's Charging stacks will not be reduced in the next turn.

eidolons.name: Meteor Showers for Wish and Want
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Aurora Basks in Beauty and Bliss
eidolons.description: Asta's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> when she has <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more Charging stacks.

eidolons.name: Nebula Secludes in Runes and Riddles
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Cosmos Dreams in Calm and Comfort
eidolons.description: Charging stack(s) lost in each turn is reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

name: Herta
description: Member <unbreak>83</unbreak> of the Genius Society. The real master of the space station.\nAn incredibly intelligent yet unsympathetic scientist.

skills.name: What Are You Looking At?
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: One-Time Offer
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Herta's ATK to all enemies. If the enemy's HP percentage is <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> or higher, DMG dealt to this target increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies. Targets with higher HP will receive increased DMG.

skills.name: <unbreak>It's Magic,</unbreak> <unbreak>I Added Some Magic</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Herta's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Fine, I'll Do It Myself
skills.description: When an ally target's attack causes an enemy target's HP percentage to fall to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or lower, Herta will launch a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Herta's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: When any ally target's attack reduces the enemy target's current HP percentage to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> or lower, Herta immediately launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, dealing minor Ice DMG to all enemies.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: It Can Still Be Optimized
skills.description: After using her Technique, Herta's ATK increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) at the beginning of the next battle.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, increases this unit's ATK at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: Kick You When You're Down
eidolons.description: When using Basic ATK, if the designated enemy's HP percentage is at <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or less, additionally deals Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Herta's ATK.

eidolons.name: Keep the Ball Rolling
eidolons.description: Every time Talent is triggered, this character's CRIT Rate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: That's the Kind of Girl I Am
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Hit Where It Hurts
eidolons.description: When Talent is triggered, DMG increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Cuss Big or Cuss Nothing
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: No One Can Betray Me
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate, this character's ATK increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

name: Saber
description: The solitary Heroic Spirit traverses the long night of fate. The banner of the round table remains unfurled in a dream. Alas, the knight-king of Camelot has yet to reach that ever-distant utopia.\nThough still a young maiden, she has heeded the call for this most unique iteration of the Holy Grail War. With the Sword in the Stone offering its choice once more, how shall she shatter the illusions of the past?\n— "The wishes I did not fulfill will end here."

skills.name: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK to adjacent targets. If <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> currently holds "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after this instance of Skill attack, then increases the multiplier for this instance of Skill. For every 1 point of "Core Resonance," increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>. And after the attack, consumes all "Core Resonance" to regenerate Energy for <unbreak>Saber</unbreak>. Otherwise, immediately gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Core Resonance."
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Wind DMG to one designated enemy and minor Wind DMG to adjacent targets. If Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after attacking, then <color=#f29e38ff>increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill based on "Core Resonance" points and consumes all "Core Resonance" after the attack</color>. Otherwise, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Core Resonance" point(s).</color>

skills.name: Excalibur
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK dealt to one random enemy. After using Ultimate, the next Basic ATK switches to "Release, the Golden Scepter," and only "Release, the Golden Scepter" can be used.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Wind DMG to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Wind DMG to random enemies, bouncing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). And enhances the next Basic ATK.

skills.name: Dragon Reactor Core
skills.description: When entering combat, gains <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Core Resonance" point(s). For every 1 "Core Resonance" point consumed, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#5[f1]</unbreak> Energy for <unbreak>Saber</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: When entering combat, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak></color> "Core Resonance" point(s)</color>. When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> and <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> "Core Resonance" point(s)</color>. Consuming "Core Resonance" will <color=#f29e38ff>regenerate Energy</color> for <unbreak>Saber</unbreak>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Behold, the King of Knights
skills.description: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, increases <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Core Resonance."
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Core Resonance" point(s)</color> and increases ATK.

skills.name: Release, the Golden Scepter
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Core Resonance" and deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK. When this ability is used, if the number of enemy targets is 2 or 1, additionally deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> or <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> ATK respectively.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> "Core Resonance"</color> and deals Wind DMG to all enemies. If there are 2 or fewer enemy targets on the field when this ability is used, additionally deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: The Lost White Walls
eidolons.description: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Core Resonance."

eidolons.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
eidolons.description: For every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, <unbreak>Saber</unbreak>'s DMG dealt ignores <unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance" effect to boost Skill's multiplier, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for the current instance of Skill by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
eidolons.description: Increases <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> Wind <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After using Ultimate, increases <unbreak>Saber's</unbreak> Wind <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect stacks up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Long Fated Night
eidolons.description: The Wind <u>RES PEN</u> of the Ultimate DMG dealt by <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The amount of overflow Energy that can be accumulated with the Trace "Blessing of the Lake" increases to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy for <unbreak>Saber</unbreak>. This effect can trigger 1 time after every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Ultimate use(s).

name: Archer
description: Despair plays in cycles between the past and future. Countless ideals were incinerated before that red garment. Yet, do not let this smear of ashes fool you —\nShould someone create a phantasmal sweet dream under the guise of false ideals, then he will burn again, facing down the hypocrites of the world till the very end.\nNo matter where he is, he always remains the steadfast champion of justice.

skills.name: Kanshou and Bakuya
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword
skills.description: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> ATK to one designated enemy. After using Skill in the "Circuit Connection" state, the current turn does not end, and the DMG dealt by <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> Skill increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s), lasting until he exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After actively using Skill <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s) or when Skill Points are insufficient to use Skill again, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After all enemy targets have been defeated in each wave, exits the "Circuit Connection" state.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals massive Quantum DMG to one designated enemy. During the "Circuit Connection" state, <color=#f29e38ff>the current turn does not end after using his Skill</color>, and the <color=#f29e38ff>DMG dealt by <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> Skill</color> increases. When Skill Points are insufficient to use Skill again, exits the "Circuit Connection" state.

skills.name: Unlimited Blade Works
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> ATK to one designated enemy and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge, up to a maximum of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Quantum DMG to one designated enemy and gains Charge.

skills.name: Mind's Eye (True)
skills.description: After <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> teammates attack enemy targets, <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> consumes 1 Charge and immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> on the primary target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> ATK and recovering 1 Skill Point. If the target is defeated before this <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is launched, the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> will be directed at one random enemy instead.
skills.simpleDescription: After a teammate uses an attack, <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> consumes 1 Charge and launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> on the primary target, dealing Quantum DMG and <color=#f29e38ff>recovering 1 Skill Point</color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Clairvoyance
skills.description: Immediately attacks enemies. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of <unbreak>Archer's</unbreak> ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Immediately attacks enemies. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG to all enemies and gains Charge.

skills.name: End
skills.description: Exits "Circuit Connection" state and ends the turn.

eidolons.name: The Unreached Dream
eidolons.description: After using Skill <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s) within one turn, recovers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for allies.

eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, reduces the enemy target's Quantum RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, and applies Quantum Weakness to it, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: The Untamed Will
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Unsung Life
eidolons.description: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Nameless Watch
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

name: Bronya
description: Heir apparent to the Supreme Guardian of Belobog.\nShe possesses pride befitting of a princess, but also the determination and integrity of a soldier.

skills.name: Windrider Bullet
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Bronya's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Combat Redeployment
skills.description: Dispels a <u>debuff</u> from a single ally, allows them to immediately take action, and increases their DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhen this Skill is used on Bronya herself, she cannot immediately take action again.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Dispels</color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff><u>debuff</u></color> from a single ally, <color=#f29e38ff>increases the damage they deal</color>, and allows them to <color=#f29e38ff>immediately take action</color>.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: The <unbreak>Belobog March</unbreak>
skills.description: Increases the ATK of all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and increases their CRIT DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Increases <color=#f29e38ff>ATK</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>CRIT DMG</color> of all allies.

skills.name: Leading the Way
skills.description: After using her Basic ATK, Bronya's next action will be <u>Advanced Forward</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses Basic ATK, their next action will be <u>Advanced Forward</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Banner of Command
skills.description: After using Bronya's Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies' ATK increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses Technique, increases all allies' ATK at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: Hone Your Strength
eidolons.description: When using Skill, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> of recovering 1 Skill Point. This effect has a 1-turn cooldown.

eidolons.name: Quick March
eidolons.description: When using Skill, the target ally's SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> after taking action, lasting for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Bombardment
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Take by Surprise
eidolons.description: After any other ally character uses Basic ATK on an enemy target that has Wind Weakness, Bronya immediately launches 1 instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Wind DMG to this target equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of her Basic ATK DMG. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

eidolons.name: Unstoppable
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Piercing Rainbow
eidolons.description: The duration of the DMG Boost effect placed by the Skill on the target ally increases by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

name: Seele
description: A resident of the Underworld and the backbone of Wildfire. She goes by the alias "Babochka."\nShe has a frank personality, but there is a delicate and sensitive hidden side to her deep in her heart.

skills.name: Thwack
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Sheathed Blade
skills.description: Increases Seele's SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Seele's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to one enemy and increases SPD.

skills.name: Butterfly Flurry
skills.description: Seele enters the Amplification state and deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the <color=#f29e38ff>Amplification state</color> and deals massive Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Resurgence
skills.description: Enters the Amplification state upon defeating an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, and receives an <u>extra turn</u>. While in the Amplification state, increases the DMG of Seele's attacks by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nEnemies defeated in the <u>extra turn</u> provided by "Resurgence" will not trigger another "Resurgence."
skills.simpleDescription: When <color=#f29e38ff>defeating enemy targets</color> with Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, gains an <color=#f29e38ff><u>extra turn</u> and enters the Amplification state</color>. While in Amplification, increases the DMG dealt by this unit.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Phantom Illusion
skills.description: After using her Technique, Seele gains Stealth for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). While Stealth is active, Seele cannot be detected by enemies. And when entering battle by attacking enemies, Seele will immediately enter the Amplification state.
skills.simpleDescription: Enter <color=#f29e38ff>Stealth</color> mode. After attacking an enemy and entering battle, enters the <color=#f29e38ff>Amplification state</color>.

eidolons.name: Extirpating Slash
eidolons.description: When dealing DMG to an enemy whose HP percentage is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or lower, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dancing Butterfly
eidolons.description: The SPD Boost effect of Seele's Skill can stack up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Dazzling Tumult
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Flitting Phantasm
eidolons.description: Seele regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy when she defeats an enemy.

eidolons.name: Piercing Shards
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Shattering Shambles
eidolons.description: After attacking with Ultimate, Seele inflicts "Butterfly Flurry" on the attacked enemy target for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Enemies in "Butterfly Flurry" will additionally take 1 instance of Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Seele's Ultimate DMG every time they are attacked. If the target is defeated by the "Butterfly Flurry" state's <u>Additional DMG</u> triggered by other allies' attacks, Seele's Talent will not be triggered.\nWhen Seele is <u>knocked down</u>, the "Butterfly Flurry" inflicted on the enemies will be removed.

name: Serval
description: A Belobog mechanic who used to be a researcher for the Technology Division of the Architects.\nAs Gepard Landau's elder sister, her personality stands in stark contrast to her brother's.\nShe loves an ancient form of music known as "rock 'n' roll" that was popular before the Eternal Freeze.

skills.name: Roaring Thunderclap
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Lightning Flash
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK to enemies adjacent to it, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for enemies hit to become Shocked for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Shocked, enemies take Lightning DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets, with a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>applying Shock</color> on the target.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Here Comes the Mechanical Fever
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK to all enemies. Enemies already Shocked will extend the duration of their Shock state by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and increases the duration of Shock.

skills.name: Galvanic Chords
skills.description: After Serval attacks, deals Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Serval's ATK to all Shocked enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: After attacking, deals <color=#f29e38ff>a minor amount of <u>Additional DMG</u></color> to all Shocked enemies.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Good Night, Belobog
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of Serval's ATK to a random enemy, with a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for all enemies to become Shocked for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Shocked, enemies will take Lightning DoT equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Lightning DMG to a random single enemy, with a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>Shock</color> all enemy targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Echo Chamber
eidolons.description: Basic ATK deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Basic ATK DMG to a random target adjacent to the target enemy.

eidolons.name: Encore!
eidolons.description: Every time Serval's Talent is triggered to deal <u>Additional DMG</u>, she regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Listen, the Heartbeat of the Gears
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Make Some Noise!
eidolons.description: Ultimate has a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to apply Shock to any enemies not currently Shocked. This Shock has the same effects as the one applied by Skill.

eidolons.name: Belobog's Loudest Roar!
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: This Song Rocks to Heaven!
eidolons.description: Serval deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG to Shocked enemies.

name: Gepard
description: A captain in the Silvermane Guards and an outstanding warrior of Belobog.\nHe is meticulous and vigilant to the core and is always true to himself.

skills.name: Fist of Conviction
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Daunting Smite
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Freeze the enemy for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to one enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>with a chance of Freezing them</color>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Enduring Bulwark
skills.description: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gepard's DEF plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Provides a Shield</color> to all allies.

skills.name: Unyielding Will
skills.description: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming <u>knocked down</u>, Gepard's HP immediately restores to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.
skills.simpleDescription: When struck by a killing blow, <color=#f29e38ff>instead of being <u>knocked down</u></color>, immediately restores HP. This effect can only trigger 1 time per battle.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Comradery
skills.description: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Gepard's DEF plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses Technique, all allies gain a Shield at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: Due Diligence
eidolons.description: When using Skill, increases the <u>base chance</u> to Freeze the attacked target enemy by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lingering Cold
eidolons.description: After an enemy Frozen by Skill is unfrozen, their SPD is reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Never Surrender
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Faith Moves Mountains
eidolons.description: When Gepard is in battle, all allies' Effect RES increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Cold Iron Fist
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Unyielding Resolve
eidolons.description: When his Talent is triggered, Gepard immediately takes action and restores extra HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP.

name: Natasha
description: A doctor from the Underworld and a caregiver of children.\nAlongside her kindness and caring, she also has a hidden dangerous side.

skills.name: Behind the Kindness
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Natasha's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
skills.description: Restores a single ally for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Natasha's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. Restores the ally for another <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Natasha's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> at the beginning of each turn for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Restores HP</color> for a single ally and provides <color=#f29e38ff>Healing Over Time</color> to them.

skills.name: Gift of Rebirth
skills.description: Heals all allies for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Natasha's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Restores HP</color> for all allies.

skills.name: Innervation
skills.description: When healing allies with HP percentage at <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect also works on continuous healing.
skills.simpleDescription: When healing allies with low HP percentage, increases Outgoing Healing. This effect also works on continuous healing.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Hypnosis Research
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Weaken all enemies.\nWhile Weakened, enemies deal <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> less DMG to allies for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Physical DMG to a random single enemy, with a high chance to inflict Weaken to all enemy targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Pharmacology Expertise
eidolons.description: After being attacked, if the current HP percentage is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or lower, heals self for 1 time to restore HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Max HP plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

eidolons.name: Clinical Research
eidolons.description: When Natasha uses her Ultimate, grant continuous healing for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) to allies whose HP percentage is at <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or lower. And at the beginning of their turn, their HP is restored by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Natasha's Max HP plus <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Right Cure
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Miracle Cure
eidolons.description: After being attacked, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra Energy.

eidolons.name: Preventive Treatment
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Doctor's Grace
eidolons.description: Natasha's Basic ATK additionally deals Physical DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of her Max HP.

name: Pela
description: An intelligence officer for the Silvermane Guards.\nShe has a serious personality and is revered by other members of the Silvermane Guards.

skills.name: Frost Shot
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Pela's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Frostbite
skills.description: Removes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>buff(s)</u> and deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Dispels</color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff><u>buff</u></color> from one enemy target, and deals Ice DMG to the target enemy.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: Can buff combat ability for a period of time, which can be dispelled unless otherwise specified.

skills.name: Zone Suppression
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Exposed on all enemies.\nWhen Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Has a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>lowering enemies' DEF</color> and deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Data Collecting
skills.description: If the enemy is <u>debuffed</u> after Pela's attack, Pela will restore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.
skills.simpleDescription: After using an attack, if the enemy target is currently inflicted with <u>debuff(s)</u>, Pela regenerates Energy.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Preemptive Strike
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of her ATK to a random enemy, with a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of lowering the DEF of all enemies by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor DMG to a random single enemy, with a high chance of lowering the DEF of all enemy targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Victory Report
eidolons.description: When an enemy is defeated, Pela regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Adamant Charge
eidolons.description: Using Skill to dispel <u>buff(s)</u> increases SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Suppressive Force
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Full Analysis
eidolons.description: When using Skill, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce the target enemy's Ice RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Absolute Jeopardy
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Feeble Pursuit
eidolons.description: After Pela attacks, if the enemy target is <u>debuffed</u>, deals Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Pela's ATK to the enemy.

name: Clara
description: A vagrant girl who lives with robots.\nShe is introverted, gentle, and has a pure heart.\nShe wishes for all Underworlders to become a family.

skills.name: I Want to Help
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Clara's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Svarog Watches Over You
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter.\nAll Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to all enemies. <color=#f29e38ff>Additionally deals Physical DMG</color> to targets with Marks of Counter.

skills.name: Promise, <unbreak>Not Command</unbreak>
skills.description: After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nIn addition, Svarog's <u>Counter</u> is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a <u>Counter</u>, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Enemies adjacent to it take <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy. Enhanced <u>Counter(s)</u> can take effect <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Reduces DMG received</color>, increases chance to be attacked by enemies, and enhances <u>Counters</u>.

10000003.name: Counter
10000003.desc: An effect that automatically triggers when the target is attacked, which unleashes an extra attack on the attacker.\nCounter is also considered a Follow-Up ATK.

skills.name: Because We're Family
skills.description: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a <u>Counter</u>, dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Clara's ATK.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>DMG received from enemy attacks is reduced</color>. Enemies who attack Clara will be marked with a Mark of Counter and <color=#f29e38ff>met with Svarog's <u>Counter</u></color>, dealing Physical DMG.

10000003.name: Counter
10000003.desc: An effect that automatically triggers when the target is attacked, which unleashes an extra attack on the attacker.\nCounter is also considered a Follow-Up ATK.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: A Small Price for Victory
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, this character's chance of being attacked by enemies increases.

eidolons.name: A Tall Figure
eidolons.description: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy.

eidolons.name: A Tight Embrace
eidolons.description: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Cold Steel Armor
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Family's Warmth
eidolons.description: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

eidolons.name: A Small Promise
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Long Company
eidolons.description: After other allies are attacked, Svarog also has a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to trigger a <u>Counter</u> on the attacker and mark them with a "Mark of Counter." When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.
