name: Sampo
description: A merchant who freely travels between the Overworld and the Underworld.\nHe acts like he is everyone's friend, is enthusiastically humorous, and is good at bantering.

skills.name: Dazzling Blades
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Ricochet Love
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy, and further deals DMG for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra time(s), with each time dealing Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sampo's ATK to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to single enemy targets with 5 Bounces in total.

skills.name: Surprise Present
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sampo's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase the targets' DoT taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Wind DMG to all enemies, with a high chance to cause <color=#f29e38ff>increased DoT taken</color> to them.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Windtorn Dagger
skills.description: Sampo's attacks have a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Wind Shear for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nEnemies inflicted with Wind Shear will take Wind DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sampo's ATK at the beginning of each turn. Wind Shear can stack up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After hitting an enemy, there is a chance of inflicting <color=#f29e38ff>Wind Shear</color> on the target.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Shining Bright
skills.description: After Sampo uses his Technique, enemies in a set area are afflicted with Blind for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Blinded enemies cannot detect ally targets.\nWhen initiating combat against a Blinded enemy, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to <u>delay all enemies' action</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Enemies in a set area are Blinded. When initiating battle against a Blinded enemy, there is a high chance to <u>delay</u> all enemies' actions.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

eidolons.name: Rising Love
eidolons.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra time(s) to a random enemy.

eidolons.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
eidolons.description: Defeating an enemy afflicted with Wind Shear has a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict all enemies with <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Wind Shear, equivalent to that of Skill.

eidolons.name: Big Money!
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Deeper the Love, the Stronger the Hate
eidolons.description: When Skill hits an enemy with <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more stack(s) of Wind Shear, the enemy immediately takes <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of current Wind Shear DMG.

eidolons.name: Huuuuge Money!
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Increased Spending
eidolons.description: Talent's Wind Shear DMG multiplier increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Hook
description: Boss (self-proclaimed) of an Underworld adventure squad, The Moles.\nShe loves freedom and sees life as a series of adventures.

skills.name: Hehe! Don't Get Burned!
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Burn for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhen afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy, with a high chance to inflict Burn on the enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Boom! <unbreak>Here Comes the Fire!</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy.\nAfter using Ultimate, the next Skill to be used is Enhanced, which deals DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Fire DMG to one enemy and <color=#f29e38ff>Enhances this unit's next Skill</color>.

skills.name: Ha! Oil to the Flames!
skills.description: When attacking a target afflicted with Burn, deals Fire <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK and regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> extra Energy.
skills.simpleDescription: When attacking a Burned enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>deals Fire <u>Additional DMG</u> for a moderate amount</color>, and additionally regenerates energy.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Ack! Look at This Mess!
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Hook deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of her ATK to a random enemy. In addition, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Burn on every enemy for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhen afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks enemies. After entering battle, deals minor Fire DMG to one random enemy, with a high chance to inflict Burn on each enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK to one designated enemy, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Burn them for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Additionally, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.\nWhen afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy with a high chance of inflicting Burn, also deals minor Fire DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Early to Bed, Early to Rise
eidolons.description: Enhanced Skill deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> increased DMG.

eidolons.name: Happy Tummy, Happy Body
eidolons.description: Extends the duration of Burn caused by Skill by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Don't Be Picky, Nothing's Icky
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: It's Okay to Not Know
eidolons.description: When Talent is triggered, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Burn enemies adjacent to the designated enemy target, equivalent to that of Skill.

eidolons.name: Let the Moles' Deeds Be Known
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Always Ready to Punch and Kick
eidolons.description: Hook deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn.

name: Lynx
description: A Belobogian Snow Plains Explorer, and the youngest of the Landau siblings.\nCalm and collected, with a strong drive for action. Often embarks on solo adventures to explore the snowy wilderness.

skills.name: Ice Crampon Technique
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of this character's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Salted Camping Cans
skills.description: Applies "Survival Response" to a single target ally and increases their Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lynx's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. If the target ally is a character on the Path of Destruction or Preservation, the chance of them being attacked by enemies will greatly increase. "Survival Response" lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nRestores the target's HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lynx's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Applies "Survival Response" to a single ally, <color=#f29e38ff>increases their Max HP</color>, and restores their HP.

skills.name: Snowfield <unbreak>First Aid</unbreak>
skills.description: Dispels <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from all allies and immediately restores their respective HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lynx's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Dispels <color=#f29e38ff>1 <u>debuff</u> from all allies</color> and restores their HP.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Outdoor Survival Experience
skills.description: When using Lynx's Skill or Ultimate, applies continuous healing to the target ally for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s), restoring the target ally's HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lynx's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> at the start of each turn. If the target has "Survival Response," the continuous healing effect additionally restores HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lynx's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: When using Skill or Ultimate, applies <color=#f29e38ff>continuous healing</color> on the target ally. If the target has "Survival Response," the continuous healing effect additionally increases.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Chocolate Energy Bar
skills.description: After Lynx uses her Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted her Talent's continuous healing effect, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses her Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted a continuous healing effect.

eidolons.name: Morning of Snow Hike
eidolons.description: When healing allies with HP percentage equal to or lower than <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, Lynx's Outgoing Healing increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect also works on continuous healing.

eidolons.name: Noon of Portable Furnace
eidolons.description: A target with "Survival Response" can resist <u>debuff</u> application for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Afternoon of Avalanche Beacon
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dusk of Warm Campfire
eidolons.description: When "Survival Response" is gained, increases the target's ATK by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak> of Lynx's Max HP for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Night of Aurora Tea
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dawn of Explorers' Chart
eidolons.description: Additionally boosts the Max HP increasing effect of "Survival Response" by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak> of Lynx's Max HP and increases Effect RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Luka
description: The boxing champion in Belobog's Underworld, and one of Wildfire's most capable fighters.\nThe consecutive reigning champion of the Fight Club, whose enthusiasm inspires children of the Underworld to dream big.

skills.name: Direct Punch
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Lacerating Fist
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target. In addition, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict Bleed on them, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile Bleeding, the enemy will take <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak> of their Max HP as Physical DoT at the start of each turn. This DMG will not exceed more than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy, with a high chance of causing <color=#f29e38ff>Bleed</color>.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Coup de Grâce
skills.description: Receives <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Fighting Will," with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase one designated enemy target's DMG received by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK to the target.
skills.simpleDescription: Receives <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "Fighting Will," with a high chance of increasing the one enemy's DMG received, and deals massive Physical DMG to the target.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Flying Sparks
skills.description: After Luka uses his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" or Skill "Lacerating Fist," he receives <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack of Fighting Will, up to 4 stacks. When he has 2 or more stacks of Fighting Will, his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" is enhanced to "Sky-Shatter Fist." After his Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG for 1 time equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG to the target. At the start of battle, Luka will possess 1 stack of Fighting Will.
skills.simpleDescription: After using the Basic ATK "Direct Punch" or the Skill "Lacerating Fist," receives 1 stack of Fighting Will. When 2 or more stacks of Fighting Will are present, <color=#f29e38ff>Basic ATK becomes Enhanced</color>.\nIf the enemy is Bleeding, the Enhanced Basic ATK will <color=#f29e38ff>cause Bleed to deal extra DMG for 1 time</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Anticipator
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Luka deals Physical DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his ATK to a random single enemy with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict his Skill's Bleed effect on the target. Then, Luka gains 1 additional stack of Fighting Will.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Physical DMG to a random single enemy, with a high chance to inflict <color=#f29e38ff>Bleed</color> to the target. Then, gains 1 stack of Fighting Will.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Sky-Shatter Fist
skills.description: Consumes 2 stacks of "Fighting Will." First, uses "Direct Punch" to deal 3 hits, with each hit dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target.\nThen, uses "Rising Uppercut" to deal 1 hit, dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luka's ATK to the designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes 2 stacks of "Fighting Will" to deal Physical DMG to one enemy.

eidolons.name: Fighting Endlessly
eidolons.description: When Luka takes action, if the target enemy is Bleeding, increases DMG dealt by Luka by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: The Enemy is Weak, I am Strong
eidolons.description: If the Skill hits an enemy target with Physical Weakness, gain <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Fighting Will.

eidolons.name: Born for the Ring
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Never Turning Back
eidolons.description: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, increases ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: The Spirit of Wildfire
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Champion's Applause
eidolons.description: After the Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG 1 time equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG for every hit of Direct Punch already unleashed during the current Enhanced Basic ATK.

name: Topaz & Numby
description:
Topaz is the Leader of the Special Debts Picket Team and high-level manager of the Strategic Investment Department under the Interastral Peace Corporation.
A member of the "Ten Stonehearts" at a young age, Topaz's foundational expertise is "debt retrieval."
Her partner, the Warp Trotter "Numby," is also capable of keenly perceiving where "riches" are located, ensuring that jobs based in security, debt collection, and actuarial varieties are of no great challenge.
At presently they are traveling the cosmos together, seeking all manner of liability disputes that might be affecting the stable progression of the IPC's businesses.

skills.name: Deficit...
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Topaz's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to an enemy.

skills.name: Difficulty Paying?
skills.description: Inflicts one designated enemy target with a "Proof of Debt" state, increasing the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG it receives by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. "Proof of Debt" only takes effect on the most recent target it is applied to. If there are no enemies inflicted with "Proof of Debt" on the field when an ally's turn starts or when an ally takes action, Topaz will inflict a random enemy with "Proof of Debt."\nNumby deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Topaz's ATK to this target. Using this Skill to deal DMG is considered as launching a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts one enemy with a "Proof of Debt" state and causes it to <color=#f29e38ff>receive increased Follow-Up ATK DMG</color>. Numby deals Fire DMG to the target.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Turn a Profit!
skills.description: Numby enters the Windfall Bonanza! state and its DMG multiplier increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Also, when enemies with Proof of Debt are hit by an ally's Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. Numby exits the Windfall Bonanza! state after using <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> attacks.
skills.simpleDescription: Numby enters the Windfall Bonanza! state and <color=#f29e38ff>increases its DMG multiplier and CRIT DMG</color>.

skills.name: Trotter Market!?
skills.description: Summons Numby at the start of battle. Numby has <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> SPD by default. When taking action, Numby launches <u>Follow-Up ATKs</u> on one enemy target afflicted with "Proof of Debt," dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Topaz's ATK.\nWhen enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive an ally's Follow-Up ATKs, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. The action Advance Forward effect cannot be triggered during Numby's own turn.\nWhen Topaz is <u>downed</u>, Numby disappears.
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of the battle, <color=#f29e38ff>summons Numby</color>. When Numby takes action, it <color=#f29e38ff>launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> on a target afflicted with "Proof of Debt"</color>, dealing Fire DMG.\nWhen an enemy afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receives <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, Numby's <color=#f29e38ff>action advances</color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Explicit Subsidy
skills.description:
Summons Numby when Topaz enters the overworld. Numby will automatically search for Basic Treasures and Trotters within a set radius.
Using her Technique will regenerate <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.
If Topaz is still in the team after using her Technique and defeating overworld enemies, a small bonus amount of credits will be added to the earned credits. A maximum of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> bonus credits can be received per calendar day.
After using her Technique and defeating enemies in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, additionally receive a small amount of Cosmic Fragments with a small chance to obtain 1 random Curio.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Summons Numby to tag along</color> in a map. Numby will automatically <color=#f29e38ff>search for Basic Treasures and Trotters nearby</color>. Using Technique will regenerate Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.

eidolons.name: Future Market
eidolons.description: When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive <u>Follow-Up ATKs</u>, they will enter the "Debtor" state. This can take effect only once within a single attack.\nThe "Debtor" state increases the CRIT DMG of <u>Follow-Up ATKs</u> inflicted on the enemy target by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s). When "Proof of Debt" is removed, the "Debtor" state is also removed.

eidolons.name: Bona Fide Acquisition
eidolons.description: After Numby takes action and launches an attack, Topaz regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Seize the Big and Free the Small
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Agile Operation
eidolons.description: After Numby's turn begins, Topaz's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Inflationary Demand

name: Qingque
description: Diviner of the Divination Commission on the Xianzhou Luofu, and a librarian.\nAlways slacks off and is about to be demoted to a "door guardian."

skills.name: Flower Pick
skills.description: Tosses 1 jade tile from the suit with the fewest tiles in hand to deal Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Tosses a tile to deal minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: A Scoop of Moon
skills.description: Immediately draws <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> jade tile(s) and increases DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> until the end of the current turn. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s). The turn will not end after this Skill is used.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Draws tiles</color> and increases DMG dealt. <color=#f29e38ff>This turn does not end</color> after this action.

skills.name: A Quartet? Woo-hoo!
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Qingque's ATK to all enemies, and obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to all enemies, then obtains 4 tiles of the same suit.

skills.name: Celestial Jade
skills.description: When an ally's turn starts, Qingque randomly draws 1 tile from 3 different suits and can hold up to 4 tiles at one time.\nIf Qingque starts her turn with 4 tiles of the same suit, she consumes all tiles to enter the "Hidden Hand" state.\nWhile in this state, Qingque cannot use her Skill again. At the same time, Qingque's ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, and her Basic ATK "Flower Pick" is enhanced, becoming "Cherry on Top!" The "Hidden Hand" state ends after using "Cherry on Top!".
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of any ally's turn, draws a tile. At the start of this character's turn, if this character holds 4 tiles from the same suit, remove all tiles in possession and <color=#f29e38ff>Enhance this Basic ATK</color> while increasing this character's ATK.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Game Solitaire
skills.description: After using Technique, Qingque draws <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> jade tile(s) when the battle starts.
skills.simpleDescription: After they use their Technique, draw tile(s) at the start of the next battle.

skills.name: Cherry on Top!
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Qingque's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Qingque's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.\n"Cherry on Top!" cannot recover Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to one enemy and minor Quantum DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

eidolons.name: Rise Through the Tiles
eidolons.description: Ultimate deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG.

eidolons.name: Sleep on the Tiles
eidolons.description: Every time Draw Tile is triggered, Qingque immediately regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Read Between the Tiles
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Right on the Tiles
eidolons.description: After using Skill, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to gain "Self-Sufficer," lasting until the end of the current turn. \nWhile "Self-Sufficer" is active, using Basic ATK or Enhanced Basic ATK immediately launches 1 <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> on the same target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <unbreak>100%</unbreak> of Basic ATK DMG or Enhanced Basic ATK DMG.

eidolons.name: Gambit for the Tiles
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Prevail Beyond the Tiles
eidolons.description: Recovers 1 Skill Point after using Enhanced Basic ATK.

name: Tingyun
description: Amicassador of the Sky-Faring Commission of the Xianzhou Luofu.\nShe travels with business delegates, forging trade relationships and alliances with many worlds.

skills.name: Dislodged
skills.description: Tingyun deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Soothing Melody
skills.description: Grants a single ally with Benediction to increase their ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Tingyun's current ATK.\nWhen the ally with Benediction attacks, they will deal Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of that ally's ATK for 1 time.\nBenediction lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and is only effective on the most recent receiver of Tingyun's Skill.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Increases the ATK</color> of a single ally and grants them Benediction. Ally with Benediction additionally deals minor <color=#f29e38ff>Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u></color> when attacking.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Amidst the Rejoicing Clouds
skills.description: Regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for a single ally and increases the target's DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Regenerates a target ally's <color=#f29e38ff>Energy</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>increases their DMG dealt</color>.

skills.name: Violet Sparknado
skills.description: When an enemy is attacked by Tingyun, the ally with Benediction immediately deals Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of that ally's ATK to the same enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: When an enemy is attacked by Tingyun, the ally with Benediction immediately deals minor Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> to the same enemy.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Gentle Breeze
skills.description: Tingyun immediately regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy upon using her Technique.
skills.simpleDescription: After using this Technique, this character immediately regenerates Energy for themselves.

eidolons.name: Windfall of Lucky Springs
eidolons.description: After using their Ultimate, the ally with Benediction gains a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> increase in SPD for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Gainfully Gives, Givingly Gains
eidolons.description: The ally with Benediction regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy after defeating an enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per turn.

eidolons.name: Halcyon Bequest
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Jovial Versatility
eidolons.description: The DMG multiplier provided by Benediction increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sauntering Coquette
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Peace Brings Wealth to All
eidolons.description: Ultimate regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> more Energy for the target ally.

name: Luocha
description: Carrying a coffin wherever he goes, he is a foreign trader who came from beyond the stellar seas.\nHas excellent medical skills.

skills.name: Thorns of the Abyss
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luocha's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Prayer of Abyss Flower
skills.description: After using his Skill, Luocha immediately restores the target ally's HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luocha's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. Meanwhile, Luocha gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.\nWhen any ally's HP percentage drops to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> or lower, an effect equivalent to Luocha's Skill will immediately be triggered and applied to this ally for one time (without consuming Skill Points). This effect can be triggered again after <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Restores</color> a single ally's HP and gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.

skills.name: Death Wish
skills.description: Removes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>buff(s)</u> from all enemies and deals all enemies Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Luocha's ATK. At the same time, Luocha gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Removes</color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff><u>buff</u></color> from all enemies, deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies, and gains 1 stack of Abyss Flower.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: Can buff combat ability for a period of time, which can be dispelled unless otherwise specified.

skills.name: Cycle of Life
skills.description: When Abyss Flower reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stacks, Luocha consumes all stacks of Abyss Flower to deploy a Zone against the enemy.\nWhen any enemy in the Zone is attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is immediately restored by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Luocha's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>.\nThe Zone's effect lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turns. When Luocha is <u>knocked down</u>, the Zone will be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: Deploys a <color=#f29e38ff>Zone</color> when Abyss Flower reaches 2 stacks. While the Zone is active, allies will <color=#f29e38ff>restore HP after they attack</color>.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Mercy of a Fool
skills.description: After the Technique is used, the Talent will be immediately triggered at the start of the next battle.
skills.simpleDescription: After the Technique is used, immediately trigger the effect of the Talent at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: Ablution of the Quick
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, ATK of all allies increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bestowal From the Pure
eidolons.description: When his Skill is triggered, if the target ally's HP percentage is lower than <unbreak>50%</unbreak>, Luocha's Outgoing Healing increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. If the target ally's HP percentage is at <unbreak>50%</unbreak> or higher, the ally receives a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Luocha's ATK plus <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turns.

eidolons.name: Surveyal by the Fool
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Heavy Lies the Crown
eidolons.description: When Luocha's Zone is active, enemies become Weakened and deal <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> less DMG.

eidolons.name: Cicatrix 'Neath the Pain
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Reunion With the Dust
eidolons.description: When Ultimate is used, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to reduce all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

name: Jing Yuan
description: The Divine Foresight, one of the Seven Arbiter-Generals of the Xianzhou Alliance, leads the Cloud Knights of the Xianzhou Luofu.\nA student of the Luofu's previous Sword Champion, though not known for his martial prowess.

skills.name: Glistening Light
skills.description: Jing Yuan deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Rifting Zenith
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for the next turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies and <color=#f29e38ff>increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action</color>.

skills.name: Lightbringer
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for the next turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and <color=#f29e38ff>increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action</color>.

skills.name: Prana Extirpated
skills.description:
Summons "Lightning-Lord" at the start of the battle. "Lightning-Lord" has <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> base SPD and <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> base Hits Per Action. When the Lightning-Lord takes action, its hits are considered as <u>Follow-Up ATKs</u>, with each hit dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jing Yuan's ATK to a random single enemy, and enemies adjacent to it also receive Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.
The Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action can reach a max of <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>. Every time "Lightning-Lord's" Hits Per Action increases by 1, its SPD increases by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>. After the "Lightning-Lord's" action ends, its SPD and Hits Per Action return to their base values.
When Jing Yuan is <u>knocked down</u>, the "Lightning-Lord" will disappear.
When Jing Yuan is affected by <u>Crowd Control debuff</u>, the "Lightning-Lord" is unable to take action.
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of the battle, summons "Lightning-Lord." When "Lightning-Lord" takes action, launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> to <color=#f29e38ff>automatically</color> <color=#f29e38ff>deal minor Lightning DMG</color> to one random enemy and adjacent targets.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Spiritus Invocation
skills.description: After the Technique is used, the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action in the first turn increases by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> at the start of the next battle.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, for the next battle, <color=#f29e38ff>increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action</color>.

eidolons.name: Slash, Seas Split
eidolons.description: When Lightning-Lord attacks, the DMG multiplier on enemies adjacent to the target enemy increases by an extra amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the DMG multiplier against the primary target enemy.

eidolons.name: Swing, Skies Squashed
eidolons.description: After Lightning-Lord takes action, DMG dealt by Jing Yuan's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Strike, Suns Subdued
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Spin, Stars Sieged
eidolons.description: For each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action, Jing Yuan regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Stride, Spoils Seized
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sweep, Souls Slain
eidolons.description: Each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action will make the target enemy Vulnerable.\nWhile Vulnerable, enemies receive <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG until the end of the Lightning-Lord's current turn, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

name: Blade
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters, and a swordsman who abandoned his body to become a blade.\nPledges loyalty to "Destiny's Slave," and possesses a terrifying self-healing ability.

skills.name: Shard Sword
skills.description: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Blade's ATK as Wind DMG to a target enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to an enemy.

skills.name: Hellscape
skills.description:
Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Blade's Max HP to enter the Hellscape state.
When Hellscape is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, and his Basic ATK Shard Sword is enhanced to Forest of Swords for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes HP to <color=#f29e38ff>Enhance Basic ATK</color>, and this turn does not end after this Skill is used.

skills.name: Death Sentence
skills.description: Sets Blade's current HP to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to the sum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK, <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP, and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK, <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP, and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.\nThe tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at <unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.
skills.simpleDescription: Sets current HP to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of Max HP, and deals massive Wind DMG to one enemy and Wind DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Shuhu's Gift
skills.description: When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.\nWhen Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Blade's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.
skills.simpleDescription: When Blade's HP decreases, gains 1 stack of Charge. Upon reaching maximum Charge, launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, <color=#f29e38ff>dealing Wind DMG to all enemies</color>, restoring HP, and consuming all Charges.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Karma Wind
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP to all enemies.\nIf Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes own HP and deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Forest of Swords
skills.description: Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Blade's Max HP and deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP to one designated enemy. In addition, deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Blade's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of his Max HP to adjacent targets.\nIf Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when using "Forest of Swords."\n"Forest of Swords" cannot regenerate Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes HP and deals Wind DMG to an enemy, as well as minor Wind DMG to adjacent targets.

eidolons.name: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell
eidolons.description: Blade's Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy target, with the increased amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle.\nThe tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP. The tally value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

eidolons.name: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream
eidolons.description: When Blade is in the Hellscape state, his CRIT Rate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Hardened Blade Bleeds Coldest Shade
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life
eidolons.description: When Blade's current HP percentage drops to <unbreak>50%</unbreak> or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Death By Ten Lords' Gaze
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Reborn Into an Empty Husk
eidolons.description: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG, with the increased amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Blade's Max HP.

name: Sushang
description: Born on the Xianzhou Yaoqing, sent to the Cloud Knights of the Luofu for military training.\nShe wields her family sword, a gift from her mother, and longs for the future she will go on to write.

skills.name: Cloudfencer Art: Starshine
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Cloudfencer Art: Mountainfall
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy. In addition, there is a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit, dealing Physical <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sushang's ATK to the enemy.\nIf the enemy is inflicted with <u>Weakness Break</u>, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy with <color=#f29e38ff>a small chance of triggering "Sword Stance"</color>. If the enemy has <u>Weakness Break</u>, <color=#f29e38ff>"Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger</color>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

skills.name: Shape of Taixu: Dawn Herald
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sushang's ATK to one designated enemy target, and she immediately takes action. In addition, Sushang's ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> and using her Skill has 2 extra chances to trigger "Sword Stance" for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\n"Sword Stance" triggered from the extra chances deals <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Physical DMG to one enemy, enhances "Sword Stance's" effect, and <color=#f29e38ff>takes action immediately</color>.

skills.name: Dancing Blade
skills.description: When an enemy has their Weakness Broken on the field, Sushang's SPD increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f2]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When an enemy on the field has its Weakness Broken, this character's SPD increases.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Cloudfencer Art: Warcry
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Sushang deals Physical DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of her ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Physical DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Cut With Ease
eidolons.description: After using Skill against a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy, regenerates 1 Skill Point.

eidolons.name: Refine in Toil
eidolons.description: After Sword Stance is triggered, the DMG taken by Sushang is reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: Rise From Fame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Cleave With Heart
eidolons.description: Sushang's Break Effect increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Prevail via Taixu
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dwell Like Water
eidolons.description: Talent's SPD Boost is stackable and can stack up to 2 times. Additionally, after entering battle, Sushang immediately gains 1 stack of her Talent's SPD Boost.

name: Yukong
description: Head of the Sky-Faring Commission on the Xianzhou Luofu. Yukong was a seasoned pilot and a deadshot.\nSince heading up the commission, she's been buried under mountains of paperwork.

skills.name: Arrowslinger
skills.description: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yukong's ATK as Imaginary DMG to a target enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to an enemy.

skills.name: Emboldening Salvo
skills.description: Obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings" (to a maximum of 2 stacks). When "Roaring Bowstrings" is active, the ATK of all allies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, and every time an ally's turn (including Yukong's) ends, Yukong loses 1 stack of "Roaring Bowstrings."\nWhen it's the turn where Yukong gains "Roaring Bowstrings" by using Skill, "Roaring Bowstrings" will not be removed.
skills.simpleDescription: Obtains 2 stacks of Roaring Bowstrings. All allies' <color=#f29e38ff>ATK increases</color> when Roaring Bowstrings is active on this character.

skills.name: Diving Kestrel
skills.description: If "Roaring Bowstrings" is active on Yukong when her Ultimate is used, additionally increases all allies' CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the same time, deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yukong's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: When "Roaring Bowstrings" is active on this character, <color=#f29e38ff>increases the CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG</color> of all allies and deals massive Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Seven Layers, One Arrow
skills.description: Basic ATK additionally deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yukong's ATK, and increases the Toughness Reduction of this attack by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can be triggered again after <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Basic Attack additionally deals minor DMG, and the Toughness Reduction of this Basic Attack is increased. This effect can be triggered again after 1 turn has passed.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Windchaser
skills.description: After using her Technique, Yukong enters Sprint mode for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. In Sprint mode, her movement speed increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, and Yukong gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings" when she enters combat by attacking enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: This unit's <color=#f29e38ff>movement speed increases</color>. After attacking an enemy and entering battle, gains 2 stacks of Roaring Bowstrings.

eidolons.name: Aerial Marshal
eidolons.description: At the start of battle, increases the SPD of all allies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Skyward Command
eidolons.description: When any ally's current energy is equal to its energy limit, Yukong regenerates an additional <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> energy. This effect can only be triggered once for each ally. The trigger count is reset after Yukong uses her Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Torrential Fusillade
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Zephyrean Echoes
eidolons.description: When "Roaring Bowstrings" is active, Yukong deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG to enemies.

eidolons.name: August Deadshot
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bowstring Thunderclap
eidolons.description: When Yukong uses her Ultimate, she immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Roaring Bowstrings."

name: Fu Xuan
description: Head of the Divination Commission on the Luofu.\nThe person who uses the third eye and Matrix of Prescience to foretell the route of Xianzhou and the outcomes of events.

skills.name: Novaburst
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fu Xuan's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Known by Stars, Shown by Hearts
skills.description: Activates Matrix of Prescience, via which Fu Xuan's teammates will <u>Distribute</u> <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the DMG they receive (before this DMG is mitigated by any Shields) to Fu Xuan for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile affected by Matrix of Prescience, all ally targets gain the Knowledge effect, which increases their respective Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Fu Xuan's Max HP, and increases CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nWhen Fu Xuan is <u>knocked down</u>, the Matrix of Prescience will be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: Activates Matrix of Prescience. <color=#f29e38ff>DMG received by Fu Xuan's teammates is <u>Distributed</u></color> to her. Also <color=#f29e38ff>increases CRIT Rate</color> and Max HP of all allies.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

10000013.name: Distribute
10000013.desc: Before DMG is calculated, distribute a part of the attacking unit's DMG to another target (or multiple other targets), with the target hit by the attack taking the rest of the DMG. DMG distributed to other targets cannot be distributed again.

skills.name: Woes of Many Morphed to One
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fu Xuan's Max HP to all enemies and obtains 1 trigger count for the HP Restore effect granted by Fu Xuan's Talent.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to all enemies and increases Fu Xuan's Talent trigger count.

skills.name: Bleak Breeds Bliss
skills.description: While Fu Xuan is still active in combat, Misfortune Avoidance is applied to the entire team. With Misfortune Avoidance, allies take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> less DMG.\nWhen Fu Xuan's current HP percentage falls to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of her Max HP or less, HP Restore will be triggered for Fu Xuan, restoring her HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the amount of HP she is currently missing. This effect cannot be triggered if she receives a killing blow. This effect has 1 trigger count by default and can hold up to a maximum of 2 trigger counts.
skills.simpleDescription: While Fu Xuan is still active in combat, the DMG taken by all team members is reduced.\nWhen her HP is low, <color=#f29e38ff>automatically</color> <color=#f29e38ff>restores her own HP</color> based on the HP percentage already lost. This effect can have up to 2 trigger counts at any given time.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Of Fortune Comes Fate
skills.description: After the Technique is used, all team members receive a Barrier, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. This Barrier can block all enemy attacks, and the team will not enter combat when attacked. Entering battle while the Barrier is active will have Fu Xuan automatically activate Matrix of Prescience at the start of the battle, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Activates a Barrier. Allies will not enter combat when attacked by enemies. Entering battle will automatically activate Matrix of Prescience.

eidolons.name: Dominus Pacis
eidolons.description: The Knowledge effect increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Optimus Felix
eidolons.description: If any ally target is struck by a killing blow while "Matrix of Prescience" is active, then all ally targets who were struck by a killing blow during this action will not be <u>knocked down</u>, and <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP is immediately restored. This effect can trigger 1 time per battle.

eidolons.name: Apex Nexus
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Fortuna Stellaris
eidolons.description: When other allies under Matrix of Prescience are attacked, Fu Xuan regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Arbiter Primus
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Omnia Vita
eidolons.description: Once Matrix of Prescience is activated, it will keep a tally of the total HP lost by all team members in the current battle. The DMG dealt by Fu Xuan's Ultimate will increase by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of this tally of HP loss.\nThis tally is also capped at <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Fu Xuan's Max HP and the tally value will reset and re-accumulate after Fu Xuan's Ultimate is used.

name: Yanqing
description: General Jing Yuan's retainer. A gifted swordsman who hasn't even come of age.\nNo one can best Yanqing when he holds a sword in hand.

skills.name: Frost Thorn
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Darting Ironthorn
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy and activates "Soulsteel Sync" for 1 turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to one designated enemy and activates the "Soulsteel Sync."

skills.name: Amidst the Raining Bliss
skills.description: Increases Yanqing's CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When "Soulsteel Sync" is active, increases Yanqing's CRIT DMG by an extra <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This <u>buff</u> lasts for one turn. Afterwards, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yanqing's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases Yanqing's CRIT Rate. Enhances "Soulsteel Sync" and deals massive Ice DMG to one enemy.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: Can buff combat ability for a period of time, which can be dispelled unless otherwise specified.

skills.name: One With the Sword
skills.description: When "Soulsteel Sync" is active, Yanqing is less likely to be attacked by enemies. Yanqing's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> and his CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Yanqing attacks an enemy, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>fixed chance</u> to launch <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yanqing's ATK to the enemy, which has a <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn.\nThe Frozen target cannot take action and receives Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yanqing's ATK at the beginning of each turn.\nWhen Yanqing receives DMG, the "Soulsteel Sync" effect will disappear.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>During "Soulsteel Sync"</color>, reduces the chance of this character being attacked and <color=#f29e38ff>increases their CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG</color>. <color=#f29e38ff>After attacking an enemy</color>, there is a chance of launching a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG with a chance to Freeze the target.\n"Soulsteel Sync" will be removed after this character receives damage.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: The One True Sword
skills.description: After using his Technique, at the start of the next battle, Yanqing deals <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> more DMG for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s) to enemies whose current HP percentage is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or higher.
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses Technique, at the start of the next battle, increases the DMG dealt by this character to enemy targets whose HP percentage is <unbreak>50%</unbreak> or higher.

eidolons.name: Svelte Saber
eidolons.description: When Yanqing attacks a Frozen enemy, he deals Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of his ATK.

eidolons.name: Supine Serenade
eidolons.description: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Energy Regeneration Rate increases by an extra <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sword Savant
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Searing Sting
eidolons.description: When the current HP percentage is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or higher, this unit's Ice <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Surging Strife
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Swift Swoop
eidolons.description: If the <u>buff</u>s from "Soulsteel Sync" or the Ultimate are in effect when an enemy is defeated, the duration of these <u>buffs</u> is extended by 1 turn.

name: Guinaifen
description: A performance artist visiting the Xianzhou Luofu — in other words, a street performer.\nShe's chasing a new life on the Luofu when not concerned with food and shelter.

skills.name: Standing Ovation
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Guinaifen's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Blazing Welcome
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Guinaifen's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Guinaifen's ATK to any adjacent enemies, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Burn the target and adjacent targets. When Burned, enemies will take a Fire DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Guinaifen's ATK at the beginning of each turn, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to adjacent enemies, with a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>Burning</color> them.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Watch This Showstopper
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Guinaifen's ATK to all enemies. If the target enemy is currently inflicted with Burn, then their Burn status immediately produces DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of their original DMG.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to all enemies. If the enemies are inflicted with Burn, the Burn status deals DMG 1 extra time.

skills.name: PatrAeon Benefits
skills.description: When Guinaifen is on the field, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to apply Firekiss to an enemy after their Burn status causes DMG. While inflicted with Firekiss, the enemy receives <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG, which lasts for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and can stack up to <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After the <color=#f29e38ff>Burn status causes DMG</color> on the enemy, there is a high chance of applying <color=#f29e38ff>Firekiss</color> to the enemy.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Skill Showcase
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals DMG for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s), dealing Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Guinaifen's ATK to a random single enemy target each time, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting Firekiss on them.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy target with a high chance of applying <color=#f29e38ff>Firekiss</color>, with a total of 4 Bounces.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Slurping Noodles During Handstand
eidolons.description: When Skill is used, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce the attacked target enemy's Effect RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Brushing Teeth While Whistling
eidolons.description: When an enemy target is being Burned, the DMG multiplier of the Burn status applied by her Basic ATK or Skill increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Smashing Boulder on Chest
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Blocking Pike with Neck
eidolons.description: Every time the Burn status inflicted by Guinaifen causes DMG, Guinaifen regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Swallowing Sword to Stomach
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Catching Bullet with Hands
eidolons.description: Increases the stackable Firekiss count by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

name: Bailu
description: The High Elder of the Vidyadhara, who is also known as the "Healer Lady" on the Luofu.\nShe uses her unique medical science and the medical treatment that can only be provided by the Vidyadhara dragon race to save lives.

skills.name: Diagnostic Kick
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Bailu's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Singing Among Clouds
skills.description: Heals a single ally for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Bailu's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. Bailu then heals random allies <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s). After each healing, HP restored from the next healing is reduced by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores HP for a single ally, then heals random allies.

skills.name: Felicitous Thunderleap
skills.description: Heals all allies for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Bailu's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>.\nBailu applies Invigoration to allies that are not already Invigorated. For those already Invigorated, Bailu extends the duration of their Invigoration by 1 turn.\nThe effect of Invigoration can last for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect cannot stack.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores HP for all allies, and grants them Invigoration, or prolongs the duration of their Invigoration.

skills.name: Gourdful of Elixir
skills.description: After an ally target with Invigoration is hit, restores the ally's HP for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Bailu's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. This effect can trigger <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s).\nWhen Bailu's teammate receives a killing blow, they will not be <u>knocked down</u>. Bailu immediately heals the ally for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Bailu's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> HP. This effect can be triggered 1 time per battle.
skills.simpleDescription: When an ally target with <color=#f29e38ff>Invigoration</color> is attacked, <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color> for the ally.\nWhen a teammate suffers a <color=#f29e38ff>killing blow</color>, Bailu <color=#f29e38ff>immediately restores their HP</color>. This effect can only trigger 1 time per battle.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Saunter in the Rain
skills.description: After Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted Invigoration for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After this character uses Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted Invigoration.

eidolons.name: Ambrosial Aqua
eidolons.description: If the target ally's current HP is equal to their Max HP when Invigoration ends, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra Energy for this target.

eidolons.name: Sylphic Slumber
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate, Bailu's Outgoing Healing increases by an additional <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Omniscient Opulence
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Evil Excision
eidolons.description: Every healing provided by the Skill makes the recipient deal <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> more DMG for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Waning Worries
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Drooling Drop of Draconic Divinity
eidolons.description: Bailu can heal allies who received a killing blow <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> more time(s) in a single battle.
