name: Jingliu
description: Former Sword Champion of the Luofu, and the creator of the Cloud Knights' legends of undefeated might.\nNow, her name has been wiped from the records, and she is a traitor of the Xianzhou walking on the fine line between sanity and mara-struck.

skills.name: Lucent Moonglow
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Transcendent Flash
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to one designated enemy and obtains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Syzygy."
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to a target enemy and obtains <color=#f29e38ff>1 stack of Syzygy</color>.

skills.name: Florephemeral Dreamflux
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to any adjacent enemies. Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Syzygy" after attack ends.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Ice DMG to a target enemy and deals Ice DMG to adjacent targets. Obtains <color=#f29e38ff>1 stack of Syzygy</color>.

skills.name: Crescent Transmigration
skills.description: When Jingliu has <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Syzygy, she enters the Spectral Transmigration state with her action advanced by <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> and her CRIT Rate increased by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>. Then, Jingliu's Skill "Transcendent Flash" is enhanced to "Moon On Glacial River," and only this enhanced Skill is available for use in battle. When Jingliu uses an attack in the Spectral Transmigration state, she consumes HP from her teammates equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP (this cannot reduce teammates' HP to lower than 1). Jingliu's ATK increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the total HP consumed from all allies in this attack, capped at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of her base ATK, lasting until the current attack ends. Jingliu cannot enter the Spectral Transmigration state again until the current Spectral Transmigration state ends. Syzygy can stack up to 3 times. When Syzygy stacks become 0, Jingliu will exit the Spectral Transmigration state.
skills.simpleDescription: When possessing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> stacks of Syzygy, Jingliu enters the Spectral Transmigration state with her <color=#f29e38ff>action advanced by <unbreak>100%</unbreak></color>, her CRIT Rate increased, and her <color=#f29e38ff>Skill becoming enhanced</color>. Using an attack in this state consumes HP from her teammates and <color=#f29e38ff>increases Jingliu's ATK</color> according to the total HP consumed. When Syzygy stacks become 0, exits the Spectral Transmigration state.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Shine of Truth
skills.description: After using this Technique, creates a Special Dimension around Jingliu that lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> seconds, and all enemies in this Special Dimension will become Frozen. After entering combat with enemies in the Special Dimension, Jingliu immediately regenerates <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> Energy and obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Syzygy, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of Freezing enemy targets for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). While Frozen, enemy targets cannot take action, and receive Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of Jingliu's ATK at the start of every turn. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension around this unit. Enemies within this dimension will become <color=#f29e38ff>Frozen</color>. After entering combat with enemies in the dimension, this character regenerates Energy and gains 1 stack of "Syzygy" with a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>Freeze</color> enemies.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Moon On Glacial River
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jingliu's ATK to adjacent enemies. Consumes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Syzygy." Using this ability does not consume Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to one designated enemy target and Ice DMG to adjacent targets. Consumes 1 stack of "Syzygy."

eidolons.name: Moon Crashes Tianguan Gate
eidolons.description: When using her Ultimate or Enhanced Skill, Jingliu's CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). If only one enemy target is attacked, the target will additionally be dealt Ice DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Jingliu's ATK.

eidolons.name: Crescent Shadows Qixing Dipper
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate, increases the DMG of the next Enhanced Skill by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Halfmoon Gapes Mercurial Haze
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lunarlance Shines Skyward Dome
eidolons.description: During the Spectral Transmigration state, the ATK gained from consuming teammates' HP is additionally increased by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the total HP consumed from the entire team. The cap for ATK gained this way also increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Night Shades Astral Radiance
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Eclipse Hollows Corporeal Husk
eidolons.description: When Jingliu enters the Spectral Transmigration state, the Syzygy stack limit increases by 1, and Jingliu obtains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Syzygy. While she is in the Spectral Transmigration state, her CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae
description: Dan Heng's true form from his Vidyadhara lineage carries the residual power left behind by his past incarnation, the Imbibitor Lunae.\nUpon accepting the majestic horns atop his crown, he must accept all the merits and faults attributed to that sinner.

skills.name: Beneficent Lotus
skills.description: Uses a 2-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Dracore Libre
skills.description:
Enhances Basic ATK. Enhancements may be applied up to 3 times consecutively. Using this ability does not consume Skill Points and is not considered as using a Skill.
Enhanced once, Beneficent Lotus becomes Transcendence.
Enhanced twice, Beneficent Lotus becomes Divine Spear.
Enhanced thrice, Beneficent Lotus becomes Fulgurant Leap.
When using Divine Spear or Fulgurant Leap, starting from the fourth hit, 1 stack of Outroar is gained before every hit. Each stack of Outroar increases Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, for a max of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stacks. These stacks last until the end of his turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Enhances the Basic ATK Beneficent Lotus to <color=#f29e38ff>Transcendence</color>, <color=#f29e38ff>Divine Spear</color>, or <color=#f29e38ff>Fulgurant Leap</color>.

skills.name: Azure's Aqua Ablutes All
skills.description: Uses a 3-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. At the same time, deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets. Then, obtains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Squama Sacrosancta."\nIt's possible to hold up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> "Squama Sacrosancta," which can be used to offset Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's consumption of skill points. Consuming "Squama Sacrosancta" is considered equivalent to consuming skill points.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one enemy, deals Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets, and gains 2 "Squama Sacrosancta," which can <color=#f29e38ff>offset</color> Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's <color=#f29e38ff>consumption of skill points</color>. Consuming Squama Sacrosancta is considered equivalent to consuming skill points.

skills.name: Righteous Heart
skills.description: After each hit dealt during an attack, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae gains 1 stack of Righteous Heart, increasing his DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s), lasting until the end of his turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases DMG for every hit dealt. This effect is stackable and lasts until the end of this character's turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Heaven-Quelling Prismadrakon
skills.description: After using his Technique, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae enters the Leaping Dragon state for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> seconds. While in the Leaping Dragon state, using his attack enables him to move forward rapidly for a set distance, attacking all enemies he touches and blocking all incoming attacks. After entering combat via attacking enemies in the Leaping Dragon state, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae deals Imaginary DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of his ATK to all enemies, and gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Squama Sacrosancta.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the Leaping Dragon state. Attacking will cause this character to move forward rapidly for a set distance and attack all enemies touched. After entering combat via attacking enemies, deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies, and gains 1 Squama Sacrosancta.

skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description: Uses a 3-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Unleashes <color=#f29e38ff>3 hits</color> in this attack and deals Imaginary DMG to one enemy target.

skills.name: Cancel
skills.description: Cancel Enhancement

skills.name: Divine Spear
skills.description: Uses a 5-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. From the fourth hit onward, simultaneously deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Unleashes <color=#f29e38ff>5 hits</color> in this attack to deal massive Imaginary DMG to one enemy and minor Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets. For each of the last 2 hits, obtains 1 stack of "Outroar" just before the hit, increasing CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Fulgurant Leap
skills.description: Uses a 7-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. From the fourth hit onward, simultaneously deal Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Unleashes <color=#f29e38ff>7 hits</color> in this attack to deal massive Imaginary DMG to one enemy and Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets. For each of the last 4 hits, obtains 1 stack of "Outroar" just before the hit, increasing CRIT DMG.

eidolons.name: Tethered to Sky
eidolons.description: Increases the stackable Righteous Heart count by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, and gains 1 extra stack of Righteous Heart for each hit during an attack.

eidolons.name: Imperium On Cloud Nine
eidolons.description: After using his Ultimate, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak> and gains 1 extra "Squama Sacrosancta."

eidolons.name: Clothed in Clouds
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Zephyr's Bliss
eidolons.description: The <u>buff</u> effect granted by "Outroar" lasts until the end of this unit's next turn.

eidolons.name: Fall is the Pride
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Reign, Returned
eidolons.description: After another ally character uses their Ultimate, the Imaginary <u>RES PEN</u> of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's next "Fulgurant Leap" attack increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

name: Xueyi
description: Judge of the Ten-Lords Commission, which presides over the jurisdiction of life and death on the Luofu.\nFor years after her death, she inhabited a puppet body and returned to the world to fulfill her mission.

skills.name: Mara-Sunder Awl
skills.description: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Xueyi's ATK as Quantum DMG to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Iniquity Obliteration
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Xueyi's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Xueyi's ATK to any adjacent enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to one enemy and minor Quantum DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Divine Castigation
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Xueyi's ATK to one designated enemy target. This attack ignores Weakness Types and reduces the enemy's Toughness. When the enemy's Weakness is Broken, the Quantum Weakness Break effect is triggered.\nIn this attack, the more Toughness is reduced, the higher the DMG will be dealt, up to a max of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> increase.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Quantum DMG to one enemy. This attack <color=#f29e38ff>ignores Weakness Types</color> and reduces the target's Toughness. The more Toughness is reduced, the higher the DMG will be dealt.

skills.name: Karmic Perpetuation
skills.description: When Xueyi reduces enemy Toughness with attacks, "Karma" will be stacked. The more Toughness is reduced, the more stacks of "Karma" are added, up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stacks.\nWhen Xueyi's teammates reduce enemy Toughness with attacks, Xueyi gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Karma."\nWhen "Karma" reaches the max number of stacks, consumes all current "Karma" stacks and immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against an enemy target, dealing DMG for 3 times, with each time dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Xueyi's ATK to a single random enemy. This Follow-Up ATK will not add "Karma" stacks.
skills.simpleDescription: When Xueyi or her teammates reduce enemy Toughness with attacks, she gains stacks of "Karma." When "Karma" reaches the max number of stacks, <color=#f29e38ff>immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, dealing minor Quantum DMG to one enemy target, bouncing for 3 times and consuming all "Karma."

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Summary Execution
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Xueyi's ATK as Quantum DMG to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Dvesha, Inhibited
eidolons.description: Increases the DMG dealt by the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Klesha, Breached
eidolons.description: Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> Reduces enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness types. At the same time, restores Xueyi's HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of her Max HP. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Quantum Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Duḥkha, Ceased
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Karma, Severed
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, increases Break Effect by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Deva, Enthralled
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Saṃsāra, Mastered
eidolons.description: The max stack limit for Karma decreases to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

name: Hanya
description: One of the judges of the Xianzhou Luofu's Ten-Lords Commission.\nOrdained by the Ten-Lords and wielding the authority of the Oracle Brush, she reads the multitudes of human sins and transgressions, then issues punishments and karmic retribution.

skills.name: Oracle Brush
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Samsara, Locked
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hanya's ATK to one designated enemy target, then applies "Burden" to them.\nFor every 2 Basic ATKs, Skills, or Ultimates allies use on an enemy with "Burden," allies will immediately recover 1 Skill Point. "Burden" is only active on the latest target it is applied to, and will be dispelled automatically after the Skill Point recovery effect has been triggered <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> times.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy and applies "Burden" to them. For every 2 Basic ATKs, Skills, or Ultimates allies use on an enemy with Burden, allies <color=#f29e38ff>recover 1 Skill Point</color>.

skills.name: Ten-Lords' Decree, All Shall Obey
skills.description: Increases the SPD of a target ally by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hanya's SPD and increases the same target ally's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Increases an ally's <color=#f29e38ff>SPD and ATK</color>.

skills.name: Sanction
skills.description: When an ally uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate on an enemy inflicted with Burden, the DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When an ally target uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate on an enemy target inflicted with "Burden," the DMG dealt increases.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Netherworld Judgment
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, applies Burden equivalent to that applied by the Skill to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, applies Burden equivalent to that applied by the Skill to a random enemy.

eidolons.name: One Heart
eidolons.description: When an ally target with Hanya's Ultimate effect defeats an enemy, Hanya's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can only be triggered <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn.

eidolons.name: Two Views
eidolons.description: After using the Skill, this character's SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Three Temptations
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Four Truths
eidolons.description: The Ultimate's duration is additionally extended for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Five Skandhas
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Six Reverences
eidolons.description: Increase the DMG Boost effect of the Talent by an additional <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Huohuo
description: A trainee Ten-Lords Commission Judge of the Xianzhou Luofu, she is a young foxian girl possessed by a heliobus.\nShe is a timid and weak girl who is afraid of all kinds of strange things, but is responsible for luring and subduing evil spirits.

skills.name: Banner: Stormcaller
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Huohuo's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Talisman: Protection
skills.description: Dispels <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from one designated ally and immediately restores this ally's HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Huohuo's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>. At the same time, restores HP for allies that are adjacent to this target ally by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Huohuo's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Dispels 1 <u>debuff</u> from one ally and <color=#f29e38ff>restore HP</color> to that ally and their adjacent allies.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Tail: <unbreak>Spiritual Domination</unbreak>
skills.description: Regenerates Energy for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of their respective Max Energy. At the same time, increases their ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Regenerates Energy</color> for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) and <color=#f29e38ff>increases their ATK</color>.

skills.name: Possession: Ethereal Metaflow
skills.description: After using her Skill, Huohuo gains Divine Provision, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 turn at the start of Huohuo's every turn. If Huohuo has Divine Provision when an ally's turn starts or when an ally uses their Ultimate, restores HP for that ally by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Huohuo's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>. At the same time, every ally with <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> HP percentage or lower receives healing once.\nWhen Divine Provision is triggered to heal an ally, dispel <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from that ally. This effect can be triggered up to <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak> time(s). Using the skill again resets the effect's trigger count.
skills.simpleDescription: Huohuo gains Divine Provision after using her Skill. If Huohuo possesses Divine Provision when an ally's turn starts or when an ally uses Ultimate, <color=#f29e38ff>restores the ally's HP</color>. At the same time, <color=#f29e38ff>every ally</color> with low HP <color=#f29e38ff>receives healing once</color>. When Divine Provision is triggered to heal an ally, <color=#f29e38ff>dispel 1 <u>debuff</u> from that ally</color>.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Fiend: Impeachment of Evil
skills.description: Huohuo terrorizes surrounding enemies, afflicting Horror-Struck on them. Enemies in Horror-Struck will flee away from Huohuo for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> second(s). When entering battle with enemies in Horror-Struck, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of reducing every single enemy's ATK by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Causes surrounding enemies to become Horror-Struck. After entering battle with enemies afflicted with Horror-Struck, there is a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>reducing the ATK</color> of the enemy targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Anchored to Vessel, Specters Nestled
eidolons.description: The duration of Divine Provision produced by the Talent is extended by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). When Huohuo possesses Divine Provision, all allies' SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sealed in Tail, Wraith Subdued
eidolons.description: If Huohuo possesses "Divine Provision" when an ally target is struck by a killing blow, the ally will not be <u>knocked down</u> and their HP will immediately be restored by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP. This reduces the duration of "Divine Provision" by 1 turn. This effect can only be triggered <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) per battle.

eidolons.name: Cursed by Fate, Moths to Flame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Tied in Life, Bound to Strife
eidolons.description: When healing a target ally via Skill or Talent, the less HP the target ally currently has, the higher the amount of healing they will receive. The maximum increase in healing provided by Huohuo is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Mandated by Edict, Evils Evicted
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Woven Together, Cohere Forever

name: Jiaoqiu
description: A foxian healer and counselor from the Xianzhou Yaoqing. Often greets people with a smile on his face and a scheme in his heart.\nBorn into a prestigious Alchemy Commission family, he once withdrew from practicing medicine due to a broken heart. However, he returned to the field to treat "the Merlin's Claw," General Feixiao.\nSkilled in the study of alchemical prescription that views food as medicine, especially those that induce a sensation of spiciness. He invented a cauldron-based medicinal formula known as the "nine-squared grid."

skills.name: Heart Afire
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jiaoqiu's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Scorch Onslaught
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jiaoqiu's ATK to one designated enemy target and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jiaoqiu's ATK to adjacent targets, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on the primary target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to adjacent targets, with a high chance to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on the primary target.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Pyrograph Arcanum
skills.description: Sets the number of "Ashen Roast" stacks on enemy targets to the highest number of "Ashen Roast" stacks present on the battlefield. Then, activates a Zone and deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jiaoqiu's ATK to all enemies.\nWhile inside the Zone, enemy targets receive <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> increased Ultimate DMG, with a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> of being inflicted with 1 stack of Ashen Roast when taking action. While the Zone exists, this effect can trigger up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s). And for each enemy target, it can only trigger once per turn. This trigger count resets every time Jiaoqiu uses Ultimate.\nThe Zone lasts for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. If Jiaoqiu gets <u>knocked down</u>, the Zone will also be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: Sets the number of "Ashen Roast" stacks on enemy targets to the highest number of "Ashen Roast" stacks present on the battlefield. Then, activates a Zone and deals Fire DMG to all enemies. While inside the Zone, enemy targets <color=#f29e38ff>receive increased Ultimate DMG</color>, with a chance of being inflicted with 1 stack of Ashen Roast when taking action.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Quartet Finesse, Octave Finery
skills.description: When Jiaoqiu hits an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill or Ultimate, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict 1 stack of Ashen Roast on them. At 1 stack, increases DMG received by the enemy by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Then, each subsequent stack increases this by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nAshen Roast is capped at <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> stack(s) and lasts for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhen an enemy target is afflicted with Ashen Roast, they are also considered as being Burned at the same time, taking Fire DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jiaoqiu's ATK at the start of each turn.
skills.simpleDescription: When attacking with Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, there is a high chance to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on the target, causing the enemy to take increased DMG and also be considered as Burned at the same time.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Fiery Queller
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> second(s). After entering combat with enemies in this Special Dimension, deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Jiaoqiu's ATK to all enemies, with a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of applying 1 "Ashen Roast" stack. Only 1 dimension created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. After entering combat with enemies in this dimension, deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies, with a high chance of applying 1 "Ashen Roast" stack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Pentapathic Transference
eidolons.description: Allies deal <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> increased DMG to enemy targets afflicted with Ashen Roast. Whenever inflicting Ashen Roast on an enemy target via triggering the Talent's effect, additionally increases the number of "Ashen Roast" stacks applied this time by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: From Savor Comes Suffer
eidolons.description: When an enemy target is afflicted with Ashen Roast, increases the multiplier for the Fire DoT dealt by Ashen Roast to this target by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Flavored Euphony Reigns Supreme
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Leisure In, Luster Out
eidolons.description: When the Zone exists, reduces enemy target's ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Duel in Dawn, Dash in Dusk
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Nonamorphic Pyrobind
eidolons.description: When an enemy target gets defeated, their accumulated "Ashen Roast" stacks will transfer to the enemy with the lowest number of "Ashen Roast" stacks on the battlefield. The maximum stack limit of Ashen Roast increases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>, and each "Ashen Roast" stack reduces the target's All-Type RES by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Feixiao
description: The Xianzhou Yaoqing's Merlin's Claw and one of the Seven Arbiter-Generals. Unconventional and straightforward, she exudes effortless charm.\nShe is skilled in all forms of martial arts and has honed herself into a supreme weapon. She is widely adored by Xianzhou soldiers and civilians alike as "The Vanquishing General."\nHowever, she bears the burden of the Moon Rage affliction. If she were to hunt down all the abominations in her limited lifetime — then the only enemy Feixiao has would be herself.

skills.name: Boltsunder
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Waraxe
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK to one designated enemy target. Then, immediately launches 1 extra instance of Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Wind DMG to an enemy, and additionally launches Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> 1 time.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Terrasplit
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated enemy target, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK. During this time, can ignore Weakness Type to reduce the target's Toughness. When the target is not <u>Weakness Broken</u>, Feixiao's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.\nDuring the attack, Feixiao first launches "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward" on the target, for a total of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s). At the end, deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK to the target.
skills.simpleDescription: During the Ultimate, can <color=#f29e38ff>ignore Weakness Type</color> to reduce enemy Toughness. When the target is not Weakness Broken, Feixiao's <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Break Efficiency increases</color>.\nLaunches "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward" on one enemy <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). Deals Wind DMG at the end.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

skills.name: Thunderhunt
skills.description: Can activate Ultimate when "Flying Aureus" reaches <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points, accumulating up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> points. Feixiao gains 1 point of "Flying Aureus" for every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> attacks by ally targets. Feixiao's Ultimate attacks do not count towards this number.\nAfter Feixiao's teammates attack an Enemy target, Feixiao immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the primary target, dealing Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK. If there is no primary target available to attack, Feixiao attacks a single random enemy instead. This effect can only trigger once per turn and the trigger count resets at the start of Feixiao's turn. When using this attack, increases DMG dealt by this unit by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Can activate Ultimate when "Flying Aureus" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> points, accumulating up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> points. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> attacks by ally targets, Feixiao gains <color=#f29e38ff>"Flying Aureus"</color>.\nAfter teammates attack, Feixiao launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> against the primary target, dealing Wind DMG. This effect can only trigger once per turn. When using this attack, increases <color=#f29e38ff>DMG dealt by this unit</color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Stormborn
skills.description: After using Technique, enters the "Onrush" state, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. While in "Onrush," pulls in enemies within a certain range, and increases this unit's movement speed by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. After entering battle, gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Flying Aureus."\nWhile in "Onrush," actively attacking will start battle with all pulled enemies. After entering battle, deals Wind DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Feixiao's ATK to all enemies at the start of each wave. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT. If more than 1 enemy is pulled in, increases the multiplier of this DMG by <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> for each additional enemy pulled in, up to a maximum of <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Onrush" state. Continuously pulls in enemies and increases movement speed. Gains "Flying Aureus" after entering battle.\nWhile in "Onrush," can actively attack all pulled enemies. At the start of every wave, deals Wind DMG to all enemies. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT. <color=#f29e38ff>The more enemies are pulled in, the higher the DMG multiplier becomes</color>.

skills.name: Boltsunder Blitz
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK to the chosen target. If the target is <u>Weakness Broken</u>, the DMG multiplier increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy and increases the DMG multiplier against targets that are <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State

skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Feixiao's ATK to the chosen target. If the target is not <u>Weakness Broken</u>, the DMG multiplier increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy and increases the DMG multiplier against targets that are <color=#f29e38ff>not Weakness Broken</color>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State

eidolons.name: Skyward I Quell
eidolons.description: After launching "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward," additionally increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Feixiao by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) and lasting until the end of the Ultimate action.

eidolons.name: Moonward I Wish
eidolons.description: In the Talent's effect, for every 1 instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> launched by ally targets, Feixiao gains 1 point of "Flying Aureus." This effect can trigger up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn.

eidolons.name: Starward I Bode
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Stormward I Hear
eidolons.description: The Toughness Reduction from the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and, when launched, increases this unit's SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Heavenward I Leap
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Homeward I Near
eidolons.description: Increases the All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> of Ultimate DMG dealt by Feixiao by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG is considered as Ultimate DMG at the same time, and its DMG multiplier increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Yunli
description: A sword hunter from the Xianzhou Zhuming and "the Flaming Heart" General Huaiyan's darling granddaughter. Frank and straightforward.\nShe has learned swordplay and forging from Huaiyan since she was young, and thus is the second-youngest prodigy swordmaster of the Flamewheel Octet.\nFueled by an intense loathing for the cursed swords that emerged from the Zhuming, she vowed to "hunt down and wipe out all cursed swords."

skills.name: Galespin Summersault
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Bladeborne Quake
skills.description: Restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to one designated enemy target and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores this unit's HP. Deals Physical DMG to one enemy and minor Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Earthbind, Etherbreak
skills.description:
Consumes <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> Energy. Yunli gains Parry and Taunts all enemies, lasting until the end of the next ally's or enemy's turn. Increases the CRIT DMG dealt by Yunli's next Counter by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. When triggering the Counter effect from Talent, launches the <u>Counter</u> "Intuit: Cull" instead and removes the Parry effect. If no Counter is triggered while Parry is active, Yunli will immediately launch the <u>Counter</u> "Intuit: Slash" on a random enemy target.

"Intuit: Slash": Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to the target, and deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets.
"Intuit: Cull": Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to the target, and deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets. Then, additionally deals <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> instances of DMG, each dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to a random single enemy.

When Yunli deals DMG via this ability, it's considered as dealing Ultimate DMG.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters "Parry" and taunts all enemies. When attacked during this period, triggers <color=#f29e38ff>powerful <u>Counter</u></color> and <color=#f29e38ff>deals Physical DMG</color> to the attacker and adjacent targets. Then, deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy that bounces 6 times. If no Counter is triggered while "Parry" is active, deals Physical DMG to a random enemy target and adjacent targets when "Parry" ends.

10000003.name: Counter
10000003.desc: An effect that automatically triggers when the target is attacked, which unleashes an extra attack on the attacker.\nCounter is also considered a Follow-Up ATK.

skills.name: Flashforge
skills.description: When Yunli gets attacked by an enemy target, additionally regenerates <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy and immediately launches a <u>Counter</u> on the attacker, dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to the attacker and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets.\nIf there is no immediate target to Counter, then Counters a random enemy target instead.
skills.simpleDescription: When Yunli is attacked by any enemy target, additionally regenerates Energy and immediately <u>Counters</u>, dealing Physical DMG to the attacker and minor Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

10000003.name: Counter
10000003.desc: An effect that automatically triggers when the target is attacked, which unleashes an extra attack on the attacker.\nCounter is also considered a Follow-Up ATK.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Posterior Precedence
skills.description: This unit gains the Ward effect, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> seconds. During this time, upon entering combat by either attacking enemies or receiving an attack, immediately casts "Intuit: Cull" on a random enemy, and increases the DMG dealt by this attack by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: This unit gains the Ward effect, lasting for <unbreak>20</unbreak> seconds. During this time, upon entering combat by either attacking enemies or receiving an attack, immediately casts "Intuit: Cull" on a random enemy.

eidolons.name: Weathered Blade Does Not Sully
eidolons.description: Increases DMG dealt by "Intuit: Slash" and "Intuit: Cull" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Increases the number of additional DMG instances for "Intuit: Cull" by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: First Luster Breaks Dawn
eidolons.description: When dealing DMG via <u>Counter</u>, ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Mastlength Twirls Mountweight
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Artisan's Ironsong
eidolons.description: After launching "Intuit: Slash" or "Intuit: Cull," increases this unit's Effect RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Blade of Old Outlasts All
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Walk in Blade, Talk in Zither
eidolons.description: While "Parry" is active, if an enemy actively uses their abilities, regardless of whether it attacks Yunli or not, it will trigger "Intuit: Cull" and remove the "Parry" effect. When dealing DMG via "Intuit: Slash" or "Intuit: Cull," increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and Physical <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Lingsha
description: The new Cauldron Master of the Xianzhou Luofu's Alchemy Commission is one perceptive and intelligent Vidyadhara healer.\nWith a keen sense of smell, she diagnoses ailments and calms minds with aromatic therapy.\nAdept at navigating complex social relationships, she can remain impeccably composed even when turmoil rages within.

skills.name: Votive Incense
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Smoke and Splendor
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies and at the same time, restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies. Fuyuan's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies and, at the same time, <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color> for all allies. Fuyuan's <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Dripping Mistscape
skills.description: Inflicts "Befog" on all enemies. While in "Befog," targets receive <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> increased <u>Break DMG</u>, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nDeals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies, and at the same time restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies. Fuyuan's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases <color=#f29e38ff>Break DMG taken</color> by all enemies, deals Fire DMG to all enemies, and at the same time, <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color> for all allies. Fuyuan's <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000014.name: Break DMG
10000014.desc: Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher target max Toughness, and higher character levels.\nBreak DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Mistdance Manifest
skills.description:
When using Skill, summons "Fuyuan," with an initial SPD of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> and an initial action count of <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak>.
When taking action, "Fuyuan" launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK to one random enemy, and this DMG prioritizes targets that have both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from all allies and restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Lingsha's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>.
"Fuyuan's" action count can accumulate up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>. When the action count reaches 0 or when Lingsha is <u>knocked down</u>, "Fuyuan" disappears.
While "Fuyuan" is on the field, using Skill can increase "Fuyuan's" action count by <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Using Skill summons "Fuyuan": When taking action, launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> and deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Fire DMG to one random enemy, prioritizing targets with both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels 1 <u>debuff</u> from all allies, and <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color>.\nUsing Skill repeatedly will increase "Fuyuan's" action count.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Wisps of Aurora
skills.description: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and inflicts "Befog" on all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and increases <color=#f29e38ff>Break DMG taken</color> by all enemies.

eidolons.name: Bloom on Vileward Bouquet
eidolons.description: Lingsha's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. When an enemy unit's Weakness is Broken, reduces their DEF by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Leisure in Carmine Smokeveil
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, increases all allies' Break Effect by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Shine of Floral Wick
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Redolence from Canopied Banquet
eidolons.description: When Fuyuan takes action, restores HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Lingsha's ATK for the ally target whose current HP is the lowest.

eidolons.name: Poise Atop Twists and Turns
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Arcadia Under Deep Seclusion
eidolons.description: While "Fuyuan" is on the field, reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When "Fuyuan" attacks, additionally deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Lingsha's ATK and <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Toughness Reduction to one random enemy. This prioritizes targets with both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness.

name: Moze
description: A Shadow Guard of the Yaoqing, Moze is taciturn and solitary, always acting on his own.\nAs an expert in intelligence services and other operations that must remain covert, Moze rarely shows himself before others. The moment he reveals his blade usually spells doom for his enemies.\nHe commands a vast wealth of assassination techniques, coupled with an extraordinary obsession for orderliness and cleanliness.

skills.name: Hurlthorn
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Moze's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Fleetwinged Raid
skills.description: Marks a designated single enemy target as "Prey" and deals to it Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Moze's ATK, and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> points of Charge.\nWhen there are no other characters on the field that are capable of combat, Moze cannot use his Skill and dispels the enemy's "Prey" state.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Marks one enemy as "Prey"</color> and deals Lightning DMG to it. Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points of Charge.

skills.name: <unbreak>Dash In,</unbreak> <unbreak>Gash Out</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Moze's ATK to one designated enemy target, and launches the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against this target. If the target is defeated before this <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is used, then launches the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against a random single enemy instead.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy, and launches Talent's <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Cascading Featherblade
skills.description: When "Prey" exists on the field, Moze will enter the <u>Departed</u> state.\nAfter ally targets attack "Prey," Moze will additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK and consumes 1 point of Charge. For every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge consumed, Moze launches 1 <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> to "Prey," dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of his ATK. When Charge reaches 0, dispels the target's "Prey" state and resets the tally of Charge points required to launch <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>. Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not consume Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: When "Prey" exists on the field, Moze will enter the <color=#f29e38ff><u>Departed</u></color> state.\nAfter allies attack "Prey," Moze deals Lightning <color=#f29e38ff><u>Additional DMG</u></color> and consumes 1 Charge point. For every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Charge consumed, Moze launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> on "Prey," dealing Lightning DMG. When Charge is 0, dispels the target's "Prey" state.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

10000016.name: Departed
10000016.desc: Targets in the Departed state cannot be designated as ability targets and will not appear in the Action Order.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Bated Wings
skills.description: After using Technique, enters the Stealth state for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). While in Stealth, Moze is undetectable by enemies. If Moze attacks enemies to enter combat while in Stealth, increases DMG by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the Stealth state. Attacking enemies to enter combat while in Stealth increases DMG.

eidolons.name: Oathkeeper
eidolons.description: After entering battle, Moze regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy. Each time the <u>Additional DMG</u> from his Talent is triggered, Moze regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Wrathbearer
eidolons.description: When all allies deal DMG to the enemy target marked as "Prey," increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Deathchaser
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Heathprowler
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Moze by <unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Truthbender
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Faithbinder
eidolons.description: Increases the DMG multiplier of the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: March 7th
description: March 7th in a Xianzhou-styled outfit. A sword-wielding female martial artist.\nLearning swordplay from both Yunli and Yanqing, she is eager to create more beautiful memories on the Xianzhou.

skills.name: My Sword Zaps Demons
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy and gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Charge.

skills.name: Master, It's Tea Time!
skills.description:
Designates one ally (excluding this unit) as "Shifu" and increases "Shifu"'s SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Only the most recent target of March 7th's Skill is considered as "Shifu."
Whenever using Basic ATK or dealing 1 hit of Enhanced Basic ATK's DMG, triggers the corresponding effect if "Shifu" with the specified Path is present on the field:
Erudition, Destruction, The Hunt, Remembrance, Elation: Deals <u>Additional DMG</u> (DMG Type based on "Shifu"'s Combat Type) equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK.
Harmony, Nihility, Preservation, Abundance: Increases the Toughness Reduction of this instance of DMG by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Makes a single ally become "Shifu." When using Basic ATK or dealing Enhanced Basic ATK's DMG, triggers the corresponding effect based on <color=#f29e38ff>the "Shifu"'s Path</color>:\nErudition, Destruction, The Hunt, Remembrance, Elation: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>Additional DMG</u></color> based on Shifu's Type.\nHarmony, Nihility, Preservation, Abundance: <color=#f29e38ff>Toughness Reduction</color> increases.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: <unbreak>March 7th,</unbreak> <unbreak>the Apex Heroine</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target.\nIncreases the initial Hits Per Action of the next Enhanced Basic ATK by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> hit(s) and increase the <u>fixed chance </u>of additionally dealing DMG by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to one enemy and <color=#f29e38ff>increases</color> the Hits Per Action and DMG chance of <color=#f29e38ff>the next Enhanced Basic ATK</color>.

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

skills.name: Master, I've Ascended!
skills.description: After Shifu uses an attack or Ultimate, March 7th gains up to 1 point of Charge each time.\nUpon reaching <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more points of Charge, March 7th immediately takes action and increases the DMG she deals by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Her Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and her Skill cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge. Charge is capped at <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points.
skills.simpleDescription: After <color=#f29e38ff>Shifu uses an attack or Ultimate</color>, March 7th gains Charge. When reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> points of Charge, March 7th immediately takes action and increases the DMG she deals. <color=#f29e38ff>Basic ATK gets Enhanced</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Feast in One Go
skills.description: If March 7th is on the team, she gains 1 point of Charge at the start of the next battle whenever a teammate uses Technique, up to a max of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s).\nAfter using Technique, March 7th regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy when the next battle starts.
skills.simpleDescription: Whenever a teammate uses Technique, March 7th gains Charge upon entering the next battle. Using Technique regenerates Energy upon entering the next battle.

skills.name: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten
skills.description: Initially, deals <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> hits, each causing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target. When dealing the final hit, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to deal 1 additional hit of DMG, up to a max of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> additional hit(s). Energy regenerated from using Enhanced Basic ATK does not increase with the number of hits.\nEnhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to one enemy, dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> hits initially. <color=#f29e38ff>There is a chance to additionally deal up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> hit(s)</color>.

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

eidolons.name: My Sword Stirs Starlight
eidolons.description: When Shifu is on the field, increases March 7th's SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Blade Dances on Waves' Fight
eidolons.description: After "Shifu" uses Basic ATK or Skill to attack an enemy target, March 7th immediately launches a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of March 7th's ATK to the primary target of this attack. Additionally, triggers the corresponding effect based on "Shifu"'s Path and then gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge. If there is no primary target available to attack, then she attacks a single random enemy instead. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

name: Fugue
description: A tactful foxian girl, whose appearance, name, and identity have all been stolen.\nThe fates have left her a thread of chance at survival, yet the brand of Destruction still writhes with anticipation.\nThe one in a fugue who has experienced life and death and is given a new life... when would she be able to return home?

skills.name: Radiant Streak
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Virtue Beckons Bliss
skills.description: Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer". Enters the "Torrid Scorch" state, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. "Foxian Prayer" only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.\nThe ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and can also reduce Toughness even when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type, with the effect equivalent to <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> of the original Toughness Reduction value. This cannot stack with other Toughness Reduction effects that also ignore Weakness Type.\nWhile in the "Torrid Scorch" state, Fugue enhances her Basic ATK. Every time an ally target with "Foxian Prayer" attacks, Fugue has a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Grants one ally "Foxian Prayer", which <color=#f29e38ff>increases Break Effect</color>, and <color=#f29e38ff>enables to reduce Toughness when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type</color>.\nMakes this unit enter the "Torrid Scorch" state, enhancing Basic ATK. When ally units with "Foxian Prayer" attack, Fugue has a high chance to reduce the enemy target's DEF.

skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fugue's ATK to all enemies. This attack ignores Weakness Type to reduce all enemies' Toughness. And when breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to all enemies. This attack <color=#f29e38ff>ignores Weakness Type</color> to reduce all enemies' Toughness.

skills.name: Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads
skills.description: While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster," equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of their Max Toughness. When the initial Toughness is reduced to 0, "Cloudflame Luster" can continue to be reduced. When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will receive Weakness Break DMG again.\nWhile Fugue is on the field and after allies attack <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy targets, converts the Toughness Reduction of this attack into 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get <color=#f29e38ff>additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster."</color> When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will <color=#f29e38ff>take Weakness Break DMG again</color>. After allies attack <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy targets, additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>Super Break DMG</u></color>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Daze on enemies within a certain area. After entering battle via attacking Dazed enemies, Fugue's <u>action advances</u>, with a high chance to inflict each enemy target with the same DEF Reduction state as that applied by Fugue's Skill.

skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Fugue's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to adjacent targets.

name: Gallagher
description: A security officer of the Bloodhound Family at Penacony. He is always courteous toward visiting guests but keeps his vigilance about him. He seems to carry a weight of a complicated past, yet he never voluntarily divulges any details.

skills.name: Corkage Fee
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Special Brew
skills.description: Immediately heals a target ally for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> HP.
skills.simpleDescription: Immediately restores an ally's HP.

skills.name: Champagne Etiquette
skills.description: Inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies, and enhances his next Basic ATK to Nectar Blitz.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Inflicts Besotted</color> on all enemies and deals Fire DMG to them at the same time. Enhances the next Basic ATK to Nectar Blitz.

skills.name: Tipsy Tussle
skills.description: The Besotted state makes targets receive <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> more <u>Break DMG</u>. Every time a Besotted target gets attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is restored by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: The Besotted state <color=#f29e38ff>makes targets receive more <u>Break DMG</u></color>. Every time the target gets attacked by an ally character, <color=#f29e38ff>the attacker's HP is restored</color>.

10000014.name: Break DMG
10000014.desc: Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher target max Toughness, and higher character levels.\nBreak DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Artisan Elixir
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). And deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, <color=#f29e38ff>inflicts Besotted</color> to all enemies and deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Nectar Blitz
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target. Reduces the target's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and reduces ATK.

eidolons.name: Salty Dog
eidolons.description: When entering the battle, Gallagher regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy and increases Effect RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lion's Tail
eidolons.description: When using the Skill, dispels <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from the designated ally. At the same time, increases their Effect RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Corpse Reviver
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Last Word
eidolons.description: Extends the duration of the Besotted state inflicted by Gallagher's Ultimate by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Death in the Afternoon
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Blood and Sand
eidolons.description: Increases Gallagher's Break Effect by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Argenti
description: A paragon knight of the Knights of Beauty who is piously seeking his missing Aeon, Idrila the Beauty.\nForthright and candid, he wanders the cosmos espousing the virtues of Idrila's good name.

skills.name: Fleeting Fragrance
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Argenti's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Justice, Hereby Blooms
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: For In This Garden, Supreme Beauty Bestows
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Argenti's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Energy and deals Physical DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Sublime Object
skills.description: For every enemy hit when Argenti uses his Basic Attack, Skill, or Ultimate, regenerates Argenti's Energy by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, and grants him a stack of Apotheosis, increasing his CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When Argenti uses his Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, he <color=#f29e38ff>regenerates Energy</color> and increases his <color=#f29e38ff>CRIT Rate</color> for every enemy target hit.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Manifesto of Purest Virtue
skills.description: After using the Technique, enemies in a set area are inflicted with Daze for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack the team.\nWhen attacking a Dazed enemy to enter combat, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Argenti's ATK and regenerates his Energy by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Daze on all enemies within a set area. When attacking a Dazed enemy to enter combat, deals minor Physical DMG to all enemies and regenerates energy for Argenti.

skills.name: Merit Bestowed in "My" Garden
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy and deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Argenti's ATK to all enemies. And further deals DMG for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> extra time(s), with each time dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Argenti's ATK to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> Energy and deals Physical DMG to all enemies and additionally deals minor Physical DMG to random single enemy targets for 6 Bounces.

eidolons.name: A Lacuna in Kingdom of Aesthetics
eidolons.description: Each stack of Apotheosis additionally increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Agate's Humility
eidolons.description: If the number of enemies on the field equals to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more when the Ultimate is used, ATK increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Trumpet's Dedication
eidolons.description: At the start of battle, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Apotheosis and increases the maximum stack limit of the Talent's effect by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Snow, From Somewhere in Cosmos
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of enemy targets' DEF.
