name: Ruan Mei
description: A member of the Genius Society and an expert in life sciences. She teamed up with Herta and others to develop the Simulated Universe.

skills.name: Threading Fragrance
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ruan Mei's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: String Sings Slow Swirls
skills.description: After using her Skill, Ruan Mei gains Overtone, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Ruan Mei's every turn. When Ruan Mei has Overtone, all allies' DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> and Weakness Break Efficiency increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: After using her Skill, Ruan Mei gains Overtone. When Ruan Mei has Overtone, increase all allies' <color=#f29e38ff>DMG</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Break Efficiency</color>.

skills.name: Petals to Stream, Repose in Dream
skills.description:
Ruan Mei deploys a Zone that lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of her turn.
While inside the Zone, all allies' All-Type RES PEN increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> and their attacks apply Thanatoplum Rebloom to the enemies hit.
When these enemies attempt to recover from <u>Weakness Break</u>, Thanatoplum Rebloom is triggered, extending the duration of their <u>Weakness Break</u>, <u>delaying their action</u> by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Ruan Mei's Break Effect plus <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>, and dealing Break DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ruan Mei's Ice <u>Break DMG</u>.
Enemy targets cannot have Thanatoplum Rebloom re-applied to them until they recover from <u>Weakness Break</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases <color=#f29e38ff>All-Type RES PEN</color> for all allies, and their attacks apply Thanatoplum Rebloom to enemies hit.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000014.name: Break DMG
10000014.desc: Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher target max Toughness, and higher character levels.\nBreak DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Somatotypical Helix
skills.description: Increases SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit). When allies Break an enemy target's Weakness, Ruan Mei deals to this enemy target Break DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of her Ice <u>Break DMG</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases <color=#f29e38ff>SPD</color> for all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit). Breaking an enemy target's Weakness will <color=#f29e38ff>additionally deal Ice Break DMG</color>.

10000014.name: Break DMG
10000014.desc: Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher target max Toughness, and higher character levels.\nBreak DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Silken Serenade
skills.description: After using the Technique, gains Silken Serenade. At the start of the next battle, automatically triggers the Skill for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s) without consuming Skill Points.\nIn Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, when Ruan Mei has Silken Serenade, the team actively attacking enemies will always be regarded as attacking their Weakness to enter combat, and this attack can reduce all enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness types. When breaking Weakness, triggers Weakness Break Effect corresponding to the attacker's Type. For every Blessing in possession (up to a max of <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Blessings will be taken into account), additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of this attack by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. After breaking an enemy target's Weakness, additionally deals to the enemy target Break DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Ruan Mei's Ice Break DMG.
skills.simpleDescription: The next time entering battle, automatically triggers the Skill for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). After using the Technique, allies attacking enemies in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe will always be regarded as attacking their Weakness to enter combat, and their Toughness is reduced <color=#f29e38ff>regardless of Weakness types</color>. For every Blessing in possession, increases Toughness Reduction and additionally deals Break DMG when breaking Weakness.

eidolons.name: Neuronic Embroidery
eidolons.description: While the Ultimate's Zone is deployed, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Reedside Promenade
eidolons.description: While Ruan Mei is on the field, all allies increase their ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> when dealing DMG to enemies that are <u>Weakness Broken</u>.

eidolons.name: Viridescent Pirouette
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Chatoyant Éclat
eidolons.description: When an enemy target's Weakness is Broken, Ruan Mei's Break Effect increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Languid Barrette
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sash Cascade
eidolons.description: Extends the duration of the Ultimate's Zone by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). The Talent's <u>Break DMG</u> multiplier additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Aventurine
description: A high-ranking executive of the IPC's Strategic Investment Department.\nA risk-taker, his constant smile makes it difficult for people to discern his true feelings.

skills.name: Straight Bet
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aventurine's DEF to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Cornerstone Deluxe
skills.description: Provides all allies with a Fortified Wager shield that can block DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Aventurine's DEF plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). When Fortified Wager is gained repeatedly, the Shield Effect can stack, up to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the current Shield Effect provided by the Skill.
skills.simpleDescription: Provides all allies with a Fortified Wager shield, <color=#f29e38ff>whose Shield Effect is stackable</color>.

skills.name: Roulette Shark
skills.description: Randomly gains 1 to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> points of "Blind Bet." Then, inflicts "Unnerved" on one designated enemy target for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aventurine's DEF to that enemy target. When an ally hits an "Unnerved" enemy target, the CRIT DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains a random amount of "Blind Bet" points and inflicts "Unnerved "on one enemy, dealing Imaginary DMG. When an ally target hits an "Unnerved" enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>the CRIT DMG dealt increases</color>.

skills.name: Shot Loaded Right
skills.description: For any single ally with "Fortified Wager," their Effect RES increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, and when they get attacked, Aventurine gains 1 point of "Blind Bet." When Aventurine has "Fortified Wager," he can resist <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. This effect can trigger again after <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Aventurine additionally gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Blind Bet" after getting attacked. Upon reaching 7 points of "Blind Bet," Aventurine consumes the 7 points to launch a <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>-hit <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, with each hit dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aventurine's DEF to one random enemy. "Blind Bet" is capped at <unbreak>10</unbreak> points.
skills.simpleDescription: For any single ally with "Fortified Wager," their Effect RES increases, and when they get attacked, Aventurine accumulates "Blind Bet." When Aventurine has "Fortified Wager," he can resist <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. Upon reaching 7 points of "Blind Bet," Aventurine consumes the 7 points to launch a <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> that deals minor Imaginary DMG to random single enemy targets, bouncing a total of 7 times.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: The Red or the Black
skills.description:
After using the Technique, 1 of the following effects will be granted:
There is a chance for DEF to increase by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
There is a high chance for DEF to increase by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
There is a small chance for DEF to increase by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.

When this Technique is used repeatedly, the acquired effect with the highest buff value is retained.
When the next battle starts, increases all allies' DEF by the corresponding value, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Using the Technique randomly grants one out of the three DEF Boost effects with different buff values. After entering the next battle, increases all allies' DEF by the corresponding value.

eidolons.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
eidolons.description: Increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for ally targets with Fortified Wager. After using the Ultimate, provides all allies with a Fortified Wager shield, whose Shield Effect is equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the one provided by the Skill, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Bounded Rationality
eidolons.description: When using the Basic ATK, reduces the target's All-Type RES by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Droprate Maxing
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Unexpected Hanging Paradox
eidolons.description: When triggering his Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, first increases Aventurine's DEF by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and additionally increases the Hits Per Action for his talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Ambiguity Aversion
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Stag Hunt Game
eidolons.description: For every teammate that holds a Shield, the DMG dealt by Aventurine increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, up to a maximum of <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Dr. Ratio
description: Member of the Intelligentsia Guild.\nEccentric temperament, sharp-tongued but with an elegant demeanor.\nThe face under the strange alabaster head sculpture is apparently unexpectedly handsome.

skills.name: Mind is Might
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Intellectual Midwifery
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Syllogistic Paradox
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target and applies "Wiseman's Folly." When Dr. Ratio's teammates attack a target afflicted with "Wiseman's Folly," Dr. Ratio launches 1 instance of his Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against this target.\n"Wiseman's Folly" can be triggered for up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> times and only affects the most recent target of Dr. Ratio's Ultimate. This trigger count resets after Dr. Ratio's Ultimate is used.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy target and applies "Wiseman's Folly." When Dr. Ratio's teammates attack a target afflicted with "Wiseman's Folly," Dr. Ratio launches 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> on this target.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Cogito, Ergo Sum
skills.description: When using his Skill, Dr. Ratio has a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> of launching a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against his target for 1 time, dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK. For each debuff the target enemy has, the <u>fixed chance</u> of launching <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. If the target enemy is defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> triggers, the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> will be directed at a single random enemy instead.
skills.simpleDescription: When using Skill, there is a chance to launch 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> on the target, dealing Imaginary DMG.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Mold of Idolatry
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that Taunts nearby enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). After entering battle with enemies in this Special Dimension, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce each single enemy target's SPD by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies within the dimension are Taunted. After entering battle with enemies in this dimension, there is a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>reduce SPD</color> of enemy targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: Pride Comes Before a Fall
eidolons.description: The maximum stackable count for the Trace "Summation" increases by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. When a battle begins, immediately obtains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stacks of Summation. Needs to unlock Summation first.

eidolons.name: The Divine Is in the Details
eidolons.description: When his Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> hits a target, for every <u>debuff</u> the target has, deals Imaginary <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Dr. Ratio's ATK. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) during each <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>.

eidolons.name: Know Thyself
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Ignorance Is Blight
eidolons.description: When triggering the Talent, additionally regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for Dr. Ratio.

eidolons.name: Sic Itur Ad Astra
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Vincit Omnia Veritas
eidolons.description: Additionally increases the trigger count for "Wiseman's Folly" by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. The DMG dealt by the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Sparkle
description: A member of the Masked Fools. Inscrutable and unscrupulous.\nA dangerous maestro of theatrics, utterly engrossed in the art of performance. Adorned with innumerable masks, she is the hero with a thousand faces.\nWealth, status, power... None of those matters to Sparkle. The only thing that can get her attention is "amusement."

skills.name: Monodrama
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sparkle's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Dreamdiver
skills.description: Increases the CRIT DMG of a single target ally by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Sparkle's CRIT DMG plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). And at the same time, Advances Forward this ally's action by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.\nWhen Sparkle uses this ability on herself, the Action Advance effect will not trigger.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases an ally's <color=#f29e38ff>CRIT DMG</color> and Advances Forward their action.

skills.name: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
skills.description: Recovers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Skill Points for the team and grants all allies Cipher. For allies with Cipher, each stack of the DMG Boost effect provided by Sparkle's Talent additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turns.
skills.simpleDescription: Recovers <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Points</color> for the team, and enables the DMG Boost provided by Sparkle's Talent to be additionally enhanced.

skills.name: Red Herring
skills.description: While Sparkle is on the battlefield, additionally increases the max number of Skill Points by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>. Whenever an ally consumes 1 Skill Point, all allies' DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>. This effect lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and can stack up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Increases the team's <color=#f29e38ff>Max Skill Points</color>. Whenever an ally consumes Skill Points, enables all allies to <color=#f29e38ff>deal more damage</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Unreliable Narrator
skills.description: After using Technique, grants all allies Misdirect for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> seconds. Characters with Misdirect will not be detected by enemies, and entering combat in the Misdirect state recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for the team.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, grants all allies Misdirect. Characters with Misdirect will not be detected by enemies, and entering combat while in Misdirect recovers <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Points</color> for allies.

eidolons.name: Suspension of Disbelief
eidolons.description: The Cipher effect granted by the Ultimate lasts for 1 extra turn. All allies with Cipher have their ATK increased by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Purely Fictitious
eidolons.description: Every stack of the Talent's effect allows allies to additionally ignore <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF when dealing DMG.

eidolons.name: Pipedream
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Life Is a Gamble
eidolons.description: The Ultimate recovers 1 more Skill Point. The Talent additionally increases the Max Skill Points by 1.

eidolons.name: Parallax Truth
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Narrative Polysemy
eidolons.description: The CRIT DMG Boost effect provided by the Skill additionally increases by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Sparkle's CRIT DMG. When Sparkle uses Skill, her Skill's CRIT DMG Boost effect will apply to all teammates with Cipher. When Sparkle uses her Ultimate, any single ally who benefits from her Skill's CRIT DMG Boost will spread that effect to teammates with Cipher.

name: Black Swan
description: A Memokeeper of the Garden of Recollection. An indolent and mysterious soothsayer.\n"Remembrance" of men are hers to heed, threads of fate are hers to tug.

skills.name: Percipience, Silent Dawn
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy target, with a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting 1 stack of "<u>Arcana</u>" on the target. Additionally, when attacking a target that suffers Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock, there is respectively a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting 1 extra stack of "<u>Arcana</u>" on the target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy and has a chance of applying "<u>Arcana</u>" to the target. After attacking a target that suffers <color=#f29e38ff>Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock</color>, there is respectively a chance of <color=#f29e38ff>additionally applying "<u>Arcana</u>"</color>.

10013071.name: Arcana
10013071.desc: Arcana is a debuff that deals DMG over time. This debuff cannot be dispelled.\nWhile in the Arcana state, the unit is also considered to be in the Wind Shear state and takes Wind DoT at the start of each turn.\nThe infliction of Arcana ignores the target's Wind Shear RES, Bleed RES, Burn RES, and Shock RES.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Decadence, False Twilight
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Black Swan's ATK to one designated enemy target and any adjacent targets. At the same time, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting 1 stack of "<u>Arcana</u>" on the target enemy and the adjacent targets. Additionally, there is a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of reducing the DEF of the target enemy and the adjacent targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy target and any adjacent targets, with a high chance of <color=#f29e38ff>inflicting "<u>Arcana</u>"</color> on the targets and lowering their DEF.

10013071.name: Arcana
10013071.desc: Arcana is a debuff that deals DMG over time. This debuff cannot be dispelled.\nWhile in the Arcana state, the unit is also considered to be in the Wind Shear state and takes Wind DoT at the start of each turn.\nThe infliction of Arcana ignores the target's Wind Shear RES, Bleed RES, Burn RES, and Shock RES.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Bliss of <unbreak>Otherworld's Embrace</unbreak>
skills.description: Inflicts Epiphany on all enemies for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile afflicted with Epiphany, enemies take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG in their turn. Additionally, if enemies are also inflicted with <u>Arcana</u>, they are also considered to be simultaneously afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, and Shock. After <u>Arcana</u> causes DMG at the start of each turn, its stacks are not reset. This non-reset effect of <u>Arcana</u> stacks can be triggered up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s) for the duration of Epiphany. And the trigger count resets when Epiphany is applied again.\nDeals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Black Swan's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Epiphany on all enemies, increasing the DMG the targets take in their turn. Additionally, <color=#f29e38ff>having <u>Arcana</u> is regarded as having Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, and Shock</color>. Furthermore, <u>Arcana</u> will not reset its stacks after causing DMG at the start of the next turn. Deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

10013071.name: Arcana
10013071.desc: Arcana is a debuff that deals DMG over time. This debuff cannot be dispelled.\nWhile in the Arcana state, the unit is also considered to be in the Wind Shear state and takes Wind DoT at the start of each turn.\nThe infliction of Arcana ignores the target's Wind Shear RES, Bleed RES, Burn RES, and Shock RES.

skills.name: Loom of Fate's Caprice
skills.description:
Every time an enemy target receives DoT at the start of each turn, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> for it to be inflicted with 1 stack of <u>Arcana</u>.
While afflicted with <u>Arcana</u>, enemy targets receive Wind DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Black Swan's ATK at the start of each turn. Each stack of <u>Arcana</u> increases this DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Then <u>Arcana</u> resets to 1 stack. <u>Arcana</u> can stack up to <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> times.
Only when <u>Arcana</u> causes DMG at the start of an enemy target's turn, Black Swan triggers additional effects based on the number of <u>Arcana</u> stacks inflicted on the target:
When there are <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> or more <u>Arcana</u> stacks, deals Wind DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Black Swan's ATK to adjacent targets, with a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting 1 stack of <u>Arcana</u> on adjacent targets.
When there are <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> or more <u>Arcana</u> stacks, enables the current DoT dealt this time to ignore <unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak> of the target's and adjacent targets' DEF.
skills.simpleDescription: When an enemy target receives DoT at the start of each turn, there is a chance for it to be inflicted with <u>Arcana</u>. They receive <color=#f29e38ff>Wind DoT</color> at the start of the turn, and Black Swan triggers <color=#f29e38ff>additional effects</color> based on the number of <u>Arcana</u> stacks.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: From Façade to Vérité
skills.description: After this Technique is used, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for each enemy to be inflicted with 1 stack of <u>Arcana</u> at the start of the next battle. For each successful application of <u>Arcana</u> on a target, inflicts another stack of <u>Arcana</u> on the same target. This process repeats until <u>Arcana</u> fails to be inflicted on this target. For each successive application of <u>Arcana</u> on a target, its <u>base chance</u> of success is equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the <u>base chance</u> of the previous successful infliction of <u>Arcana</u> on that target.
skills.simpleDescription: After this Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, there is a high chance for each enemy to be <color=#f29e38ff>inflicted with Arcana repeatedly until <u>Arcana</u> fails to be inflicted</color>.

eidolons.name: Seven Pillars of Wisdom
eidolons.description: While Black Swan is active in combat, enemies afflicted with Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock will have their corresponding Wind, Physical, Fire, or Lightning RES respectively reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Weep Not For Me, My Lamb
eidolons.description: When an enemy target afflicted with "<u>Arcana</u>" is defeated, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "<u>Arcana</u>" on adjacent targets.

eidolons.name: As Above, So Below
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: In Tears We Gift
eidolons.description: While in the Epiphany state, enemy targets have their Effect RES reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and Black Swan regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy at the start of these targets' turns or when they are defeated. This Energy Regeneration effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Epiphany lasts. The trigger count is reset when Epiphany is applied again.

eidolons.name: Linnutee Flyway
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Pantheon Merciful, Masses Pitiful
eidolons.description: When an enemy target is attacked by Black Swan's teammates, Black Swan has a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of inflicting 1 stack of "<u>Arcana</u>" on the target.\nEvery time Black Swan inflicts "<u>Arcana</u>" on an enemy target, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> to additionally increase the number of "<u>Arcana</u>" stacked this time by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

name: Acheron
description: A drifter claiming to be a Galaxy Ranger. Her true name is unknown.\nShe walks the cosmos alone, carrying with her a long sword.

skills.name: Trilateral Wiltcross
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Octobolt Flash
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Slashed Dream." Inflicts <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Crimson Knot" on one designated enemy target, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to this target, as well as Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Slashed Dream. Inflicts <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of Crimson Knot on one enemy, dealing Lightning DMG to this target, as well as minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Slashed Dream Cries in Red
skills.description:
Sequentially unleash "Rainblade" 3 times and "Stygian Resurge" 1 time, dealing Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target, as well as Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to other targets.
"Rainblade": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, immediately deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies. For every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed, this DMG Multiplier is additionally increased, up to a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
"Stygian Resurge": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and remove all "Crimson Knots."
"Crimson Knot" cannot be applied to enemies during the Ultimate.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals 3 hits of minor Lightning DMG to one enemy. If "Crimson Knot" is removed from the target, then deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies. Finally, deals 1 hit of Lightning DMG to all enemies and removes all "Crimson Knots."

skills.name: Atop Rainleaf Hangs Oneness
skills.description: When Slashed Dream reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s), the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness Types and reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting until the end of the Ultimate.\nWhen any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on a target. If debuffs are inflicted on multiple targets, then the 1 stack of Crimson Knot will be inflicted on the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks. This effect can only trigger once for every ability use.\nAfter an enemy target exits the field or gets defeated by any unit while Acheron is on the field, their Crimson Knot stacks will be transferred to the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks on the whole field.
skills.simpleDescription: When Slashed Dream reaches its upper limit, the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness <color=#f29e38ff>regardless of Weakness Types</color> and reduces all enemies' <color=#f29e38ff>All-Type RES</color>.\nWhen any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains Slashed Dream and inflicts Crimson Knot on an enemy target.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Quadrivalent Ascendance
skills.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and reducing Toughness of all enemies irrespective of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.\nQuadrivalent Ascendance: After using the Ultimate, Acheron gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Slashed Dream and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Crimson Knot on a single random enemy.\nIf attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG to all enemies and reducing Toughness <color=#f29e38ff>regardless of Weakness Types</color>.\nIf attacking a normal enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>immediately defeats them</color> without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.

skills.name: Rainblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

skills.name: Rainblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

skills.name: Rainblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

skills.name: Stygian Resurge
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and removes all Crimson Knots.

eidolons.name: Silenced Sky Spake Sooth
eidolons.description: When dealing DMG to <u>debuffed</u> enemies, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Mute Thunder in Still Tempest
eidolons.description: The number of Nihility characters required for the Trace "The Abyss" to achieve its highest possible effect is reduced by 1. When this unit's turn starts, gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on the enemy with the most Crimson Knot stacks.

eidolons.name: Frost Bites in Death
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Shrined Fire for Mirrored Soul
eidolons.description: When enemy targets enter combat, inflicts them with the Ultimate DMG Vulnerability, increasing the amount of Ultimate DMG they take by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Strewn Souls on Erased Earths
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Apocalypse, the Emancipator
eidolons.description: Increases the All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> for the Ultimate DMG dealt by Acheron by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill will also be considered as Ultimate DMG and can Reduce enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.

name: Robin
description: A Halovian singer who was born in Penacony and has risen to cosmic fame. An elegant and demure young lady.\nThis time, she has been invited home by The Family to grace everyone with song during the Charmony Festival.\nShe can use the power of "Harmony" to broadcast her music, manifesting "resonance" among not only her fans but all manner of lifeforms.

skills.name: Wingflip White Noise
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Robin's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Pinion's Aria
skills.description: Increase DMG dealt by all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Robin's every turn.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Increases DMG dealt</color> by all allies.

skills.name: Vox Harmonique, Opus Cosmique
skills.description:
Robin enters the "Concerto" state and makes all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) immediately take action.
While in the "Concerto" state, increases all allies' ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Robin's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>. Moreover, after every attack by ally targets, Robin deals Physical <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK for 1 time, with a fixed CRIT Rate for this damage set at <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> and fixed CRIT DMG set at <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>.
While in the "Concerto" state, Robin is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and cannot enter her turn or take action until the "Concerto" state ends.
A "Concerto" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, Robin exits the "Concerto" state and immediately takes action. The countdown has its own fixed SPD of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Concerto" state, <color=#f29e38ff>increases all allies' ATK</color>, and causes all teammates to immediately take action. After an attack, Robin deals <color=#f29e38ff>Physical <u>Additional DMG</u></color>. While "Concerto" lasts, Robin is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. Before Concerto ends, Robin won't take a turn or action, lasting until the end of the countdown.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

skills.name: Tonal Resonance
skills.description: Increase all allies' CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Moreover, after allies attack enemy targets, Robin additionally regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy for herself.
skills.simpleDescription: Increase all allies' <color=#f29e38ff>CRIT DMG</color>. After an ally target attacks the enemy, Robin additionally regenerates Energy.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Overture of Inebriation
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension around the character that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. Enemies within this dimension will not attack Robin and will follow Robin while the dimension is active. After entering battle while the dimension is active, Robin regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy at the start of each wave. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension around the character. Enemies within this dimension will not attack Robin. After entering battle while the dimension is active, Robin additionally regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Energy at the start of each wave.

eidolons.name: Land of Smiles
eidolons.description: While the "Concerto" state is active, all allies' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Afternoon Tea For Two
eidolons.description: While the "Concerto" state is active, all allies' SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The Talent's Energy Regeneration effect additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Inverted Tuning
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nUltimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Raindrop Key
eidolons.description: When using the Ultimate, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies. While Robin is in the "Concerto" state, increases the Effect RES of all allies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lonestar's Lament
eidolons.description: Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Moonless Midnight
eidolons.description: While the "Concerto" state is active, the CRIT DMG for the Physical <u>Additional DMG</u> caused by the Ultimate increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. The effect of "Moonless Midnight" can trigger up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s) and the trigger count resets each time the Ultimate is used.

name: Firefly
description: A member of the Stellaron Hunters, clad in a set of mechanized armor known as "SAM." Her character is marked by unwavering loyalty and steely resolve.\nEngineered as a weapon against the Swarm, she experiences accelerated growth, but a tragically shortened lifespan.\nShe joined the Stellaron Hunters in a quest for a chance at "life," seeking to defy her fated demise.

skills.name: Order: Flare Propulsion
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Order: Aerial Bombardment
skills.description: Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of this unit's Max Energy. Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy. If the current HP is not sufficient, reduces SAM's HP to 1 when using this Skill. <u>Advances</u> this unit's next Action by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes a portion of this unit's own HP to regenerate Energy. Deals Fire DMG to one enemy. <u>Advances</u> this unit's next Action.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Complete Combustion
skills.description: Enters the Complete Combustion state, advances this unit's Action by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Skill. While in Complete Combustion, increases SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>, and when using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases this unit's Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> and increases the Break DMG dealt by SAM to the enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting until this current attack ends.\nA countdown timer for the Complete Combustion state appears in the Action Order. When the countdown timer's turn starts, SAM exits the Complete Combustion state. The countdown timer has a fixed SPD of <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>.\nSAM cannot use Ultimate while in Complete Combustion.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the Complete Combustion state. <color=#f29e38ff>Advances this unit's Action by <unbreak>100%</unbreak></color>. Gains <color=#f29e38ff>Enhanced Basic ATK</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>Enhanced Skill</color>. Increases this unit's <color=#f29e38ff>SPD, Weakness Break Efficiency, and the Break DMG received by the enemy targets</color>, lasting until the countdown ends.

skills.name: Chrysalid Pyronexus
skills.description: The lower the HP, the less DMG received. When HP is <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> or lower, the DMG Reduction reaches its maximum effect, reducing up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. During the Complete Combustion, the DMG Reduction remains at its maximum effect, and the Effect RES increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>.\nIf Energy is lower than <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all <u>debuffs</u> on this unit.
skills.simpleDescription: The lower the HP, the less DMG received. During the Complete Combustion state, the DMG Reduction effect remains at its maximum extent and Effect RES is increased. If Energy is lower than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> when the battle starts, regenerates Energy to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. Once Energy is regenerated to its maximum, dispels all <u>debuffs</u> on this unit.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Δ Order: Meteoric Incineration
skills.description: Leaps into the air and moves about freely for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds, which can be ended early by launching a plunging attack. When the duration ends, plunges and immediately attacks all enemies within a set area. At the start of each wave, applies a Fire Weakness to all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of SAM's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Leaps into the air and moves about freely. After a few seconds of movement, plunges and attacks all enemies within range. At the start of <color=#f29e38ff>each wave</color>, <color=#f29e38ff>applies a Fire Weakness</color> to all enemies and deals Fire DMG to them.

skills.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Pyrogenic Decimation
skills.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP. Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of SAM's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores a portion of this unit's own HP and deals Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Fyrefly Type-IV: Deathstar Overload
skills.description: Restores HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP. Applies Fire Weakness to one designated enemy, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (<unbreak>#5[f1]</unbreak> × Break Effect + <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>) of SAM's ATK to this target. At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to (<unbreak>#6[f1]</unbreak> × Break Effect + <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>) of SAM's ATK to adjacent targets. The Break Effect taken into the calculation is capped at <unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores a portion of this unit's own HP. <color=#f29e38ff>Applies Fire Weakness</color> to one enemy. Deals massive Fire DMG to this target and Fire DMG to adjacent targets.

eidolons.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
eidolons.description: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.

eidolons.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to <u>Break their Weakness</u> allows SAM to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>. This effect can trigger again after <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
eidolons.description: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Misha
description: A well-behaved young man serving as a hotel bellboy in Penacony.\nMisha has a great longing for the Nameless and dreams of one day embarking on a journey of his own.

skills.name: E—Excuse Me, Please!
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: R—Room Service!
skills.description: Increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> hit(s). Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target, and Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to an enemy and minor Ice DMG to enemies adjacent to them. In addition, increases Misha's next <color=#f29e38ff>Ultimate's Hits Per Action</color>.

skills.name: G—Gonna Be Late!
skills.description: Has <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Hits Per Action by default. First, uses 1 hit to deal Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target. Then, the rest of the hits each deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK to one random enemy. Just before each hit lands, there is a <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> <u>base chance</u> to Freeze the target, lasting for 1 turn.\nWhile Frozen, enemy targets cannot take any actions, and at the start of their turn, they receive Ice <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Misha's ATK.\nThis Ultimate can possess up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Hits Per Action. After the Ultimate is used, its Hits Per Action will be reset to the default level.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to single enemies. The attack bounces <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> times by default and up to a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> times. Before each hit lands, there is a minor chance to <color=#f29e38ff>Freeze</color> the target.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Horological Escapement
skills.description: For every 1 Skill Point allies consume, Misha's next Ultimate delivers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> more Hit(s) Per Action, and Misha regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy.
skills.simpleDescription: For <color=#f29e38ff>every 1 Skill Point allies consume</color>, Misha's next Ultimate <color=#f29e38ff>delivers more Hits Per Action</color>, and Misha regenerates his Energy.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Wait, You Are So Beautiful!
skills.description: After using the Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. Enemies caught in the Special Dimension are inflicted with Dream Prison and stop all their actions. Upon entering battle against enemies afflicted with Dream Prison, increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> hit(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension that stops all enemies within. Upon entering battle against enemies within the dimension, Misha's <color=#f29e38ff>next Ultimate deals more Hits Per Action</color>.

eidolons.name: Whimsicality of Fancy
eidolons.description: When using the Ultimate, for every enemy on the field, additionally increases the Hits Per Action for the current Ultimate by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> hit(s), up to a maximum increase of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> hit(s).

eidolons.name: Yearning of Youth
eidolons.description: Before each hit of the Ultimate lands, there is a <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> of reducing the target's DEF by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Vestige of Happiness
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Visage of Kinship
eidolons.description: Increases the DMG multiplier for each hit of the Ultimate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Genesis of First Love
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Estrangement of Dream
eidolons.description: When using the Ultimate, increases own DMG by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting until the end of the turn. In addition, the next time the Skill is used, recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for the team.

name: Sunday
description: The dream of the Order has dissipated, yet there are still those who will not give up on their original intent.\n — The traveler whose wings were clipped... whereto shall his footsteps lead?

skills.name: Gleaming Admonition
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Sunday's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Benison of Paper and Rites
skills.description: Enables one designated ally character and their summon to immediately take action, and increases their DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. If the target has a summon, then the DMG Boost effect is further boosted by an additional <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nAfter using Skill on The Beatified, recovers 1 Skill Point.\nWhen Sunday uses this ability on characters following the Path of Harmony, cannot trigger the "immediate action" effect.
skills.simpleDescription: Enables one designated <color=#f29e38ff>ally character and their summon to immediately take action</color>, and increases their DMG dealt. If the target has a summon, then the DMG dealt increase is further boosted.\nAfter using Skill on The Beatified, recovers 1 Skill Point.\nWhen Sunday uses this ability on characters following the Path of Harmony, cannot trigger the "immediate action" effect.

skills.name: Ode to <unbreak>Caress and Cicatrix</unbreak>
skills.description: Regenerates Energy by <unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak> of Max Energy for one designated ally character, and turns the target and their summon into "The Beatified." "The Beatified" have their CRIT DMG increased by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Sunday's CRIT DMG plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nAt the start of Sunday's every turn, the duration of "The Beatified" decreases by 1 turn, lasting for a total of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). And it only takes effect on the most recent target of the Ultimate (excluding Sunday himself). When Sunday is knocked down, "The Beatified" will also be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Regenerates Energy</color> for one designated ally character and turns the target and their summon into "The Beatified." "The Beatified" increases their CRIT DMG.

skills.name: The Sorrowing Body
skills.description: When using Skill, increases the target's CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When using Skill, increases the target's CRIT Rate.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: The Glorious Mysteries
skills.description: After this Technique is used, the first time Sunday uses an ability on an ally target in the next battle, the target's DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After this Technique is used, the first time Sunday uses an ability on an ally target in the next battle, the target's DMG dealt increases.

eidolons.name: Millennium's Quietus
eidolons.description: When Sunday uses Skill, the target character can ignore <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG and their summon can ignore <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Faith Outstrips Frailty
eidolons.description: After the first use of Ultimate, recovers <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s). The DMG dealt by "The Beatified" increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Hermitage of Thorns
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sculpture's Preamble
eidolons.description: When the turn starts, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Paper Raft in Silver Bay
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dawn of Sidereal Cacophony
eidolons.description: The Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect becomes stackable up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s), and the Talent's duration increases by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). When Sunday uses Ultimate, can also apply the Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect to the target. When the Talent's CRIT Rate boost takes effect and the target's CRIT Rate exceeds <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, every 1% of excess CRIT Rate increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Jade
description: A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts, known for her cornerstone "Jade of Credit."\nA beautiful and elegant moneylender, she is skilled in deciphering the depths of people's minds, with a personal hobby called "Bonajade Exchange."\nShe's willing to wait patiently for high-value acquisitions and adept at extracting value from seemingly destitute clients.

skills.name: Lash of Riches
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jade's ATK to one designated enemy target, and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jade's ATK to adjacent enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy and minor Quantum DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

skills.name: Acquisition Surety
skills.description:
Makes a single target ally become the Debt Collector and increases their SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
After the Debt Collector attacks, deals 1 instance of Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jade's ATK to each enemy target hit, and consumes the Debt Collector's HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of their Max HP. If the current HP is insufficient, reduces HP to 1.
If Jade becomes the Debt Collector, she cannot gain the SPD boost effect, and her attacks do not consume HP.
When the Debt Collector exists on the field, Jade cannot use her Skill. At the start of Jade's every turn, the Debt Collector's duration decreases by 1 turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Makes a single ally become the <color=#f29e38ff>Debt Collector</color> and increases their SPD. After the <color=#f29e38ff>Debt Collector</color> attacks, deals minor Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> to each enemy target hit and consume the Debt Collector's own HP. When Jade becomes the Debt Collector, she cannot gain the SPD boost effect, and her attacks do not consume her HP.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Vow of the Deep
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jade's ATK to all enemies. At the same time, Jade enhances her Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, increasing its DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. This enhancement can take effect <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to all enemy units, and this unit's Talent's <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> DMG multiplier increases.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Fang of Flare Flaying
skills.description: After Jade or the "Debt Collector" unit attacks, gains 1 point of Charge for each enemy target hit. Upon reaching <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points of Charge, consumes the <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points to launch 1 instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Jade's ATK to all enemies. This <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not generate Charge.\nWhen launching her Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, Jade immediately gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Pawned Asset," with each stack increasing CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> times.
skills.simpleDescription: After Jade or the <color=#f29e38ff>"Debt Collector"</color> unit attacks, gains 1 point of Charge for each enemy target hit. Upon reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> points of Charge, consumes the <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> points to launch 1 instance of <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, dealing Quantum DMG to all enemies.\nWhen Jade launches the <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, gains "Pawned Asset" and increases CRIT DMG, stacking up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> times.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Visionary Predation
skills.description: After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with Blind Fealty for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies inflicted with Blind Fealty will not initiate attacks on allies. When entering battle via actively attacking enemies inflicted with Blind Fealty, all enemies with Blind Fealty will enter combat simultaneously. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Jade's ATK to all enemies, and immediately gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Pawned Asset.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Blind Fealty on enemies within a set area. Attacking an enemy with Blind Fealty causes all enemies with Blind Fealty to enter combat simultaneously. Upon entering combat, deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies and immediately gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of Pawned Asset.

eidolons.name: Altruism? Nevertheless Tradable
eidolons.description: The <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG from Jade's Talent increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After the "Debt Collector" character attacks and the number of the enemy target(s) hit is either 2 or 1, Jade additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> or <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge respectively.

eidolons.name: Morality? Herein Authenticated
eidolons.description: When there are <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stacks of Pawned Asset, Jade's CRIT Rate increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Honesty? Soon Mortgaged
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sincerity? Put Option Only
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, enables the DMG dealt by Jade to ignore <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of enemy targets' DEF, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Hope? Hitherto Forfeited
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Equity? Pending Sponsorship
eidolons.description: While the "Debt Collector" character exists on the field, Jade's Quantum <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, and Jade gains the "Debt Collector" state.

name: Boothill
description: A cyborg cowboy drifting among the stars. Extremely optimistic and unrestrained.\nHe is a member of the Galaxy Rangers who swore to punish the wretched by any and all means...\nHis flamboyant and brash actions were all to draw the attention of the Interastral Peace Corporation — the target of his revenge.

skills.name: Skullcrush Spurs
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Sizzlin' Tango
skills.description:
Forces Boothill and one designated enemy target into the "Standoff" state. Boothill's Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and he cannot use his Skill, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Boothill's every turn.
The enemy target in the "Standoff" becomes Taunted. When this enemy target/Boothill gets attacked by the other party in the Standoff, the DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
After this target is defeated or becomes Weakness Broken, Boothill gains 1 stack of "Pocket Trickshot," then dispels the "Standoff."
This Skill cannot regenerate Energy. After using this Skill, the current turn does not end.
skills.simpleDescription: Initiates <color=#f29e38ff>Standoff</color>. After the target in the Standoff is <color=#f29e38ff>defeated or Weakness Broken</color>, Boothill receives Pocket Trickshot and dispels the Standoff. Boothill <color=#f29e38ff>gains Enhanced Basic ATK</color> and this turn does not end.

skills.name: Dust Devil's Sunset Rodeo
skills.description: Applies Physical Weakness to one designated enemy target, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nDeals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to the target and <u>delays their action</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Applies Physical Weakness</color> to one enemy, deals massive Physical DMG to them, and <u>delays their action</u>.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Five Peas in a Pod
skills.description: Each stack of Pocket Trickshot increases the Enhanced Basic Attack's Toughness Reduction by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s).\nIf the target is <u>Weakness Broken</u> while the Enhanced Basic ATK is being used, based on the number of Pocket Trickshot stacks, deals <u>Break DMG</u> to this target equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's Physical Break DMG. The max Toughness taken into account for this DMG cannot exceed <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> times the base Toughness Reduction of the Basic Attack "Skullcrush Spurs."\nAfter winning the battle, Boothill can retain Pocket Trickshot for the next battle.
skills.simpleDescription: Pocket Trickshot increases the Enhanced Basic ATK's Toughness Reduction and additionally deals Physical <color=#f29e38ff>Break DMG</color> <color=#f29e38ff>if the target is Weakness Broken</color>. After winning the battle, retains Pocket Trickshot for the next battle.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000014.name: Break DMG
10000014.desc: Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher target max Toughness, and higher character levels.\nBreak DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: 3-9× Smile
skills.description: After the Technique is used, when casting the Skill for the first time in the next battle, applies the same Physical Weakness to the target as the one induced by the Ultimate, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After the Technique is used, <color=#f29e38ff>inflicts Physical Weakness</color> on one enemy when casting the Skill for the first time in the next battle.

skills.name: Fanning the Hammer
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to one designated enemy target.\nThe Enhanced Basic Attack cannot recover Skill Points and can only target the enemy that is in the "Standoff" state.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy. Can only attack the target in the "Standoff."

eidolons.name: Dusty Trail's Lone Star
eidolons.description: When the battle starts, obtains 1 stack of Pocket Trickshot. When Boothill deals DMG, ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the enemy target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Milestonemonger
eidolons.description: When in Standoff and gaining Pocket Trickshot, recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) and increases Break Effect by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Can also trigger this effect when gaining Pocket Trickshot stacks that exceed the max limit. But cannot trigger repeatedly within one turn.

eidolons.name: Marble Orchard's Guard
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Cold Cuts Chef
eidolons.description: When the enemy target in the Standoff is attacked by Boothill, the DMG they receive additionally increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When Boothill is attacked by the enemy target in the Standoff, the effect of him receiving increased DMG is offset by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Stump Speech
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Crowbar Hotel's Raccoon
eidolons.description: When triggering the Talent's <u>Break DMG</u>, additionally deals <u>Break DMG</u> to the target equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG multiplier and additionally deals <u>Break DMG</u> to adjacent targets equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG multiplier.
