name: Rappa
description: A peculiar girl who appears in Penacony like a flashbang at the darkest hour of night, identifying herself as a ninja and attributing everything in the world to "ninjutsu."\nUpholding the recitation of ninja mantra, creating Dazzling Ninja Seals, and studying ninja scrolls — That is, the Way of the Ninja involves rap, graffiti, and manga — Through rigorous self-discipline, she roams the stars, upholding justice and righteousness.\nAs a member of the Galaxy Rangers, she relentlessly pursues the villain known as Evil Ninja Osaru, chasing them to the very edge of the Cosmos.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Rise Above Tumbles
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Ninja Strike: Rooted Resolute
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Nindō Supreme: Aishiteru
skills.description: Enters the "Sealform" state, immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u>, obtains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points of "Chroma Ink," and increases Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> and Break Effect by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.\nWhile in the "Sealform" state, Basic ATK is enhanced, and Skill and Ultimate cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 1 point of "Chroma Ink." When "Chroma Ink" is depleted, exits the "Sealform" state.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Sealform" state, gains an <color=#f29e38ff><u>extra turn</u></color>, obtains 3 points of "Chroma Ink," and <color=#f29e38ff>increases Weakness Break Efficiency and Break Effect</color>.\nWhile in the "Sealform" state, <color=#f29e38ff>gains Enhanced Basic ATK</color>. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 1 point of "Chroma Ink." When "Chroma Ink" is depleted, exits the "Sealform" state.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

skills.name: Ninja Tech: Endurance Gauge
skills.description: Each time the enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 point of Charge, up to a max of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> points of Charge. When Rappa next launches the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Break DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can ignore Weakness Type to reduce <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Toughness, consuming all Charge. Each point of Charge increases the Break DMG multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> and increases the Toughness Reduction that can ignore Weakness Type by <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>.\nWhen Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.
skills.simpleDescription: When the enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 point of Charge. When launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can <color=#f29e38ff>ignore Weakness Type to reduce Toughness</color> and consume all Charge, increasing the Break DMG multiplier and Toughness Reduction.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Ninja Dash: By Leaps and Bounds
skills.description: After using Technique, enters the "Graffiti" state for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. While in the "Graffiti" state, moves forward rapidly for a set distance and attacks any enemies touched. During the rapid movement, can block all enemies' attacks. Using an attack in the "Graffiti" state can end the state's duration early. After entering combat via attacking enemies, deals <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Toughness Reduction regardless of Weakness Type and Break DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to each enemy target, and deals Break DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to adjacent targets. At the same time, this unit regenerates <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy.
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Graffiti" state. Moves forward rapidly for a set distance and attacks any enemies touched. After entering combat via attacking enemies, deals <color=#f29e38ff>Toughness Reduction regardless of Weakness Type</color> and Imaginary Break DMG to each enemy target and deals Imaginary Break DMG to their adjacent targets. At the same time, this unit regenerates Energy.

skills.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and minor Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets. Attacking enemies without Imaginary Weakness can also reduce their Toughness.

skills.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and minor Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets. Attacking enemies without Imaginary Weakness can also reduce their Toughness.

skills.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all enemies. Attacking enemies without Imaginary Weakness can also reduce their Toughness.

skills.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
skills.description: Launches "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade." The first 2 hits deal Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's ATK to adjacent targets, and the 3rd hit deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.\nEnhanced Basic ATK will not recover Skill Points. Attacking enemies that don't have Imaginary Weakness can also reduce Toughness, whose effect is equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the original Toughness Reduction. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.
skills.simpleDescription: The first 2 hits deal minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and minor Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets. The third hit deals minor Imaginary DMG to all enemies. Attacking enemies without Imaginary Weakness can also reduce their Toughness.

eidolons.name: Returned Is the Revenant With No Ferry Toll
eidolons.description: During the "Sealform" state entered by using Ultimate, DMG dealt by Rappa ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the targets' DEF. After exiting the "Sealform" state, regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Free Is the Mind Enlightened by Haikus
eidolons.description: The Enhanced Basic ATK's first 2 hits have their Toughness Reduction against the one designated enemy increased by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Many Are the Shrines That Repel No Hell
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lost Is the Nindō Devoured by Time
eidolons.description: While in the "Sealform" state, increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Steady Is The Ranger With Unerring Arrows
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Righteous Is the Wrath That Spares No Evil
eidolons.description: When battle starts, Rappa gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of her Talent's Charge, and its upper limit increases by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s). After launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge.

name: The Dahlia
description: The sweet dream burned down the Ever-Flame Mansion, taking with it every trace of "her."\nDestruction, Remembrance... flowers of betrayal bloomed wherever they passed.\nTo return to the dreamscape no one remembers, who will be the one to set her aflame again?

skills.name: Fiddle... Fissured Memory
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Lick... Enkindled Betrayal
skills.description: Deploys a Zone that lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of The Dahlia's turn. Then, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Dahlia's ATK to one designated enemy and their adjacent targets.\nWhile the Zone lasts, increases all allies' Weakness Break Efficiency by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. Toughness Reduction taken by enemy targets while not <u>Weakness Broken</u> can also be converted into <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deploys a Zone. Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and their adjacent targets.\nWhile the Zone lasts, increases all allies' <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Break Efficiency</color>, and enemy targets <color=#f29e38ff>will also take <u>Super Break DMG</u> even when they are not <u>Weakness Broken</u></color>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

skills.name: Wallow... <unbreak>Entombed Ash</unbreak>
skills.description: Inflicts a "Wilt" state on all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Dahlia's ATK, which is distributed evenly across all enemies.\nEnemy targets in the "Wilt" state have their DEF reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> and will be implanted with Weakness of all Dance Partners' Types.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Applies Weaknesses of Dance Partners' Types</color> to all enemies and reduces their DEF. Deals massive Fire DMG, which is distributed evenly across all enemies.

skills.name: Who's Afraid of Constance?
skills.description: When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy and becomes "Dance Partners" along with the teammate that triggered combat. Whenever there is no other "Dance Partner" on the field, this unit and the teammate with the highest Break Effect become "Dance Partners" together. After a "Dance Partner" attacks a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>.\nAfter an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Dahlia's ATK to one random enemy. After each instance of DMG dealt to a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this DMG will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.\nThis effect can only trigger once per turn. If the target is defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is used, it will be launched at one random enemy instead.
skills.simpleDescription: When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates Energy and becomes "Dance Partner" along with the teammate that triggered combat. When a "Dance Partner" attacks a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>Super Break DMG</u></color>.\nAfter an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia triggers <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, deals minor Fire DMG to random enemies, and additionally deals <u>Super Break DMG</u> to <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy targets, bouncing a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: The Heart Makes the Finest Tomb
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies within this dimension will not actively attack ally targets. After entering combat with enemies in the Special Dimension, The Dahlia immediately deploys her Skill's Zone, and converts the combat-triggering Toughness Reduction into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> against enemy targets that are <u>Weakness Broken</u>.\nOnly 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension where enemies within will not attack ally targets. After entering combat with enemies in the dimension, The Dahlia immediately deploys a Zone and deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>Super Break DMG</u></color> to enemy targets in the <u>Weakness Break</u> state.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

eidolons.name: When a Bud Readies to Bloom
eidolons.description: The <u>Super Break DMG</u> multiplier provided by Talent to "Dance Partners" now applies to all ally characters, with "Dance Partners" additionally receiving a <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> boost. After "Dance Partners" use an attack, additionally deals the attacked enemy targets a fixed amount of Toughness Reduction equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their Max Toughness (minimum <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>, maximum <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>). This effect can only trigger once per enemy target, and this trigger count resets after the enemy target receives a killing blow.

eidolons.name: Fresh, Ethereal, and Beloved
eidolons.description: When The Dahlia is on the field, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When an enemy target enters the field, immediately inflicts "Wilt" on them, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Pity Its Petals Thin as Mist
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Pity Its Heart Gnawed by Worms
eidolons.description: Increases the number of DMG instances dealt by Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>. Upon its use, the DMG taken by all enemy targets increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Fallen, Decayed, and Despised
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: And Yet, Always, Deathly Beautiful
eidolons.description: Increases Dance Partners' Break Effect by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When using Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, <u>advances the next action</u> of all "Dance Partners" by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

skills.name: Did You Get It
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Big Brain Energy
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy, and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Interpretation." Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets. This effect can repeat 2 times.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals DMG to one designated enemy. Deals DMG to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets, repeating 2 times.

skills.name: <unbreak>Told Ya!</unbreak> <unbreak>Magic Happens</unbreak>
skills.description: Rearranges the numbers of "Interpretation" stacks on all enemies, prioritizing the transfer of the higher numbers of "Interpretation" stacks to Elite-level targets and above. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to all enemies. When using Ultimate, increases The Herta's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s). After the use, The Herta immediately takes action and gains 1 stack of "Inspiration." "Inspiration" can stack up to <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> time(s). While having "Inspiration," enhances Skill to "Hear Me Out."
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Rearranges the numbers of "Interpretation" stacks</color> on all enemies, prioritizing the transfer of the higher numbers of "Interpretation" stacks to Elite-level targets and above. Then, deals Ice DMG to all enemies. After use, enhances Skill and immediately takes action.

skills.name: Hand Them Over
skills.description: When enemy targets enter combat, The Herta inflicts 1 stack of "Interpretation" on them. At the start of each wave, applies <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Interpretation" to a random enemy target, prioritizing Elite-level targets and above. When the Enhanced Skill's primary target has "Interpretation," the multiplier for the DMG dealt increases, with each stack granting an increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> on the primary target/other targets respectively. If 2 or more characters follow the Path of Erudition in the team, each stack grants an additional increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> on the primary target/other targets respectively. "Interpretation" can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s). When using the Enhanced Skill, resets the number of "Interpretation" stacks on the primary target to 1. After the enemy target leaves the field or gets defeated by any unit, "Interpretation" will be transferred, prioritizing the transfer to Elite-level targets and above.
skills.simpleDescription: Enhanced Skill <color=#f29e38ff>increases the DMG dealt based on the target's "Interpretation" stacks</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Vibe Checker
skills.description: After using Technique, increases The Herta's ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> at the start of the next battle, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nIf there are Basic Treasures in this current map, using Technique can mark up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Basic Treasures' locations.\nAfter entering battle by using Technique in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, at the start of each wave, deals <u>True DMG</u> to enemy targets lower than Elite-level by an amount equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the targets' Max HP, and deals <u>True DMG</u> to enemy targets at Elite-level and above by an amount equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of the targets' Max HP.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, <color=#f29e38ff>can mark several Basic Treasures' locations</color>, and increases The Herta's ATK at the start of the next battle.\nAfter entering battle by using Technique in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, deals massive <u>True DMG</u> to all enemies at the start of each wave.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

skills.name: Hear Me Out
skills.description: Consumes 1 stack of "Inspiration." Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to one designated enemy and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Interpretation." Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets, repeating 2 times. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of The Herta's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals DMG to one designated enemy. Deals DMG to the targets hit by this instance of Skill and their respective adjacent targets, repeating 2 times. After that, deals DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Night at Shorefall
eidolons.description: When the Enhanced Skill calculates the number of "Interpretation" stacks, additionally counts <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the number of "Interpretation" stacks on the 1 target with the most stacks among the primary target and adjacent targets. When "Interpretation" is reset by using the Enhanced Skill, its stack number is reset to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instead.

eidolons.name: Wind Through Keyhole
eidolons.description: After The Herta enters combat or uses Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Inspiration" stack. After using Enhanced Skill, <u>advances</u> The Herta's next action by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Door into Summer
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Sixteenth Key
eidolons.description: The SPD of Erudition characters in the team increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bitter Pill of Truth
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sweet Lure of Answer
eidolons.description: The Herta's Ice RES PEN increases by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>. When the number of enemy targets on the field is (≥3)/2/1, Ultimate's DMG multiplier increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> respectively.

name: Aglaea
description: In that holy city kissed by the dawn, the weaver caresses the golden threads, entwining fates.\nThe Chrysos Heir that bears the "Romance" Coreflame gathered the world's heroes, leading them on a long journey once more\n— to topple the gods, reclaim the divine flame, and grant rebirth to the nearly fallen Amphoreus.

skills.name: Thorned Nectar
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aglaea's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Rise, Exalted Renown
skills.description: Restores HP to Garmentmaker by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of its Max HP. If Garmentmaker is absent, then <u>summons the memosprite</u> Garmentmaker and makes this unit immediately take action.
skills.simpleDescription: Restores HP for Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is absent, <color=#f29e38ff><u>summons the memosprite</u></color> Garmentmaker and makes this unit immediately take action.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Dance, <unbreak>Destined Weaveress</unbreak>
skills.description: <u>Summons the memosprite</u> Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is already on the field, then restores its HP to max. Aglaea enters the "Supreme Stance" state and immediately takes action.\nWhile in "Supreme Stance," Aglaea gains the SPD Boost stacks from Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent, with each stack increasing this unit's SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. Enhances Basic ATK to "Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss," and cannot use Skill. Garmentmaker is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>.\nA countdown appears in the Action Order, with its own SPD set at <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>. While the countdown exists, using Ultimate again will reset the countdown. When the countdown's turn starts, Garmentmaker self-destructs. When Garmentmaker disappears, Aglaea dispels the "Supreme Stance" state.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Garmentmaker, enabling Aglaea to enter the "Supreme Stance" state, immediately take action, and gain Enhanced Basic ATK.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Rosy-Fingered
skills.description: The memosprite Garmentmaker has an initial SPD equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of Aglaea's SPD and a Max HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aglaea's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color>. While Garmentmaker is on the field, Aglaea's attacks inflict the target with the "Seam Stitch" state. After attacking enemies in the "Seam Stitch" state, further deals Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aglaea's ATK. "Seam Stitch" only takes effect on the most recently inflicted target.
skills.simpleDescription: While Garmentmaker is on the field, Aglaea's attacks inflict the target with the "Seam Stitch" state. After attacking enemies in the "Seam Stitch" state, deals minor Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Meteoric Sunder
skills.description: <u>Summons the memosprite</u> Garmentmaker and launches a forward joint attack. After entering battle, regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy and deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Aglaea's ATK to all enemy targets. Then, randomly inflicts the "Seam Stitch" state on a random enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Garmentmaker and launches a forward joint attack. After entering battle, regenerates Energy and deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies. Then, randomly inflicts the "Seam Stitch" state on a random enemy target.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss
skills.description: Aglaea and Garmentmaker launch a <u>Joint ATK</u> on the target, respectively dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Aglaea's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Garmentmaker's ATK to the target. Also, respectively deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Aglaea's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Garmentmaker's ATK to adjacent targets.\n"Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss" cannot recover Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Aglaea and Garmentmaker launch a <color=#f29e38ff><u>Joint ATK</u></color> on the target. Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

skills.name: Rise, Exalted Renown
skills.simpleDescription: Restores HP for Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is absent, <u>summons the memosprite</u> Garmentmaker and makes this unit immediately take action.

eidolons.name: Drift at the Whim of Venus
eidolons.description: The enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch" takes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> increased DMG. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker attacks this target, additionally regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy.

eidolons.name: Sail on the Raft of Eyelids
eidolons.description: When Aglaea or Garmentmaker takes action, enables the DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker to ignore <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) and lasts until any unit, other than Aglaea or Garmentmaker, actively uses an ability.

eidolons.name: Bequeath in the Coalescence of Dew
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Flicker Below the Surface of Marble
eidolons.description: The SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent has its max stack limit increased by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. After Aglaea uses an attack, can also make Garmentmaker gain the SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent.

eidolons.name: Weave Under the Shroud of Woe
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Fluctuate in the Tapestry of Fates
eidolons.description: While Aglaea is in "Supreme Stance," increases her and Garmentmaker's Lightning <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When Aglaea's or Garmentmaker's SPD is greater than <unbreak>160</unbreak>/<unbreak>240</unbreak>/<unbreak>320</unbreak>, the <u>Joint ATK</u> DMG dealt by them increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.

1140201.name: Thorned Snare
1140201.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of ATK to one enemy and Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of ATK to adjacent targets.
1140201.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy target and adjacent targets.

1140203.name: A Body Brewed by Tears
1140203.desc: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," increases this unit's SPD by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>, stacking up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s). When Garmentmaker takes action, automatically uses "Thorned Snare," prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.
1140203.simple_desc: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," <color=#f29e38ff>increases this unit's SPD</color>. When taking action, automatically uses attacks, prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.

1140205.name: The Speeding Summer
1140205.desc: When Garmentmaker is summoned, this unit's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
1140205.simple_desc: When summoned, this unit has its <u>action advanced</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

1140206.name: Bloom of Drying Grass
1140206.desc: When Garmentmaker disappears, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for Aglaea.
1140206.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, regenerates Energy for Aglaea.

name: Tribbie
description: From that holy land blessed by the tripartite prophecy, the messenger split into a thousand forms, embarking on a long journey.\nTribios, Holy Maiden of Janusopolis, the Chrysos Heir who stole Passage's Coreflame, toiled for the masses and brought the news of deliverance to all domains.\n—Seek the children of humanity with golden blood in their veins, shatter the dimmest dark in this world, and walk toward the tomorrow where the stars gleam.

skills.name: Hundred Rockets
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Tribbie's Max HP to one designated enemy. Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Tribbie's Max HP to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Where'd the Gifts Go
skills.description: Gains "Numinosity," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While Tribbie has "Numinosity," increases all ally targets' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Numinosity," during which all ally targets have their All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increased.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Guess Who Lives Here
skills.description: Activates a Zone and deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies.\nWhile the Zone lasts, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>. After an ally target attacks, for every 1 target hit, deals 1 instance of Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Tribbie's Max HP to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets.\nThe Zone lasts for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Activates a Zone</color> and deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies. While the Zone lasts, increases the DMG taken by enemies and deals minor Quantum <color=#f29e38ff>Additional DMG</color> to the target that has the highest HP among the hit targets based on <color=#f29e38ff>the number of enemies</color> attacked.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Busy as Tribbie
skills.description: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Tribbie's Max HP to all enemies. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters. If the target was defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is launched, then launches the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against new enemy targets entering the battlefield.
skills.simpleDescription: After other ally characters use Ultimate, Tribbie launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, dealing minor Quantum DMG to <color=#f29e38ff>all enemies</color>. This effect triggers up to 1 time per character. When Tribbie uses Ultimate, resets the trigger count for other ally characters.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: If You're Happy and You Know It
skills.description: After using Technique and upon entering battle, obtains "Numinosity," lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When entering battle, obtains "Numinosity."

eidolons.name: Rite of Sugar Scoop
eidolons.description: While the Zone lasts and after ally targets attack enemies, additionally deals <u>True DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the total DMG of this attack to targets that have been dealt <u>Additional DMG</u> by the Zone.

eidolons.name: Guide of Dream Tour
eidolons.description: The <u>Additional DMG</u> dealt by the Zone increases to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG. When the Zone deals <u>Additional DMG</u>, further deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of Additional DMG.

eidolons.name: Trove of Morning Glow
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Peace of Empathy Bond
eidolons.description: While "Numinosity" lasts, the DMG dealt by all allies ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Clock of Wonder Origin
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Morrow of Star Shine
eidolons.description: After Tribbie uses Ultimate, launches her Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against all enemies. The DMG dealt by Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Mydei
description: Kremnos, the mist-shrouded city of chaos and war! Its royal lineage is tainted with patricide, and its god bears the name of calamity.\nThe undying Mydeimos, the lion apart from the rest. Chrysos Heir who seeks the Coreflame of Strife, must suffer a thousand deaths, be bathed in blood on the path home, and bear the madness of fate alone.\n— Kingslayer be king, godslayer be god. Iron-hooves pound across the wilderness for the campaign, and must eventually soak in the blood of their homeland.

skills.name: Vow of Voyage
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Deaths are Legion, Regrets are None
skills.description: Consumes HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Mydei's current HP. Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets.\nIf the current HP is not sufficient, using Skill reduces Mydei's current HP to 1.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes HP and deals Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy unit and minor Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Throne of Bones
skills.description: Restores HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP and accumulates <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Talent's Charge point(s). Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to one designated enemy, and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets. Additionally, Taunts the target and targets adjacent to it, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). The next use of "Godslayer Be God" prioritizes attacking one designated enemy, and this effect only works on the latest target.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Restores HP</color> and accumulates Talent's Charge. Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets, then <color=#f29e38ff>Taunts</color> the target and their adjacent targets.

skills.name: Blood for Blood
skills.description: For each 1% of HP lost, accumulates 1 point of Charge (up to <unbreak>200</unbreak> points). When Charge reaches <unbreak>100</unbreak>, consumes <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of Charge to enter the "Vendetta" state, restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP, and advances action by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. While the "Vendetta" state is active, Max HP increases by <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of the current Max HP and DEF remains at 0. At the start of this unit's turn, automatically uses "Kingslayer Be King."\nWhen Charge reaches <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Godslayer Be God."\nWhen receiving a killing blow during the "Vendetta" state, Mydei will not be <u>knocked down</u>, but will clear his Charge, exits the "Vendetta" state, and restores HP by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP.
skills.simpleDescription: When losing HP, accumulates Charge. When Charge is at <unbreak>100</unbreak>, enters the <color=#f29e38ff>"Vendetta"</color> state, restores HP and advances action. During "Vendetta," Max HP increases and DEF remains at 0. At the start of this unit's turn, <color=#f29e38ff>automatically uses</color> "Kingslayer Be King."\nWhen Charge reaches <unbreak>150</unbreak> during "Vendetta," Mydei immediately gains 1 <color=#f29e38ff><u>extra turn</u></color> and <color=#f29e38ff>automatically uses</color> "Godslayer Be God."\nWhen Mydei receives a killing blow, he exits the "Vendetta" state.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Cage of Broken Lance
skills.description: After using Technique, pulls in enemies within a certain area and inflicts Daze on them for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.\nIf actively attacking Dazed enemies, when entering battle, deals Imaginary DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Mydei's Max HP to all enemies, and Taunts the targets, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This unit accumulates <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Talent's Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Pulls in enemies within a certain area and inflicts Daze on them. After attacking Dazed enemies and entering battle, deals minor Imaginary DMG to all enemies and Taunts the targets. This unit accumulates Talent's Charge.

skills.name: Kingslayer Be King
skills.description: Consumes HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Mydei's current HP. Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to one enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets.\nIf the current HP is not sufficient, using Skill reduces Mydei's current HP to 1.\nThis ability will be automatically used.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes HP. Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets.\nThis ability will be <color=#f29e38ff>automatically used</color>.

skills.name: Godslayer Be God
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge. Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to one enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mydei's Max HP to adjacent targets.\nThis ability will be automatically used. While this ability is in use, Charge cannot be accumulated.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Consumes Charge</color>. Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy and massive Imaginary DMG to adjacent targets.\nThis ability will be <color=#f29e38ff>automatically used</color>.

eidolons.name: Frost Hones Spine of Steel
eidolons.description: Increases the DMG multiplier dealt by "Godslayer Be God" to the primary target by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. This ability now deals to all enemies Imaginary DMG equal to the DMG multiplier dealt to the primary target.

eidolons.name: Strife Beholds Cry of Dead
eidolons.description: During "Vendetta," the DMG dealt by Mydei ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of enemy targets' DEF. After he receives healing, converts <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the healed amount to Charge. The tally of the converted Charge cannot exceed <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s). Resets this tally of Charge after any unit takes action.

eidolons.name: Honor Exalts Feast of Faith
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Siren Jolts the Laconic Lion
eidolons.description: While in "Vendetta," increases CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> and restores HP by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP after receiving attacks from enemy targets.

eidolons.name: War Chisels Flesh of Flame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Legacy Scales Mound of Blood
eidolons.description: When entering battle, immediately enters the "Vendetta" state, and lowers the Charge required for "Godslayer Be God" to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s).

name: Anaxa
description: The Grove of Epiphany, where knowledge flourishes and philosophers are born.\nYet here stands Anaxagoras the blasphemer, the Chrysos Heir who challenges the Coreflame of Reason. He is questioned: Would you defy the prophecy even if you must bear infamy, and insist on driving the thorns of doubt into the Sacred Tree of wisdom?\n——"Ridiculous. In a world full of lies, I am the only truth."

skills.name: Pain, Brews Truth
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Anaxa's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Fractal, Exiles Fallacy
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Anaxa's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG. Each instance of DMG deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Anaxa's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing Bouncing to enemy targets that have not been hit by this instance of Skill.\nWhen used, for each attackable enemy on the field, this Skill has its DMG dealt increased by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy and Bounces 5 times in total, prioritizing Bouncing to targets that have not been hit. The more enemy targets on the battlefield, the higher the DMG.

skills.name: Sprouting Life Sculpts Earth
skills.description: Inflicts the "Sublimation" state on all enemies, then deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Anaxa's ATK to all enemies.\nIn the "Sublimation" state, the targets will be simultaneously inflicted with Physical, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, Quantum, and Imaginary Weaknesses, lasting until the start of the targets' turn. If the targets do not have Control RES, they are unable to take action in the "Sublimation" state.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts "Sublimation" on all enemies and deals Wind DMG. In the "Sublimation" state, targets will be simultaneously inflicted with <color=#f29e38ff>7 types of Weaknesses</color>, and can't take action if they do not have Control RES.

skills.name: Tetrad Wisdom Reigns Thrice
skills.description: Each time Anaxa lands 1 hit on enemy targets, inflicts 1 Weakness of a random Type to the targets, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), with priority to the Weakness Type that the target doesn't already possess.\nWhile Anaxa is on the field, inflicts the "Qualitative Disclosure" state on enemy targets that have at least <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> different Types of Weaknesses. Anaxa deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG to targets afflicted with the "Qualitative Disclosure" state. In addition, after using Basic ATK or Skill on them, unleashes 1 additional instance of Skill on the targets. This additional Skill does not consume any Skill Points and cannot trigger this effect again. If the target has been defeated before the additional Skill is used, it will be cast on one random enemy instead.
skills.simpleDescription: After hitting enemy targets, inflicts 1 <color=#f29e38ff>random Weakness</color>. Enemies whose <color=#f29e38ff>Weaknesses reach <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> get inflicted with "Qualitative Disclosure." Anaxa deals increased DMG to targets in the "Qualitative Disclosure" state. After Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill on them, unleashes 1 additional instance of <color=#f29e38ff>Skill without consumption</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Prism of the Pupil
skills.description: After using Technique, inflicts the Terrified state on enemies in a set area. Terrified enemies will flee in a direction away from Anaxa for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). When allies enter combat via actively attacking a Terrified enemy, it will always be considered as entering battle via attacking a Weakness. After entering battle, Anaxa applies 1 Weakness of the attacker's Type to every enemy target, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts the Terrified state on the surrounding enemies. Attacking a Terrified enemy will always be considered as entering battle via Weakness, and applies 1 <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness of the attacker's Type</color> to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Magician, Isolated by Stars
eidolons.description: After using Skill for the first time, recovers <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s). When using Skill to hit enemy targets, decreases the targets' DEF by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Soul, True to History
eidolons.description: When enemy targets enter the battlefield, triggers 1 instance of the Talent's Weakness Implant effect, and reduces their All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Pupil, Etched into Cosmos
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Blaze, Plunged to Canyon
eidolons.description: When using Skill, increases ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Embryo, Set Beyond Vortex
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Everything Is in Everything
eidolons.description: The DMG dealt by Anaxa is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG. The 2 effects in the Trace "Imperative Hiatus" will be triggered directly and will no longer depend on the number of "Erudition" characters in the team.

requirements.description: A golden goblet of fine wine held by the troupe's cupbearer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.

name: Cipher
description: In the fallen city of bandits, Dolos, the 300 Rogues run wild and free.\nRace onward, fleet-footed Thief Star Cifera, Chrysos Heir of the "Trickery" Coreflame. May your web of lies spread with the breeze throughout all lands—\n"Tryna trick me? Not a chance!"

skills.name: Oops, a Missed Catch
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Hey, Jackpot for the Taking
skills.description: Has a <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Weaken one designated enemy and its adjacent targets (decreasing their DMG dealt by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>) and increases Cipher's ATK by <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Moreover, deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK to the adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Has a high chance to decrease one enemy and adjacent targets' DMG dealt and increases Cipher's ATK. Deals Quantum DMG to one designated enemy and minor Quantum DMG to adjacent targets.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Yours Truly, <unbreak>Kitty Phantom Thief!</unbreak>
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy. Then, deals <u>True DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the current tally kept by Talent to the one designated enemy. Moreover, deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK alongside <u>True DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the current tally kept by Talent to the one designated enemy and its adjacent targets. And this <u>True DMG</u> is distributed evenly among all targets of this ability.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG and <u>True DMG</u> equal to a percentage of the current tally kept by Talent to one enemy. Moreover, deals minor Quantum DMG and <u>True DMG</u> equal to a percentage of the current tally kept by Talent to the one enemy and its adjacent targets. And this <u>True DMG</u> is distributed evenly among all targets of this ability.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

skills.name: The Hospitable Dolosian
skills.description: When there are no enemy targets in the "Patron" state on the battlefield, Cipher immediately causes one enemy target with the highest Max HP on the battlefield to become the "Patron." When using Skill and Ultimate, the primary target becomes the "Patron." The "Patron" state only takes effect on the most recent target.\nAfter the "Patron" gets attacked by other ally targets, Cipher immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the "Patron," dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cipher's ATK. This effect can trigger up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn, and this trigger count resets at the start of Cipher's turn.\nCipher will tally <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the non-<u>True DMG</u> dealt by ally targets to the "Patron." Overflow DMG will not be tallied. After using Ultimate, clears this tally.
skills.simpleDescription: Cipher causes one enemy target to enter the "Patron" state. After the target in this state gets attacked by teammates, Cipher launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Quantum DMG to the target. This can trigger <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s) per turn.\nCipher will keep a tally of the DMG dealt by allies to the target in the "Patron" state. After using Ultimate, clears this tally.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Puss in Boots
skills.description: Gains "Zagreus's Blessing" that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). During this time, Cipher will be undetectable by enemies and her movement speed increases by <unbreak>50%</unbreak>. When approaching an enemy in the overworld/Simulated Universe/Divergent Universe, can immediately gain a random Consumable. Consumables can be gained this way for up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s) in each Earth day.\nWhen entering battle with "Zagreus's Blessing" active, deals Quantum DMG equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Cipher's ATK to all enemies. And the tallied amount Cipher gains from this instance of DMG increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Zagreus's Blessing." While it is active, Cipher cannot be detected by enemies, and gains random Consumables when approaching them. When entering battle, Cipher deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Read the Room, Seek the Glee
eidolons.description: Cipher's tally of DMG is <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of its original value. When using the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, increases Cipher's ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: In the Fray, Nab On a Spree
eidolons.description: When Cipher hits an enemy target, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase the DMG it receives by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: From Thin Air, Hard to Foresee
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Jig Is Up, Quick to Flee
eidolons.description: After the "Patron" gets attacked by an ally target, Cipher deals Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> to it equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Cipher's ATK.

eidolons.name: Safe in Numbers, Light as a Bee
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Thief's Game, Unsung and Free
eidolons.description: The DMG dealt by <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> from Cipher's Talent increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. During the tally, an additional <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of non-Overflow DMG dealt by this attack is tallied. After the tally is cleared by using Ultimate, <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the cleared tally is returned.

name: Castorice
description: Aidonia, the snowy land that respects and worships death, has already sunken into sweet slumber.\nO Castorice, daughter of the River of Souls, the Chrysos Heir in search of the Coreflame of "Death," set forth! Guard the lament of the souls in this world, and embrace the solitude of destiny.\n— Life and death is a journey. When a butterfly rests on that dead branch, the withered will be reborn again.

skills.name: Lament, Nethersea's Ripple
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Silence, Wraithfly's Caress
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of all allies' current HP. Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one designated enemy and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to adjacent targets.\nIf the current HP is insufficient, reduces the current HP down to 1.\nIf Netherwing is on the battlefield, the Skill becomes "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace" instead.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes all allies' HP. Deals Quantum DMG to one enemy and minor Quantum DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Doomshriek, Dawn's Chime
skills.description: <u>Summons the memosprite</u> Netherwing and <u>advances its action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. At the same time, deploys the <u>Territory</u> "Lost Netherland," which decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>. If Castorice has the DMG Boost effect from her Talent, then this effect spreads to Netherwing. Netherwing has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> and a set Max HP equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of max "Newbud."\nAfter Netherwing experiences <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turns or when its HP is 0, it disappears and dispels the <u>Territory</u> "Lost Netherland."
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Netherwing and <u>advances its action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. At the same time, deploys a <u>Territory</u> that <color=#f29e38ff>decreases All-Type RES</color> for all enemies.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

10000020.name: Territory
10000020.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

skills.name: Desolation Across Palms
skills.description: The maximum limit of "Newbud" is related to the levels of all characters on the battlefield. For every 1 point of HP lost by all allies, Castorice gains 1 point of "Newbud." When "Newbud" reaches its maximum limit, can activate the Ultimate. When allies lose HP, Castorice's and Netherwing's DMG dealt increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s), lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhen Netherwing is on the field, "Newbud" cannot be gained through Talent, and every 1 point of HP lost by all allies (except Netherwing) will be converted to an equal amount of HP for Netherwing.
skills.simpleDescription: When allies lose HP, Castorice gains <color=#f29e38ff>"Newbud"</color>. Increases Castorice's and Netherwing's <color=#f29e38ff>DMG dealt</color>. When <color=#f29e38ff>"Newbud"</color> reaches its maximum limit, can activate the Ultimate. While Netherwing is on the field, HP lost by allies (except Netherwing) will be converted to an equal amount of HP for Netherwing.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Wail, Death's Herald
skills.description: After using Technique, enters the "Netherveil" state that lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> seconds. While "Netherveil" is active, enemies are unable to actively approach Castorice.\nDuring "Netherveil," active attacks will cause all enemies within range to enter combat. At the same time, <u>summons the memosprite</u> Netherwing, <u>advances its action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, and deploys the <u>Territory</u> "Lost Netherland." Netherwing has its current HP equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of max "Newbud." After entering battle, consumes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing).\nIf Netherwing is not summoned after entering battle, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of max "Newbud."
skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Netherveil" state. Enemies are unable to actively approach Castorice.\nDuring "Netherveil," attacks will cause all enemies within range to enter combat. At the same time, <color=#f29e38ff><u>summons the memosprite</u></color> Netherwing, <u>advances its action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. Upon entering battle, consumes HP of all allies (except Netherwing).\nIf Netherwing is not summoned after entering battle, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of max "Newbud."

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

10000020.name: Territory
10000020.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

skills.name: Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing). Castorice and Netherwing launch <u>Joint ATK</u> on the targets, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.\nIf the current HP is insufficient, reduces the current HP down to 1.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes all allies' HP. Castorice and Netherwing launch <u>Joint ATK</u> on the targets, dealing Quantum DMG to all enemies.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

eidolons.name: Snowbound Maiden, Memory to Tomb
eidolons.description: When the enemy target's current HP is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Max HP or lower, the DMG dealt to it by "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace," "Claw Splits the Veil," "Breath Scorches the Shadow," and "Wings Sweep the Ruins" is <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG respectively.

eidolons.name: Crown on Wings of Bloom
eidolons.description: After summoning the memosprite Netherwing, Castorice gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Ardent Will." "Ardent Will" can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) and can be used to offset the HP cost of Netherwing's Memosprite Skill, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" and <u>advance Castorice's action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. When using the next Enhanced Skill, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of max "Newbud."

eidolons.name: Pious Pilgrim, Dance in Doom
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Rest in Songs of Gloom
eidolons.description: While Castorice is on the field, all allies' HP restored when receiving healing increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Pristine Pages, Prophecy as Plume
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Await for Years to Loom
eidolons.description: When Castorice or Netherwing deals DMG, increases Quantum <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. During Netherwing's attacks, can reduce enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Quantum Weakness Break effect. And the number of Bounces for Netherwing's Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins" additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

1140701.name: Claw Splits the Veil
1140701.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
1140701.simple_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies.

1140702.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140702.desc: Launching "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will consume <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Netherwing's Max HP to deal Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.\nIn one attack, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" can be launched repeatedly, with the DMG multiplier increased progressively to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> / <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>. After reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, it will not increase further. The DMG Multiplier Boost effect will not decrease before Netherwing disappears.\nWhen Netherwing's current HP is equal to or less than <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of its Max HP, launching this ability will actively reduce HP down to 1, and then trigger the ability effect equal to that of the Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140702.simple_desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."

1140703.name: Mooncocoon Shrouds the Form
1140703.desc: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as <u>backup</u> for allies. When allies take DMG or consume HP, their current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will bear the HP loss. But Netherwing consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original value. This lasts until Netherwing disappears.
1140703.simple_desc: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as <u>backup</u> for allies. Allies' current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will bear the DMG received or the HP consumed.

10000021.name: Backup
10000021.desc: Enemies cannot actively target backup units. Allies' Blast-type abilities cannot Blast to backup units.

1140705.name: Roar Rumbles the Realm
1140705.desc: When Netherwing is summoned, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
1140705.simple_desc: When summoned, increases the DMG dealt by all allies.

1140706.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
1140706.desc: When Netherwing disappears, deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies.
1140706.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy that Bounces a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). At the same time, restores HP for all allies.

1140710.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140710.simple_desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."

1140711.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140711.simple_desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."

1140712.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
1140712.desc: Consumes all HP and deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies.
1140712.simple_desc: Consumes all HP and deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy that Bounces a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). At the same time, restores HP for all allies.

140704.name: Sanctuary of Mooncocoon
140704.desc: After obtaining Castorice or when Castorice is in the current team, receive the following effect: In battle, when an ally character receives a killing blow, all ally characters that received a killing blow in this action enter the "Mooncocoon" state. Characters in "Mooncocoon" temporarily delay becoming <u>downed</u> and can take actions normally. After the action and before the start of the next turn, if their current HP increases or they gain a Shield, "Mooncocoon" is removed. Otherwise, they will be <u>downed</u> immediately. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

name: Phainon
description: Aedes Elysiae, a remote frontier village isolated from the world, now lives on only in cryptic legends.\nThe Nameless hero, ████████, the Chrysos Heir holding the Coreflame of "Worldbearing," memorizes the ideals of the entire world, carries the fate of millions, and brings the first light of dawn to the new world\n—"But if dawn should never come, let this fury consume this body, and rise as tomorrow's blazing sun!"

skills.name: Stride to Deliverance
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Let There Be Light
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Coreflame," dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Phainon's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of <color=#f29e38ff>"Coreflame"</color>, dealing massive Physical DMG to one enemy and Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: He Who Bears the World Must Burn
skills.description: Transforms into Khaslana. During the transformation, deploys the <u>Territory</u> "Ruinous Irontomb." Within the <u>Territory</u>, other teammates <u>depart</u> and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weaknesses.\nKhaslana does not enter his own turn, but has <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> <u>Khaslana's extra turn(s)</u>, with a SPD set at <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Khaslana's base SPD. When the last of <u>Khaslana's extra turns</u> starts, immediately launches a final hit and deals Physical Ultimate DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Khaslana's ATK that is distributed evenly across all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Transforms into Khaslana</color> and deploys a <u>Territory</u>: Teammates <u>depart</u> and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weaknesses.\nKhaslana does not enter his own turn, but has <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> <u>Khaslana's <color=#f29e38ff>extra turn(s)</color></u>. In the final turn, launches a final hit and deals massive Physical DMG that is distributed evenly across all enemies.

10000016.name: Departed
10000016.desc: Targets in the Departed state cannot be designated as ability targets and will not appear in the Action Order.

10000020.name: Territory
10000020.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

10014082.name: Khaslana's Extra Turn
10014082.desc: When Phainon transforms into Khaslana, a countdown will appear on the Action Order. When the countdown begins, Khaslana will gain 1 extra turn. When the last turn of the countdown begins, transforms into Khaslana and delivers a final hit before ending the transformation.\nThe countdown initial action value will be set between 0–<unbreak>100%</unbreak>. The action value will not be reset at the start of each wave.\nWhen Khaslana is under the effect of action advance, the first countdown's action is advanced instead.

skills.name: Pyric Corpus
skills.description: Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s), can activate Ultimate. Even after reaching the limit, can still hold up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> overflow point(s). When the transformation ends, gains "Coreflame" based on the number of overflow points.\nWhen Phainon is targeted by an ability from any other target, gains 1 "Coreflame" point. And if the ability is cast by one of Phainon's teammates, can also increase Phainon's CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>, can activate Ultimate.\nWhen Phainon is <color=#f29e38ff>targeted by abilities from other targets</color>, gains <color=#f29e38ff>"Coreflame"</color>. When targeted by a teammate's ability, increases CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Fate: Divine Vessel
skills.description: Khaslana's Talent. Upon transformation, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of <u>"Scourge"</u>. If this happens during an ally target's turn, then the duration of all <u>buffs</u> on that target is extended by 1 turn and the current turn ends.\nKhaslana is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, has 1 Enhanced Basic ATK and 2 Enhanced Skills, but cannot use Ultimate. During the transformation, increases ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> and Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color>. After using an attack, restores HP equal to <unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak> of his Max HP. When Khaslana takes a killing blow, he will not get <u>knocked down</u>. Instead, he will restore HP equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Max HP and immediately launch a final hit. For every 1 remaining <u>Khaslana's extra turn</u>, the final hit's DMG multiplier decreases by <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak> of its original multiplier value.\nWhen the transformation ends, increases all allies' SPD by <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> for 1 turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Khaslana's Talent. Upon transformation, gains <u>"Scourge"</u>.\nKhaslana is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and has <color=#f29e38ff>3 new abilities</color>. During the transformation, increases ATK and Max HP. Using attacks restores HP. When taking a killing blow, restores HP and immediately uses a final hit. The more remaining actions he has, the lower the DMG multiplier.\nWhen the transformation ends, increases all allies' SPD.

10000007.name: Downed State

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: Can buff combat ability for a period of time, which can be dispelled unless otherwise specified.

10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10014081.name: Scourge
10014081.desc: Khaslana's exclusive charge with an upper limit of 7. Will be retained even before transforming.

When the last turn of the countdown begins, transforms into Khaslana and delivers a final hit before ending the transformation.\nThe countdown initial action value will be set between 0–<unbreak>100%</unbreak>.
