name: Hyacine
description: As the city-state in the clouds crumbles through time, the Twilight Courtyard opens its gates once more, bringing a glimmer of light to Evernight.\nPhysician Hyacinthia is the Chrysos Heir who watches over the Coreflame of Sky. Carrying the will of her ancestors, she mends the torn fabric of dusk and dawn.\nMay the rainbow light pour down, dissolve all grudges, and bring the dawn back to this land.

skills.name: When Breeze Kisses Cirrus
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Love Over the Rainbow
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Little Ica. Restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies (except Little Ica), and restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> for Little Ica.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons memosprite</u></color> Little Ica, and restores HP for all allies.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: We Who Fly <unbreak>Into Twilight</unbreak>
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Little Ica. Restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies (except Little Ica), and restores HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak></color> for Little Ica. Hyacine enters the "After Rain" state, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Hyacine's every turn. While "After Rain" is active, all ally targets increase their Max HP by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons memosprite</u></color> Little Ica, and restores HP for all allies. Enters the "After Rain" state. While Hyacine is in this state, <color=#f29e38ff>increases all allies' Max HP</color>.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: First Light Heals the World
skills.description: The memosprite Little Ica initially has Max HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Hyacine's Max HP. When Hyacine or Little Ica provides healing, increases Little Ica's DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Stacks up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When Hyacine or Little Ica provides healing, increases Little Ica's DMG dealt.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Day So Right, Life So Fine!
skills.description: When the next battle starts, restores HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for all allies and increases Max HP by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When the next battle starts, restores HP for all allies and <color=#f29e38ff>increases Max HP</color>.

eidolons.name: Cradle the Candle of Night
eidolons.description: While Hyacine is in the "After Rain" state, all ally targets additionally increase their Max HP by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, and after using an attack, immediately restore their HP by an amount equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Hyacine's Max HP.

eidolons.name: Come Sit in My Courtyard
eidolons.description: When an ally target's HP decreases, SPD increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Depart, Unto the Sun!
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sunlit Amber, Yours to Keep
eidolons.description: The "Tempestuous Halt" Trace gets enhanced: For every <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> excess SPD, additionally increases Hyacine's and Little Ica's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Twilight Drapes the Tide
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: O Sky, Heed My Plea
eidolons.description: When Little Ica uses Memosprite Skill, the amount cleared from the tally of healing is changed to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. While Little Ica is on the field, all ally targets' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

1140901.name: Rainclouds, Time to Go!
1140901.desc: Deals Wind DMG to all enemies by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the tally of healing done by Hyacine and Little Ica in the current battle, and clears <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of this tally of healing.
1140901.simple_desc: Deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

1140903.name: Take Sky in Hand
1140903.desc: Little Ica maintains 0 SPD, is immune to <u>debuffs</u>, and will not appear in the Action Order.\nIf the HP of an ally target (except Little Ica) is reduced, then at the start of any target's turn or after any target takes action, Little Ica will consume <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their own Max HP and heal the ally target with reduced HP for an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>.\nWhile Hyacine is in the "After Rain" state, Little Ica gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically casts "Rainclouds, Time to Go!" immediately after Hyacine uses an ability. Moreover, when Little Ica triggers the Talent's healing effect, additionally restores HP for all ally targets by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hyacine's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>. After Little Ica uses an ability, the duration of all their <u>Continuous Effects</u> decreases by 1 turn.
1140903.simple_desc: If an ally target (except Little Ica) has <color=#f29e38ff>reduced HP</color>, Little Ica will consume their own HP and <color=#f29e38ff>restore HP</color> for the target. When Hyacine has "After Rain," Little Ica gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses Memosprite Skill immediately after Hyacine uses an ability. After Little Ica uses an ability, the duration of their <u>Continuous Effects</u> decreases by 1 turn.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

10000022.name: Continuous Effect
10000022.desc: Includes buffs, debuffs, and other effects.

1140905.name: Soar, Unto the Sunlight
1140905.desc: When summoned, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for Hyacine. On the first summon, additionally regenerates <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy.
1140905.simple_desc: When summoned, regenerates Energy for Hyacine.

1140906.name: Fall, Then Take Wing
1140906.desc: Upon disappearing, <u>advances the action</u> of Hyacine by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
1140906.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, <u>advances the action</u> of Hyacine.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

name: Hysilens
description: Styxia, the coastal city of intoxication and dreams, where echoes of old songs still drift among the waves.\nHelektra, Daughter of the Sea, Chrysos Heir who cleanses the Ocean's Coreflame, dispels the murky undercurrents and orchestrates a banquet of revelry for the heroes beyond the sky.\nThe show must go on. Even if hope is as fragile as bubbles, the waves will keep surging forward.

skills.name: Aeolian Mode: Echoes in Still Waters
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hysilens's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Overtone Hum: Chorus After Dark Tides
skills.description: Has a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to increase the DMG taken by all enemies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the same time, deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: There is a high chance to increase the DMG taken by all enemies, and deals Physical DMG to them.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Maelstrom Rhapsody
skills.description: Hysilens deploys a Zone that reduces enemy targets' ATK by <unbreak>#6[f1]%</unbreak> and DEF by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, and deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Hysilens's ATK to all enemies.\nFor every 1 instance of DoT taken by an enemy target within the Zone, Hysilens deals Physical DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK to them. This damage triggers at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s). And it cannot repeatedly trigger this effect.\nThe Zone lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s) and this duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. When Hysilens gets <u>knocked down</u>, the Zone will also be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: Deploys a Zone that <color=#f29e38ff>reduces all enemies' ATK and DEF</color>, and deals Physical DMG to them. While the Zone exists, for every 1 instance of DoT received by enemy targets, <color=#f29e38ff>deals 1 instance of Physical DoT</color> to them.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: Sirenic Serenade
skills.description: When an ally target attacks, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for Hysilens to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: Wind Shear, Bleed, Burn, or Shock. Priority is given to inflicting a different state.\nWhile in the Wind Shear/Burn/Shock state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Wind/Fire/Lightning DoT equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hysilens's ATK for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nWhile in the Bleed state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Physical DoT equal to <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak> of their Max HP, up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Hysilens's ATK, lasting for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When an ally target attacks, Hysilens has a high chance to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: <color=#f29e38ff>Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock</color>.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: At Ocean's Abode
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds and automatically moves forward. Enemies within the Special Dimension enter the "Soulstruck" state. "Soulstruck" enemies will not attack ally targets and will follow the dimension while it persists.\nAfter entering combat with "Soulstruck" enemies, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to inflict each enemy target with <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> of the following states: Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock, all of which are equivalent to those provided by Hysilens's Talent effect. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies within the dimension will not attack ally targets. After entering combat with enemies within the dimension, there's a high chance to inflict <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> state(s) from <color=#f29e38ff>Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock</color> on each enemy target.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

eidolons.name: You Ask Why Hearts Cry
eidolons.description: While Hysilens is on the field, the DoT dealt by ally targets is equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their original value. When Hysilens inflicts Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock on enemies via her Talent, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to additionally inflict the target with 1 instance of Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock state that is equivalent to those from the original Talent effect and can coexist with such pre-existing states.

eidolons.name: Tell Me Why Waves Roar High
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, the DMG Boost effect from Trace "The Fiddle of Pearls" applies to all allies.

eidolons.name: Why Do Lights Bid Goodbye
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Lo, How Time Flows By
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, reduces All-Type RES of all enemies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: In Ablution, I Hum and Sigh
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: When to Return From Where You Lie
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, at the start of each turn or after one attack by an ally target, increases the maximum trigger count for Hysilens's Physical DoT effect to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, and increases the multiplier of the DMG dealt by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Cerydra
description: The Northern Empire, a lost dynasty, where its frozen lands burn with the fever of conquest.\nSovereign Cerydra, the Chrysos Heir who wields the Coreflame of "Law," weaves her schemes, contends with the gods, passes judgment upon the faithless, and lays the foundation of Flame-Chase into this world.\n..."This is far from the end. Amphoreus's journey is set to blaze across the stars!"

skills.name: King's Castling
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cerydra's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Wind DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Pawn's Promotion
skills.description: Grants "Military Merit" to one designated ally character and gives Cerydra <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> points of Charge. Charge is capped at <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points. When Charge reaches <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> points, automatically upgrades the character's "Military Merit" to "Peerage" and dispels their <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. The character with "Peerage" is considered to have "Military Merit" simultaneously. The character with "Peerage" increases the CRIT DMG for their dealt Skill DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, increases their All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>, and triggers <u>Coup de Main</u> when using their Skill on enemy targets. After <u>Coup de Main</u> ends, consumes <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> points of Charge to revert "Peerage" to "Military Merit."
skills.simpleDescription: Grants "Military Merit" to an ally character and gives Charge to Cerydra. When Charge reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> points, automatically upgrades the ally character's "Military Merit" to "Peerage." The character with "Peerage" <color=#f29e38ff>increases the CRIT DMG for their dealt Skill DMG, increases All-Type <u>RES PEN</u></color>, and can trigger <color=#f29e38ff><u>Coup de Main</u></color>.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000023.name: Coup de Main
10000023.desc: Copy and immediately use the ability about to be used, then use the original ability.\nCoup de Main won't trigger Coup de Main again.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Scholar's Mate
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Charge. Deals Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cerydra's ATK to all enemies. If no character on the field has "Military Merit," prioritizes granting "Military Merit" to the first character in the current team.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains Charge. Deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Ave Imperator
skills.description: The character with "Military Merit" increases ATK by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Cerydra's ATK. When the character uses Basic ATK or Skill, Cerydra gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Charge. During <u>Coup de Main</u>, Cerydra cannot gain Charge. After the character with "Military Merit" uses an attack, Cerydra additionally deals 1 instance of Wind <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of her ATK. This effect can trigger up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s). The trigger count resets every time Cerydra uses her Ultimate. "Military Merit" only takes effect on the most recent target. When the target changes, Cerydra's Charge is reset to 0.
skills.simpleDescription: The character with "Military Merit" <color=#f29e38ff>increases their ATK</color>. When they use Basic ATK or Skill, Cerydra gains Charge. After the character with "Military Merit" uses an attack, Cerydra additionally deals minor Wind <u>Additional DMG</u>.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

10000023.name: Coup de Main
10000023.desc: Copy and immediately use the ability about to be used, then use the original ability.\nCoup de Main won't trigger Coup de Main again.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: First-Move Advantage
skills.description: After using Technique, gains "Military Merit." When switching the active character, "Military Merit" transfers to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill 1 time on the character with "Military Merit" without consuming any Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Grants "Military Merit" to the current active character. Automatically uses Skill on the character with "Military Merit" at the start of the next battle.

eidolons.name: Seize the Crowns of All
eidolons.description: The character with "Military Merit" ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the targets' DEF when dealing DMG. If "Military Merit" has been upgraded to "Peerage," then the character additionally ignores <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the targets' DEF when dealing Skill DMG. When Cerydra uses her Skill, regenerates <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy for the designated ally target.

eidolons.name: Forge the Dreams of Many
eidolons.description: The character with "Military Merit" deals <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> increased DMG. While a teammate on the field has "Military Merit," Cerydra's DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Torch the Laws of Old
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Remake the Realms of Men
eidolons.description: Increases Ultimate's DMG multiplier by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Help and Hurt Repaid in Full
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Journey Set Starward
eidolons.description: The character with "Military Merit" increases their All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, and the multiplier for the <u>Additional DMG</u> triggered via "Military Merit" increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. While a teammate on the field has "Military Merit," Cerydra's All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

name: Evernight
description: In the Memory Zone secluded from the world, candlelight reflects the past, silently extinguishing in the mist.\nEvernight, child of Remembrance emerging from those shadows, the Chrysos Heir who conceals the Coreflame of "Time," raises the waves of "Oblivion" to protect the wishes of those in the mirror\n"Don't worry, I will guard the path of Trailblaze for you... at any cost. ♭"

skills.name: Time Thence Blurs
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evernight's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Day Gently Slips
skills.description: Consumes <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> of Evernight's current HP to <u>summon memosprite</u> Evey and increases CRIT DMG of all ally memosprites by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evernight's CRIT DMG for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Evernight's every turn. If Evey is already on the field, restores its HP by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of its Max HP. When using this, gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Memoria." If in the "Darkest Riddle" state, gains <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> additional point(s) of "Memoria."
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes this unit's HP to <u>summon memosprite</u> Evey and <color=#f29e38ff>increase CRIT DMG for all ally memosprites</color>. If Evey is already on the field, restores its HP. When using this, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Memoria."</color> If in the "Darkest Riddle" state, additionally <color=#f29e38ff>gains <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> "Memoria."</color>

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: O Wakeful World, Goodnight
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Evey. Then Evey deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP and Evernight enters the "Darkest Riddle" state. During this state, all enemies take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG while both Evernight and Evey deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG and are immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Charge for "Darkest Riddle." And Evey consumes 1 point after it uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew." At the start of Evernight's turn, if no Charge remains, exits the "Darkest Riddle" state.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies. <u>Summons memosprite</u> Evey and causes Evernight to enter the "Darkest Riddle" state, during which enemies take increased DMG and both Evernight and her memosprite deal increased DMG and are immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

skills.name: With Me, This Night
skills.description: When entering combat, <u>summons memosprite</u> Evey. Evey has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> and its Max HP equals to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of that of Evernight's. Each time Evernight or Evey loses HP, increases CRIT DMG for Evernight and Evey by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Memoria." This effect can trigger only once per target for each received attack.\nWhen Evernight has <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> or more points of "Memoria," dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and becomes immune to them. If Evey is on the field, it immediately takes action. The immediate action effect can only trigger again after Evey uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew."
skills.simpleDescription: When entering combat, <u>summons memosprite</u> Evey. Each time this unit or Evey <color=#f29e38ff>loses HP</color>, <color=#f29e38ff>increases CRIT DMG for this unit and Evey</color>, and <color=#f29e38ff>gains "Memoria."</color>\nWhen Evernight has <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> or more "Memoria," Evey immediately takes action.

skills.simpleDescription: At the start of the next battle, obtains the same effect as the one from Skill that increases memosprite CRIT DMG, and additionally gains "Memoria."

skills.name: Day Gently Slips
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes this unit's HP to <u>summon memosprite</u> Evey and <color=#f29e38ff>increase CRIT DMG for all ally memosprites</color>. If Evey is already on the field, restores its HP. When using this, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Memoria."</color> If in the "Darkest Riddle" state, additionally <color=#f29e38ff>gains <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> "Memoria."</color>

eidolons.name: Sleep Tight, the Night Dreams Long
eidolons.description: When Evernight is on the field, if there are (≥4)/3/2/1 enemy targets on the field, ally memosprites deal DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of their original DMG respectively.

eidolons.name: Listen Up, the Slumber Speaks Soft
eidolons.description: Increases Evernight's and the memosprite Evey's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. Each time Evernight gains "Memoria," increases the amount of "Memoria" gain by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s). When using Ultimate, additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Charge for "Darkest Riddle."

eidolons.name: Fear Not, the Nightmare Lies Past
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Wake Up, the Tomorrow is Yours
eidolons.description: While Evernight is on the field, ally memosprites' Weakness Break Efficiency increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, and the memosprite Evey's Weakness Break Efficiency additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Let Go, the "Me" in Memories
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Like This, Always
eidolons.description: While Evernight is on the field, all ally targets' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. After the memosprite Evey uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," Evernight gains <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the amount of "Memoria" consumed in this attack.

1141301.name: Remembrance, Whirling, Like Rain
1141301.desc: This ability automatically selects a target, prioritizing the enemy target that Evernight last attacked. Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to one enemy. For every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Memoria" Evernight currently has, additionally deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP. Gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Memoria" after use.
1141301.simple_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy and further deals minor Ice DMG based on the amount of "Memoria."

1141303.name: Solitude, Drifting, In Murk
1141303.desc: Evey is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and has an increased chance of getting attacked. While Evey is on the field, Evernight and Evey deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG.
1141303.simple_desc: The memosprite Evey is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, and its chance of getting attacked increases. While it's on the field, increases its own and Evernight's DMG dealt.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141305.name: Night, Trailing, In Step
1141305.desc: When summoned, this unit immediately takes action.
1141305.simple_desc: When summoned, this unit immediately takes action.

1141306.name: You, Parting, Beyond Reach
1141306.desc: Upon disappearing, increases Evernight's SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. If the disappearance is due to using "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," then, for every 1 "Memoria" point consumed by the attack, additionally increases Evernight's SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. Up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Memoria" points can be taken into account for this. The SPD Boost effect cannot stack and is removed at the start of Evernight's next turn.

1141307.name: Dream, Dissolving, as Dew
1141307.desc: This ability is used when Evernight's "Memoria" is greater than or equal to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> and she is not affected by Crowd Control. For every 1 "Memoria" point currently held, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to the primary target, and Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to the other enemy targets. After use, consumes all "Memoria" and HP, and makes Evey disappear.
1141307.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Based on the amount of "Memoria"</color>, deals massive Ice DMG to the primary target and Ice DMG to the other enemy targets. After use, <color=#f29e38ff>consumes all "Memoria" and HP, and makes Evey disappear</color>.

name: Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
description: The chest of Georios, the body of the fallen dragon supporting the shattered earth, enduring millennia of pain.\nDan Heng, the Nameless and the Chrysos Heir who guards the Earth's Coreflame, steadies the world before it falls and guides all life across the land to a new home beyond.\nRivers flow to the sea, mountains echo in harmony, and the eternal path stretches ten thousand miles.

skills.name: Aegis Vitae
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Terra Omnibus
skills.description: Designates one ally character as the "Bondmate" and provides all allies with a Shield that can offset DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the current Shield provided by Skill.\n"Bondmate" only applies to the most recent target of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.
skills.simpleDescription: Designates one ally character as the "Bondmate" and grants all allies a Shield with <color=#f29e38ff>stackable Shield Effect</color>.

skills.name: A Dragon's Zenith Knows No Rue
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to all enemies, and provides a Shield to all allies that can offset DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed <unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak> of the current Shield provided by Skill.\n"Souldragon" becomes enhanced. When "Souldragon" takes action, launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK and <u>Additional DMG</u> of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[f1]%</unbreak></color> of the Bondmate's ATK. The enhancement lasts for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Souldragon" action(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Physical DMG to all enemies and provides a Shield with <color=#f29e38ff>stackable Shield Effect</color> to all allies. Enhances "Souldragon." When "Souldragon" takes action, launches <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>, dealing minor Physical DMG and minor DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies. The enhancement lasts for <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Souldragon" action(s).

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

skills.name: Of Virtue, Forms Unfold
skills.description: When an ally character becomes the "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae summons "Souldragon" for them, which has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>.\nWhen "Souldragon" takes action, dispels <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>debuff(s)</u> from all allies and provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). The Shield Effect provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae and "Souldragon" can be stacked, but it will not exceed <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the Shield provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.\nWhen Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae or the "Bondmate" is <u>knocked down</u>, "Souldragon" disappears.
skills.simpleDescription: When an ally character becomes the "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae will <color=#f29e38ff>summon "Souldragon" for them</color>.\nWhen "Souldragon" takes action, dispels 1 <u>debuff</u> from all allies and provides a Shield <color=#f29e38ff>with stackable Shield Effect</color>.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Earthrend
skills.description: After using Technique, gains "Bondmate" and inflict Daze on enemies within a certain area for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.\nWhen switching the active character, "Bondmate" transfers to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill 1 time on the character with "Bondmate" without consuming any Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Daze on enemies within a certain area and grants "Bondmate" to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill on the character with "Bondmate."

eidolons.name: Shed Scales of Old
eidolons.description: When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) and increases the "Bondmate's" All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Watch Trails to Blaze
eidolons.description: Additionally increases the number of actions for the enhanced Souldragon from Ultimate by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. After Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, Souldragon <u>advances action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. When the enhanced "Souldragon" takes action, the <u>Additional DMG</u> dealt by the "Bondmate" becomes <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of its original DMG, and the Shield Effect provided in this instance becomes <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of its original Shield Effect.

eidolons.name: Bear Weight of Worlds
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: By Oath, This Vessel Is I
eidolons.description: Reduces the DMG taken by the "Bondmate" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Path of Permanence Sweeps Far
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: One Dream to Enfold All Wilds
eidolons.description: When the "Bondmate" is on the field, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When the "Bondmate" deals DMG, ignores <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the enemy targets' DEF. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, the "Bondmate" will deal <u>Additional DMG</u> of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies, equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the Bondmate's ATK.

name: Cyrene
description: A meteor streaks across the night sky, stirring ripples in the river of life, shimmering with thirteen hues.\nDaughter of Aedes Elysiae, nurturer of the Chrysos Heir of "███," plants the Seed of Memory, letting yesterday's flowers bloom in tomorrow\n—"Now, let's write a different kind of poem together♪"

skills.name: Lo, Hope Takes Flight!
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" point(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Recollection" and deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Bloom, Elysium of Beyond
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" point(s) and deploys a Zone that lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of Cyrene's every turn. While the Zone lasts, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of <u>True DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG. When Cyrene is <u>downed</u>, the Zone will also be dispelled.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Recollection" and deploys a Zone. Additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color> after all ally targets deal DMG.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

skills.name: Verse ◦ Vow ∞
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>, and activates all teammates' Ultimate. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state. Enhances Basic ATK to "To Love and Tomorrow ♪" and can only use this Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.\nCan only be used once per battle. Demiurge's initial Max HP equals to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Cyrene's Max HP.
skills.simpleDescription: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>, and <color=#f29e38ff>activates all teammates' Ultimate</color>. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state and gains Enhanced Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Hearts Gather as One
skills.description: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, other ally characters under any state and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, consumes "Future" to grant Cyrene <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" point(s). When Cyrene has <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" points, can activate Ultimate and dispel all <u>debuffs</u> on her. When she has <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" points during the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state, can activate Ultimate. After reaching the maximum, it can overflow by up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points. While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
skills.simpleDescription: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, teammates and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, Cyrene gains "Recollection." While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by ally targets.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: Debuffs are negative status effects that render units weaker. Unless otherwise specified, debuffs can be dispelled.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Peace at West Wind's End
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s) around the character. Enemies within this Special Dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state. While in this state, enemies will cease all actions. Ally characters within this Special Dimension have <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> increased movement speed. After entering combat within the duration, deploys the Skill's Zone. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension around the character. Enemies within this dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state while ally characters within this dimension have increased movement speed. After entering combat, deploys the Skill's Zone.

skills.name: To Love and Tomorrow ♪
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" points and deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Cyrene's Max HP to all enemies.\n"To Love and Tomorrow ♪" cannot recover Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Recollection" and deals Ice DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: <unbreak>Reunion at</unbreak> <unbreak>First Sight</unbreak>
skills.description: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

eidolons.name: Epics, Born on a Blank Slate
eidolons.description: When Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" point(s) and increases the number of bounces for this attack by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Tomorrow in Thirteen Shades
eidolons.description: When entering combat, additionally gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Recollection" point(s). For every 1 different ally character that gains the Memosprite Skill <u>buff</u> from Demiurge, the DMG multiplier for the <u>True DMG</u> dealt by ally targets via the Skill's Zone increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, up to a max increase of <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: By Thy Being, As I've Written
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Please Write On, With a Smile
eidolons.description: After every 1 use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes" by Demiurge, the Bounce DMG multiplier for the triggered Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> in the current battle, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> times.

eidolons.name: Gaze, Steeped in Yesterbloom
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Remembrance, Sung in Ripples ♪
eidolons.description: When Cyrene uses Ultimate for the first time, all allies <u>advance action</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Each time Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains the following effects based on the number of times it has been triggered in the current battle:\n1 time: When Demiurge is on the field, reduces all enemy targets' DEF by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.\n2 times and more: All allies <u>advance action</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.

1141501.name: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes
1141501.desc: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP.
1141501.simple_desc: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies.

1141502.name: This Ode, to All Lives
1141502.desc: Applies a <u>buff</u> to one designated ally character. When the character is a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, the target gains a <color=#f9b0f0><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarCyrene id=0 width=1 height=1>special</unbreak> effect</u></color>. When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.
1141502.simple_desc: Applies a <u>buff</u> to one ally character. When the character is a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, the target gains a <color=#f9b0f0><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarCyrene id=0 width=1 height=1>special</unbreak> effect</u></color>. When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt. This effect also applies on memosprites.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: Can buff combat ability for a period of time, which can be dispelled unless otherwise specified.

10000025.name: Chrysos Heir
10000025.desc: Cyrene, Tribbie, Cerydra, Evernight, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Hysilens, Hyacine, Phainon, Anaxa, Aglaea, Mydei, Castorice, Cipher, Trailblazer (Remembrance).

1141503.name: Waiting, In Every Past
1141503.desc: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as <u>Out-of-Bounds</u>. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all <u>Continuous Effects</u> on this unit by 1.
1141503.simple_desc: When changes occur on Cyrene's HP, Demiurge's HP will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's Max HP increases.

10000022.name: Continuous Effect
10000022.desc: Includes buffs, debuffs, and other effects.

10000024.name: Out-of-Bounds
10000024.desc: Neither allies nor enemies can actively select Out-of-Bounds units.

1141505.name: "Hello, World ♪"
1141505.desc: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.
1141505.simple_desc: When summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141513.name: Ode to Genesis
1141513.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.
1141513.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK and CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

1141514.name: Ode to Romance
1141514.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, and ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.
1141514.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, immediately stacks Aglaea's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. name: Yao Guang
description: Mysterious, bold, radical... her quest for change is stunning.\nWith the "eye" of The Hunt, she sees all fates. Though she knows fate is immutable, the Seer Strategist still walks into danger alone.\nWith the odds stacked against her, how can she possibly change her destiny?

skills.name: Whistlebolt Sings Joy
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yao Guang's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Yao Guang's ATK to targets adjacent to it. The Energy regenerated from Basic ATK increases to <unbreak>30</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy target and minor Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Decalight Unveils All
skills.description: Deploys a Zone for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While the Zone is active, increases all allies' Elation by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Yao Guang's Elation. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deploys a Zone that <color=#f29e38ff>increases Elation</color> for all ally targets. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, <color=#f29e38ff>gains <u>Punchline</u></color>.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: Hexagram of Feathered Fortune
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u>. <u>Aha</u> immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> where a fixed amount of <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> is taken into account. This turn does not consume <u>Punchline</u>, and increases all allies' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>Gains <u>Punchline</u></color>. Immediately grants <color=#f29e38ff><u>Aha</u></color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff><u>extra turn</u></color> where a fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> is taken into account, and increases all allies' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u>.

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000026.name: Aha
10000026.desc: When taking action, triggers an Aha Instant and causes units capable of using Elation Skills to each use their Elation Skill 1 time. If there are no units capable of using Elation Skills when Aha takes action, Aha will use "Let There Be Laughter."\nThe Aha Instant lasts until the final Elation Skill finishes this time.\nWhen the Aha Instant ends, participating characters gain the "Certified Banger" state for the Punchline points taken into account this time, lasting for 2 turns. After Aha takes action, all Punchlines will be consumed.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Behold Wherever Light Unfolds
skills.description:
While Yao Guang holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>":
After an ally target uses an attack, triggers the "Great Boon" effect, dealing 1 additional instance of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> <u>Elation DMG</u> of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, then additionally triggers "Great Boon" 1 time.
When triggering the "Great Boon" effect, if the attacker's Elation is lower than that of Yao Guang, then this instance of <u>Elation DMG</u> will take Yao Guang's Elation into calculation.
Triggering the "Great Boon" effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.
skills.simpleDescription: While Yao Guang is in possession of "<u>Certified Banger</u>," after an ally target uses an attack, triggers "Great Boon": <color=#f29e38ff>Additionally deals</color> 1 instance of minor <color=#f29e38ff><u>Elation DMG</u></color> of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, this effect triggers 1 extra time. This effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Whistlebolt Sings Joy
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Untethered Glimmer Sails Far
skills.description: After using Technique, automatically triggers Skill 1 time at the start of the next battle without consuming any Skill Points. When Yao Guang is in the team, breaking destructible objects immediately grants Fortune Pouch, up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> within every Earth Week.
skills.simpleDescription: Upon entering combat, automatically triggers Skill 1 time. When Yao Guang is in the team, immediately gains Fortune Pouch when breaking destructible objects.

skills.name: Let Thy Fortune Burst in Flames
skills.description: Inflicts "Woe's Whisper" on all enemies, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Enemy targets under the "Woe's Whisper" state take <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak> increased DMG. Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies. Then, deals <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases DMG received by all enemies. Deals Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies. Then, deals minor Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

eidolons.name: Chuckle Chimes Where Jade Falls
eidolons.description: In <u>Aha's</u> <u>extra turn</u> triggered by Ultimate, the fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> taken into account increases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>. When dealing <u>Elation DMG</u>, all ally targets ignore <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Blind Arrows Guided by Feathers
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, increases all ally targets' SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, and additionally increases Elation by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Auspices Mirrored In Decalight
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Threads of Fate Colored by Plumes
eidolons.description: In <u>Aha's</u> <u>extra turn</u> triggered by Yao Guang's Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all ally characters' Elation Skill becomes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG.

eidolons.name: Bejeweled in Radiant Grace
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Ferried Along the Astral Arc
eidolons.description: All ally targets' <u>Elation DMG</u> <u>merrymakes</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Increases the DMG multiplier of Yao Guang's Elation Skill by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of its original multiplier.

name: Ashveil
description: He takes cases on a whim, cracks them with hard-core logic, and solves the strangest crimes on sheer instinct.\nWith a monkey for an assistant and his heart set on retirement, the detective sleeps in a refrigerator, waiting for the bait to catch its willing prey.\nUnder the light of the Phantasmoon, the vile beast howls. How will he draw the net on this hunt?

skills.name: Talons: Inculcate Decorum
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Flog: Smite Evil
skills.description: Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing it Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK. If the target is already the "Bait," additionally deals it Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK, and recovers <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s). When the "Bait" exists on the field, all enemies' DEF gets reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color>.\nWhen there is no "Bait" on the field, Ashveil immediately makes the enemy target with the lowest HP on the field become the "Bait." The "Bait" state only takes effect on the most recently applied target.
skills.simpleDescription: Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing massive Lightning DMG to them. If the target is already the "Bait," additionally deals minor Lightning DMG to them, and recovers <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s). When the "Bait" exists on the field, all enemies' <color=#f29e38ff>DEF gets reduced</color>.

skills.name: Banquet: Insatiable Appetite
skills.description: Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing it Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK. Then, immediately launches 1 instance of enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the "Bait." And Ashveil gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Charge.\nThis enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not consume Charge. Whenever "Gluttony" reaches <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) or more, consumes <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Gluttony" to additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK. And when this instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> deals a killing blow to the target, it will continue to deal DMG to a new "Bait." This triggers until "Gluttony" becomes lower than <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s). If all enemy targets currently on the field have been dealt killing blows, the enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> will immediately end.
skills.simpleDescription: Makes one designated enemy become the "Bait," dealing massive Lightning DMG to them. Then, <color=#f29e38ff>immediately launches against the "Bait"</color> 1 instance of enhanced Talent's <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color>. And Ashveil gains Charge.\nThis enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not consume Charge. Whenever "Gluttony" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) or more, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "Gluttony" to additionally deal massive Lightning DMG. And when this instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> deals a killing blow to the target, it will <color=#f29e38ff>continue to deal DMG to a new "Bait"</color>. This triggers until "Gluttony" becomes lower than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s).

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Rancor: Enmity Reprisal
skills.description: Ashveil has an initial Charge of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> and can hold up to a max of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>. After the "Bait" gets attacked by other ally targets, Ashveil regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak> Energy, then consumes <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Charge to launch <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the "Bait," dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Ashveil's ATK. Afterwards, gains <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Gluttony," which can stack up to <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff>After the "Bait" gets attacked by other ally targets</color>, Ashveil regenerates a fixed amount of Energy, then consumes Charge to <color=#f29e38ff>launch <u>Follow-Up ATK</u></color> against the "Bait," dealing massive Lightning DMG. Afterwards, gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of "Gluttony."

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Talons: Inculcate Decorum
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Devour: O Loathsome Hand
skills.description: After using Technique, inflicts Daze on enemies within a set area for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.\nWhen entering combat via actively attacking a Dazed enemy, deals Lightning DMG to all enemies equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Ashveil's ATK, and grants Ashveil <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts Daze on enemies within a set area. After entering combat via attacking a Dazed enemy, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies, and grants Ashveil <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Charge.

eidolons.name: Beware: Venture Not at Full Moon
eidolons.description: While Ashveil is on the field, increases DMG taken by all enemies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When an enemy target's current HP percentage is <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> or lower, the DMG they take increases to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Knock: Where Snickers Echo
eidolons.description: The max stack limit of "Gluttony" increases to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. After each time Ashveil launches the enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, refunds <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the removed "Gluttony" stacks.

eidolons.name: Hush: Unsaid Between Friends
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Heed: Swallow Truth Whole
eidolons.description: When Ashveil uses Ultimate, increases ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Caution: Sleuth Turns Slayer
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Finale: And Then There Were None
eidolons.description: When the "Bait" exists on the field, reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. For every 1 stack of "Gluttony" Ashveil has gained, the DMG dealt increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s).

name: Evanescia
description: One season the Phantasmoon waxes full, one season the mortal world shifts anew: The mysterious girl reappears in Planarcadia!\nFallen petals scatter with ease, and her stay was but a fleeting instant. Everything about this new era enthralls her, and she will not allow anyone to bring it to ruin...\nA single ruler blade judges right from wrong, but who can say how much good or evil lies within oneself?

skills.name: Syllabus: Pop Quiz
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Discipline: Final Verdict
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to adjacent targets. Additionally gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Physical DMG to one enemy and Physical DMG to adjacent targets. Additionally gains <u>Punchline</u>.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: Swordsong: Absolution Denied
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to all enemy targets, then deals 5 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to all enemies. Then, deals Physical DMG to one random enemy, bouncing a total of 5 times.

skills.name: Youth: Halcyon Evermore
skills.description:
Evanescia gains Elation equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of CRIT DMG. When Evanescia gains Energy, she will simultaneously gain an equal amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>." When Evanescia gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>," she will simultaneously gain an equal amount of Energy. The amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" taken into calculation via this method cannot exceed <unbreak>100</unbreak> points in a single instance.
After accumulating <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy, she consumes this accumulation of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>, and "Master Fox" launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evanescia's ATK to all enemies, and regenerates <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy for Evanescia. Each instance of Energy regeneration grants up to an accumulation of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>. While Evanescia holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>":
Using Skill can deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[f1]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to the attacked enemy targets.
Using Ultimate can deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies and also deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#8[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to the enemy targets that have been randomly dealt DMG by Ultimate. When Ultimate deals <u>Elation DMG</u>, the amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" taken into account is at least equal to Max Energy.
Master Fox's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: When Evanescia gains Energy, she will simultaneously <color=#f29e38ff>gain an equal amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>"</color>. When Evanescia gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>," she will simultaneously <color=#f29e38ff>gain an equal amount of Energy</color>. After a certain amount of Energy is accumulated, "Master Fox" launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing minor Physical DMG to all enemies, and regenerates Energy for Evanescia. While Evanescia holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," using Skill, Ultimate, or Master Fox's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> can deal minor Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to enemies.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Petalfall: Floral Reminiscence
skills.description: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, deals Physical DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Evanescia's ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>."
skills.simpleDescription: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, deals minor Physical DMG to all enemies and gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>".

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Scarlet: Elation or Execution
skills.description: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies and additionally gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>".
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies and additionally gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>."

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

eidolons.name: Home: A Prayer in Dance
eidolons.description: Increases All-Type RES PEN by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After "Master Fox" uses an attack, additionally triggers 1 instance of Elation Skill. Elation Skill additionally grants this unit <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "<u>Certified Banger</u>" point(s).

eidolons.name: Voyage: A Wish for Everbloom
eidolons.description: CRIT DMG increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When triggering the Certified Banger gain effect from the Trace "Watch All Revels"/"Best All Blooms", additionally gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>" equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of the "<u>Certified Banger</u>" gained this time.

eidolons.name: Blade: A Feast on Evils
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Meadow: A Ruin by Vice
eidolons.description: Evanescia's DMG dealt ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the enemy targets' DEF.

eidolons.name: Arcadia: A Glimpse of Fates
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Maiden: A Step into Dreams
eidolons.description: The duration of Evanescia's "<u>Certified Banger</u>" increases by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). The <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt by Evanescia <u>merrymakes</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. For every <unbreak>100</unbreak> points of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" held, it additionally <u>merrymakes</u> by <unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak>. Up to <unbreak>1000</unbreak> points of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" can be taken into account. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy for Evanescia. This effect can trigger 1 time for every <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> more instances of Ultimate used.
