name: Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>
description: A new season of Elation begins, featuring the limited-time return of the invincible player "Silver Wolf LV.999"!\nShe's conquered the universe, unlocked every cosmic achievement... What's left to play?\n"Reach the peak of 'Elation'? Boring... Since I've got the cartridge now, I make the rules~"

skills.name: One Punch!
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Trigger Happy
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains <u>Punchline</u>. Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: God Mode: ON!
skills.description:
Enters the "Godmode Player" state, and <u>advances action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>.
Deploys a Zone while in the "Godmode Player" state. While Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," for every 1 Skill Point consumed by an ally target within the Zone, there is a chance to trigger 1 instance of Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s "<u>Top Loot Box</u>": Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u> that is distributed evenly among all enemies, and randomly triggers 1 of the following effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Additionally deals <u>True DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of the total DMG dealt this time to the enemy target with the highest HP.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Recovers <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s).
The initial <u>fixed chance</u> to trigger the effect is <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. After a successfully trigger, the <u>fixed chance</u> for the next trigger is reduced to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of the current chance. If the target is defeated before it triggers, it will instead trigger on a newly entering enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription:
Transforms and <u>advances action</u> by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>.
Deploys a Zone during Transformation. While holding "<u>Certified Banger</u>," for every <color=#f29e38ff>1 Skill Point consumed</color> by allies, there is a high chance to <color=#f29e38ff>trigger 1 "Top Loot Box"</color>: Deals massive Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u> that is distributed evenly among all enemies, and randomly triggers 1 of the following effects:
Deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color> to the target with the highest HP based on total DMG dealt.
Recovers <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Points</color>.
Gains <color=#f29e38ff><u>Punchline</u></color>.
The trigger chance decreases proportionally after each trigger.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

10015061.name: Top Loot Box
10015061.desc:
Special Attack that ally targets can trigger while in Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s Zone when Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> has "Certified Banger." Can also be actively triggered in "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant." Triggering via this method is not considered as launching 1 attack.
When used, deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG split evenly among all enemies and randomly triggers one of the following 3 effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on the total DMG dealt this time.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Restores Skill Points (Trigger rate increases when Skill Points are low. Trigger rate decreases when Skill Points are high).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains Punchline (Trigger rate increases when "Hidden MMR" is low. Trigger rate decreases when "Hidden MMR" is high).

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

skills.name: I Carry, We Win
skills.description:
After "Hidden MMR" reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>, can activate Ultimate. And after reaching its maximum limit, it can overflow by an additional <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s).
When gaining <u>Punchline</u>, Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> gains an equal amount of "Hidden MMR." Each point of "Hidden MMR" increases CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f2]%</unbreak></color>. Once CRIT Rate reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, each additional point of "Hidden MMR" instead increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[f2]%</unbreak></color>.
While in the "Godmode Player" state, Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> becomes immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, cannot use Ultimate, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Elation Skill. After fully using Enhanced Basic ATK <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s), she exits the "Godmode Player" state. When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, clears "Hidden MMR".
While holding "<u>Certified Banger</u>," using Basic ATK or Skill deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u> to the attacked enemy targets. And the Enhanced Basic ATK's ability DMG changes to <u>Elation DMG</u> at the same multiplier.
skills.simpleDescription: After "Hidden MMR" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>, the Ultimate can be activated. <color=#f29e38ff>When gaining <u>Punchline</u>, gains an equal amount of "Hidden MMR"</color>. The higher the "Hidden MMR", the higher the CRIT Rate. Once CRIT Rate reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, increases CRIT DMG instead.\nDuring Transformation, Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> becomes immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, and her Basic ATK and Elation Skill get enhanced. She exits the Transformation after using Enhanced Basic ATK <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).\nWhile holding "<u>Certified Banger</u>," using Basic ATK or Skill additionally deals Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u>. And the Enhanced Basic ATK's ability DMG changes to <u>Elation DMG</u>.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: This? Absolute Meta!
skills.description: Summons "Funky Munch Bean." Use again to dismiss. Using Technique does not consume Technique Points. When Technique Points reach 0, the summon is dismissed and Technique cannot be used.\n"Funky Munch Bean" causes Normal Enemies within a certain range to enter a Terrified state. It will also automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies, consuming 1 Technique Point to instantly defeat them without entering combat.\nWhile "Funky Munch Bean" is present, after entering combat, 1 instance of "<u>Top Loot Box</u>" from "Funky Munch Bean" is triggered at the start of each wave. A fixed amount of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "<u>Certified Banger</u>" is taken into account for the <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt in this instance.
skills.simpleDescription: Summons "Funky Munch Bean." Use again to dismiss. Using Technique <color=#f29e38ff>does not consume Technique Points</color>.\n"Funky Munch Bean" will automatically seek out and attack Normal Enemies, consuming 1 Technique Point to <color=#f29e38ff>instantly defeat them without entering combat</color>.\nAfter entering combat, triggers the Top Loot Box corresponding to "Funky Munch Bean" at the start of each wave.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

Special Attack that ally targets can trigger while in Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s Zone when Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> has "Certified Banger." Can also be actively triggered in "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant." Triggering via this method is not considered as launching 1 attack.
When used, deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG split evenly among all enemies and randomly triggers one of the following 3 effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on the total DMG dealt this time.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Restores Skill Points (Trigger rate increases when Skill Points are low. Trigger rate decreases when Skill Points are high).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains Punchline (Trigger rate increases when "Hidden MMR" is low. Trigger rate decreases when "Hidden MMR" is high).

skills.name: Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant
skills.description:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s ATK, split evenly into <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> hits that bounce onto random enemies. After every set number of bounces, the bouncing pauses and the <u>Top Loot Box</u> triggers 1 time. Can trigger up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s) in total.
When dealing fatal damage to all enemies on the field, this ability ends. After attackable enemy targets appear, gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and uses this ability again based on the remaining number of bounces and <u>Top Loot Box</u> triggers. The first time this effect triggers in each turn, extends the duration of all <u>buffs</u> on this unit by 1 turn.
After all of the above DMG is dealt, launches a Final Hit that deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s ATK, split evenly among all enemies.
Enhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points. For every <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> points of "Hidden MMR" held, increases DMG dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK by <unbreak>#8[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG, stacking up to <unbreak>#7[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Imaginary DMG, bouncing a large number of times, during which "Top Loot Box" can trigger <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). If <color=#f29e38ff>fatal damage is dealt to all enemies, the remaining effect is reserved</color> and can continue to be used on newly entering enemy targets. Finally, deals Imaginary DMG, split evenly among all enemies.\nEach time "Hidden MMR" reaches a set number, can additionally increase the DMG of Enhanced Basic ATK.

skills.simpleDescription: Gains "Hidden MMR."

skills.name: Honkai-DMG Demo
skills.description: Deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instances of DMG, with each instance dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. Then, resets the <u>fixed chance</u> to trigger "<u>Top Loot Box</u>" to its initial value.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Imaginary <u>Elation DMG</u> to one enemy, bouncing a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> times. <color=#f29e38ff>Resets the trigger chance of "Top Loot Box"</color>.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10015061.name: Top Loot Box
10015061.desc:
Special Attack that ally targets can trigger while in Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>'s Zone when Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> has "Certified Banger." Can also be actively triggered in "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant." Triggering via this method is not considered as launching 1 attack.
When used, deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG split evenly among all enemies and randomly triggers one of the following 3 effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on the total DMG dealt this time.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Restores Skill Points (Trigger rate increases when Skill Points are low. Trigger rate decreases when Skill Points are high).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains Punchline (Trigger rate increases when "Hidden MMR" is low. Trigger rate decreases when "Hidden MMR" is high).

30000002.name: Fixed Chance
30000002.desc: Fixed chance will not be affected by any factor.

eidolons.name: Aether Editing: Eidolon +1
eidolons.description: Enemy targets in the Zone take <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> increased DMG.\nWhen exiting the "Godmode Player" state, "Hidden MMR" will not be cleared. Instead, <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of "Hidden MMR" will be retained.

eidolons.name: It's a Feature, Not a Bug
eidolons.description: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, extends the duration of all <u>buffs</u> on this unit by 1 turn. In the current "Godmode Player" state, for every <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Hidden MMR" increased (including the initial "Hidden MMR"), Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak> gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and regains 1 use of Enhanced Basic ATK.

eidolons.name: Max Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>? Says who?
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: I Came. I Saw. I One-Shot.
eidolons.description: <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt by "Honkai-DMG Demo" additionally takes into account <u>Punchline</u>, equal to the original amount multiplied by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Basic ATK Is the New Ultimate
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Solo Maxxing!
eidolons.description: <u>Elation DMG</u> dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK <u>merrymakes</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.\nWhen enemy targets enter combat, they are implanted with "Absolute Weakness": Has All-Type Weakness, and reduces their All-Type <u>Base RES</u> to 0. (If <u>Base RES</u> is already at 0, then the corresponding Type RES decreases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> instead).

150604.name: McAwolfee <unbreak>999</unbreak>
150604.desc: After obtaining "Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>" or when "Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>" is present in the current team, gains the following effect: During combat, if an enemy target inflicts a <u>Crowd Control debuff</u> on an ally, all allies gain "Firewall" for 1 turn. While in the "Firewall" state, ally targets are immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> inflicted by enemy targets. This effect can trigger at most 1 time per wave.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

name: Mortenax Blade
description: Body like spring wood, heart like dead ash. Yet embers of a craftsman's spark still linger at his fingertips.\nAs ancient grudges are ignited once more, he promises to send both himself and the gods to the other side...\nTorn flesh, tempered a thousand times into a blade... What answer will it create?

skills.name: A Broken Blade Still Slays
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy and inflicts the Taunt state on the target.

skills.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate
skills.description:
Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP and deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one random enemy.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses Skill.
While not in the "Infinite Fury" state or when the current HP is 1 or lower, Mortenax Blade cannot use his Skill.
Using Skill does not consume Skill Points.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes HP and deals Fire DMG to all enemies. Then, deals minor Fire DMG to single enemies, bouncing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).

skills.name: Fornax Ex Corpore
skills.description:
Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies. Enemy targets in the "Balefire Bind" state have their DEF reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[f1]%</unbreak></color> and the DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to deploy a Zone. While the Zone is active, Mortenax Blade enters the "Infinite Fury" state.
During the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a new Ultimate "Tenax Per Ignem." When receiving a killing blow, this unit will not be <u>knocked down</u>, but will dispel the Zone, exit the "Infinite Fury" state, and restore HP equal to <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP.
When gaining the "Infinite Fury" state, a corresponding countdown appears on the Action Order. The countdown has a fixed SPD of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>. At the start of the countdown's turn, dispels the Zone and exits the "Infinite Fury" state.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses this ability.
skills.simpleDescription: Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies, causing the targets to <color=#f29e38ff>decrease their DEF and increase the DMG they receive</color>. Then, consumes this unit's HP to activate a Zone. While the Zone is active, this unit gains the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate, increases CRIT DMG, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a <color=#f29e38ff>new Ultimate</color>, lasting until the countdown ends.\nWhen Mortenax Blade receives a killing blow, the Zone is dispelled.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

skills.name: All Karma Comes Due
skills.description: While the Zone is active, after each attack an ally target uses on an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the corresponding enemy target and grants 1 Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> points and the current HP is more than 1, consumes <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Charge, regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use Skill 1 extra time. This extra Skill use is considered as <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: While the Zone is active, after an ally target attacks an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the enemy and grants Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> points and his HP is higher than 1, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Charge to regenerate Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use his <color=#f29e38ff>Skill</color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff>extra time</color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: One Cut Ends All
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Blade's Reach Spares None
skills.description: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, inflicts the Taunt state on all enemies for 1 turn and decreases DMG taken by this unit by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks all enemies within range. After entering combat, inflicts the Taunt state on all enemies and reduces DMG taken by this unit.

skills.name: A Tempered Blade Severs Souls
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and inflicts the Taunt state on the target.

skills.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate
Tenax Per Ignem
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Fire DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Ere My Death, I Stood Unmade
eidolons.description: While the Zone is active, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After using the extra Skill from Talent, the "Infinite Fury" countdown has its <u>action delayed</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Ash Was My Heart, Yet the Flame Stayed
eidolons.description: When an ally character uses Ultimate to deal DMG, it is considered as having launched <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>. And the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG dealt by ally targets increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The upper limit of Mortenax Blade's Charge decreases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Across the Shore, Wrath Laid Bare
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Odium I've Smitten, Thence Came the Blade
eidolons.description: "Heart, Refined ad Infinitum" additionally increases ally targets' DMG dealt by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: I Severed My Woes, Knowing Death Begets Life
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: If Immortality Could Die, I Swore THEM Slain
eidolons.description: As the Zone persists, when Mortenax Blade takes DMG or consumes HP, he gains 1 Charge. This effect can trigger again after any target's turn ends. The DMG multiplier of "Tenax Per Ignem" increases to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of its original value.

name: Rin Tohsaka
description: Hailing from a world beyond our universe where magic and magecraft coexist, this young mage tirelessly hones her skills. She is the Sixth Head of the Tohsaka family, a prestigious lineage of Fuyuki City mages.

skills.name: Bajiquan
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Jeweled Sword Zelretch
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to a single designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to other enemy targets. When used, recovers <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for allies, and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Quantum DMG to one designated enemy and Quantum DMG to other enemy targets. When used, increases the DMG taken by all enemies and recovers Skill Point(s) for allies.

skills.name: Gem Magecraft
skills.description: When entering combat, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Gem Energy." When an ally target consumes or recovers Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed or recovered, Rin Tohsaka gains 1 "Gem Energy." If Rin Tohsaka possesses <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> or more "Gem Energy" or if current Skill Points are <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> or more, her Skill is enhanced into "Second Magic Experiment."
skills.simpleDescription: When entering combat, <color=#f29e38ff>gains</color> <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> <color=#f29e38ff>point(s) of "Gem Energy"</color>. When an ally target <color=#f29e38ff>consumes or recovers Skill Points</color>, <color=#f29e38ff>increases their CRIT DMG</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>grants Rin Tohsaka "Gem Energy."</color> If Rin Tohsaka possesses <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> or more point(s) of "Gem Energy" or current Skill Points is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> or more, her Skill is enhanced into "Second Magic Experiment."

skills.name: Freeform Tohsaka Style
skills.description: After <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> uses his Skill "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" to attack, if there are <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> or fewer Skill Point(s) remaining or if "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" has been actively used 5 times during the current "Circuit Connection" state, and the <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> from "Freeform Tohsaka Style" has not been triggered, Rin Tohsaka and <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> will launch a <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> on all enemies, dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of <unbreak>Archer</unbreak>'s ATK respectively, and recovering <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for allies. This <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> can only trigger once. The trigger count resets when Rin Tohsaka's turn ends.
skills.simpleDescription: After <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> attacks with his Skill "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword," if there are <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> Skill Point(s) or fewer remaining, or if "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" has been actively used 5 times during the current "Circuit Connection" state and the <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> from "Freeform Tohsaka Style" has not yet been triggered, Rin Tohsaka and <unbreak>Archer</unbreak> will launch a <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> on all enemies, dealing massive Quantum DMG and recovering Skill Point(s) for allies. This <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u> can only trigger once. The trigger count resets when Rin Tohsaka ends her turn.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Conversion Charge
skills.description: After using the Technique, gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Gem Energy" at the start of the next combat.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of "Gem Energy" at the start of the next combat.

skills.name: Second Magic Experiment
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to all enemies. Then, consumes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Gem Energy" to deal additional Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one random enemy target. This repeats until "Gem Energy" is less than <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> or there are no enemy targets with current HP greater than 0, up to a maximum of <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> time(s). When used, if current Skill Points are greater than <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>, consumes Skill Points until <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> left, immediately gaining <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Gem Energy" for every 1 Skill Point consumed.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies, then <color=#f29e38ff>consumes "Gem Energy"</color> to additionally deal minor Quantum DMG to one random enemy target a certain number of times. When using this ability, if current Skill Points are greater than <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>, consumes Skill Points until <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) remain, and immediately <color=#f29e38ff>gains</color> <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> <color=#f29e38ff>point(s) of "Gem Energy"</color> for each Skill Point consumed.

eidolons.name: Zelretch's Apprentice
eidolons.description: If the amount of "Gem Energy" consumed by a single Enhanced Skill is <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> or more, Rin Tohsaka gains "Shadow Gem" equal to the amount of "Gem Energy" consumed.\nWhile possessing "Shadow Gem," Skill is enhanced to "Second Magic Experiment." The Enhanced Skill consumes all "Shadow Gem," does not trigger the effect of converting Skill Points into "Gem Energy," and does not consume "Gem Energy."

eidolons.name: Dimensional Traveler
eidolons.description: Increases Rin Tohsaka's Skill DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, Skill DMG dealt by all allies becomes <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG.

eidolons.name: Holy Grail War: Victory Memorial
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Red Devil: Triple Speed
eidolons.description: When the CRIT DMG boost effect from Talent "Gem Magecraft" takes effect on Rin Tohsaka, the effect can stack up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: Goddess of Venus's Favor
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Nailed It This Time!
eidolons.description: Rin Tohsaka's All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When using Ultimate, gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Gem Energy" and 1 <u>extra turn</u>.

name: Gilgamesh
description: The King of Heroes from the dawn of human history, hailing from a world beyond the stars.\nPossessing a nature two-thirds divine and one-third mortal, he claims a natural-born prerogative to rule over all of creation.

skills.name: Halfhearted Blow
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: King's Treasure
skills.description: Obtains "King's Acknowledgement," allowing this unit to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the target's DEF when dealing DMG, lasting for <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nDeals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains "King's Acknowledgement," enabling this unit to ignore the target's DEF when dealing DMG. Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Enuma Elish
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals <color=#f29e38ff>massive Lightning DMG</color> to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Lightning DMG to one random enemy, bouncing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).

skills.name: "Amuse Me to the Fullest"
skills.description: When an ally teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," increasing Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nInitially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest." When "Interest" reaches <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> points, Gilgamesh consumes <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Interest" and immediately takes action.\nWhen "Interest" reaches <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> points for the first time, Gilgamesh enters the "Interest Piqued!" state and can only use his Skill.
skills.simpleDescription: When an ally <color=#f29e38ff>uses their Ultimate</color>, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which <color=#f29e38ff>increases Ultimate DMG dealt</color> by this unit.\nInitially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh <color=#f29e38ff>gains 1 point of "Interest"</color>. When "Interest" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points, Gilgamesh consumes "Interest" and <color=#f29e38ff>immediately takes action</color>.\nWhen "Interest" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> points for the first time, Gilgamesh enters the "Interest Piqued!" state and can only use his Skill.

skills.name: "I Grant You Permission To Strike"
skills.description: When Gilgamesh or <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> attacks, they accumulate 1 attack tally. After any unit attacks, if the accumulated attack tally reaches <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>, Gilgamesh and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> launch a <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK and Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Saber's ATK to all enemies. Then, Gilgamesh gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Interest," and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> regenerates <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy and the DMG dealt when she next uses her Ultimate becomes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.\nThe accumulated attack tally is reset after using the <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: When Gilgamesh or <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> attacks, they accumulate attack tally. If the accumulated attack tally reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color> after any unit attacks, Gilgamesh and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> launch a <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing massive Lightning DMG and massive Wind DMG to all enemies. Gilgamesh <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of "Interest"</color>, and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> regenerates Energy and additionally increases the DMG of her next Ultimate.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Enkidu
skills.description: After using Technique, creates 1 Special Dimension lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state. Enemies in the "King's Permission" state will stop all actions.\nWhen entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering battle. Gilgamesh also immediately gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Interest." Only 1 Special Dimension created by allies can exist.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state and stop all their actions.\nAttacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat simultaneously. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and immediately <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of "Interest"</color>.

eidolons.name: He Who Saw the Deep
eidolons.description: When Gilgamesh possesses "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect will apply to other teammates as well, and "King's Acknowledgement" will additionally increase Gilgamesh's ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After Gilgamesh consumes "Interest," he additionally regenerates a fixed <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy the next time he uses his Skill.

eidolons.name: Wisdom That Encompassed All
eidolons.description: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Interest," and additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Interest" when using his Ultimate. The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" dealt to the primary target increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, and the DMG multiplier dealt to adjacent targets increases by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Journey That Spanned Far
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: King Who Bowed to None
eidolons.description: Gilgamesh's <u>Energy Regeneration Rate</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Sword That Parted God from Man
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Soul That Bore Friendship
eidolons.description: Increases the bounce DMG multiplier of the Ultimate "Enuma Elish" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases the All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> of ally characters by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, and when an ally character uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Golden Rule," up to a total of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points. If Gilgamesh has <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points of "Golden Rule" after using his Ultimate, he consumes all "Golden Rule" to activate his Ultimate.

name: Himeko • Nova
description: Some fight side by side, some keep watch. The Trailblaze is never a lonely voyage.\nShe paints a trailblazing miracle. The silver rail stretches on, and the Nameless set sail once more, illuminating the galaxy's eternal night.\nAt the end of the line, she looks back once again. The dream of setting forth has never run aground.

skills.name: Enkindle the First Lodestar
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Upraise the Vanward Cresset
skills.description: After using Skill, immediately regains all uses of <u>Assist Skill</u> and Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). At the start of each of Himeko • Nova's turn, the duration is reduced by 1. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the start of every turn, immediately regains 1 use of <u>Assist Skill</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Skill, immediately regains all uses of <u>Assist Skill</u> and Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore." When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt increases. At the start of every turn, immediately regains 1 use of <u>Assist Skill</u>.

10000032.name: Assist Skill
10000032.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

skills.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
skills.description: Immediately takes control of Starblazer. Starblazer can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume <u>"Source Energy"</u> to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#9[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#10[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.\nWhen the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.\nWhen "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.
skills.simpleDescription: During the Ultimate, can unleash "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" on all enemies. At the end, deals Fire DMG to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak></color> random single enemies.

10015101.name: Source Energy
10015101.desc: Charge exclusive to the Starblazer, maximum 3 points.

skills.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
skills.description: While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the <u>Territory</u> "Starblazer Visioscape," causing a "Starblazer" to appear on the field and granting all ally characters 1 <u>Assist Skill</u> usage. Ally characters can use the <u>Assist Skill</u> to command the "Starblazer" to attack enemies.\nUsing the <u>Assist Skill</u> is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova's All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. Attacks can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When Weakness is Broken, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.\nWhen an ally character other than Himeko • Nova uses the <u>Assist Skill</u>, they regenerate <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy.
skills.simpleDescription: When Himeko • Nova is on the field, she deploys a <u>Territory</u>, granting all ally characters <u>Assist Skill</u>. When an ally character uses <u>Assist Skill</u>, Himeko • Nova's gains All-Type <u>RES PEN</u>boost and CRIT DMG boost, and her attacks ignore Weakness Types to reduce Toughness.\nWhen ally characters aside from Himeko • Nova use <u>Assist Skill</u>, she regenerates Energy.

10000020.name: Territory
10000020.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

10000031.name: Trailblaze Companions
10000031.desc: Trailblazer, Himeko, Himeko • Nova, March 7th, Evernight, Dan Heng, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Welt, Sunday.

10000032.name: Assist Skill
10000032.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Starcharter Cruise
skills.description: When Himeko • Nova is in the team, increases max Technique Points by 3.\nAfter using the Technique, she enters the "Cruise" state, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.\nIf attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.
skills.simpleDescription: Increases <color=#f29e38ff>max Technique Points</color> by 3. After using the Technique actively, enters the "Cruise" state and consumes 2 Technique Points to attack all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.\nIf attacking a Normal Enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>immediately defeats them</color> without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

skills.name: Hyperluminal Particle Beam
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of <u>"Source Energy"</u>. A maximum of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> <u>"Source Energy"</u> can be held.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies. Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of <u>"Source Energy"</u>. A maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> <u>"Source Energy"</u> can be held.

10015101.name: Source Energy
10015101.desc: Charge exclusive to the Starblazer, maximum 3 points.

skills.name: Orbital Annihilation Pulse
skills.description: Consumes 1 point of <u>"Source Energy"</u> to deal Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies. When current <u>"Source Energy"</u> is 1 point or more, for every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of <u>"Source Energy"</u> consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes 1 point of <u>"Source Energy"</u> to deal minor Fire DMG to all enemies. When current <u>"Source Energy"</u> is 1 point or more, for every <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of <u>"Source Energy"</u> consumed, deals minor Fire DMG 1 time to one random enemy.

10015101.name: Source Energy
10015101.desc: Charge exclusive to the Starblazer, maximum 3 points.

skills.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
skills.simpleDescription: Deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG to one random enemy.

skills.name: Trailblaze, By Your Side
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> extra instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy. When used by Himeko • Nova, deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and deals <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> extra instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.\nIf used by a <u>Trailblaze Companions</u> character other than Himeko • Nova, Himeko • Nova will additionally gain 1 of the <color=#DE7A66><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarHimekoNova id=0 width=1 height=1>Special</unbreak> Effects</u></color> depending on the user.\nThe extra <u>Assist Skill</u> triggered by all <color=#DE7A66><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarHimekoNova id=1 width=1 height=1>Special</unbreak> Effects</u></color> can be triggered up to <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> time(s) per battle, and the trigger count is reset after Himeko • Nova uses her Ultimate.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Fire DMG to all enemies, and minor Fire DMG to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> random enemies. Gains 1 point of Charge for each enemy target hit by an ally. skills.simpleDescription: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state. Increases all allies' CRIT DMG, and additionally increases CRIT DMG dealt by Skills. Gains 1 point of Charge for each enemy target hit by an ally. When Charge reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#9[i]</unbreak></color> points, consumes all Charge, and Himeko • Nova immediately launches 1 <u>Assist Skill</u> against the enemy.

10000032.name: Assist Skill
10000032.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

eidolons.name: That Which We Stride Is the Trailblaze
eidolons.description: Increases the number of times the Talent triggers the extra <u>Assist Skill</u> effect by <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>. When in the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, the number of Ultimate uses required to launch the <u>Assist Skill</u> is reduced by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. When in the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state, the Charge required to launch the <u>Assist Skill</u> is reduced by <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>. When Himeko • Nova launches the <u>Assist Skill</u>, the number of times the extra DMG effect is triggered increases by <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Colors We Never Strike
eidolons.description: Max uses of Himeko • Nova's <u>Assist Skill</u> increase to 2, and DMG dealt by Ultimate and <u>Assist Skill</u> becomes <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their original DMG. At the start of each turn in the "Navigator's Semaphore" state, immediately recovers 1 extra <u>Assist Skill</u> use. Trace "Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars" effect: When characters other than <u>Trailblaze Companions</u> use <u>Assist Skill</u>, they also gain 1 <u>extra turn</u>.

eidolons.name: We Who Are Starborn Muse Starward
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Let No Skyward Hand Stay Unheld
eidolons.description: When using the <u>Assist Skill</u> from Talent "Of Fire and Far Faring," the All-Type RES PEN increase effect applies to all allies. When Himeko • Nova gains this effect, her All-Type RES PEN increases by an additional <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: To Cross the Cosmos and Beyond
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Ours Is the Oath to Sail Starward
eidolons.description: Himeko • Nova's Fire Type <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Max <u>"Source Energy"</u> increases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s), and when an ally uses or triggers an <u>Assist Skill</u>, DMG dealt by the <u>Assist Skill</u> increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, and Himeko • Nova gains 1 point of <u>"Source Energy"</u>. When launching a "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" attack during Ultimate, additionally gains 1 point of <u>"Source Energy"</u>. When launching "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," if the current <u>"Source Energy"</u> is <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) or more, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies 1 time.

skills.description: Choose between two attack modes to deliver a full strike.\n"Blowout: Farewell Hit" deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.\n"Blowout: RIP Home Run" deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy, and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Uses Single Target ATK or Blast to strike with full force.

skills.name: Perfect Pickoff
skills.description: Each time after this character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Every time this unit breaks an enemy target's Weakness, ATK increases.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Immortal Third Strike
skills.description: Immediately heals all allies for <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP after using this Technique.
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, immediately <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color> for team.

skills.name: Blowout: Farewell Hit
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals massive Physical DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Blowout: RIP Home Run
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

eidolons.name: A Falling Star
eidolons.description: When enemies are defeated due to the Trailblazer's Ultimate, the Trailblazer regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra Energy. This effect can only be triggered once per attack.

eidolons.name: An Unwilling Host
eidolons.description: Attacking enemies with Physical Weakness restores the Trailblazer's HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's ATK.

eidolons.name: A Leading Whisper
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Destructing Glance
eidolons.description: When attacking an enemy that is <u>Weakness Broken</u>, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Surviving Hope
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: A Trailblazing Will
eidolons.description: The Trailblazer's Talent is also triggered when they defeat an enemy.

skills.name: War-Flaming Lance
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's DEF to all enemies. The next Basic ATK will be automatically enhanced and does not cost Magma Will.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to all enemies and enhances this unit's next Basic ATK.

skills.name: Treasure of the Architects
skills.description: Each time the Trailblazer is hit, they gain 1 stack of "Magma Will" for a max of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s).\nWhen "Magma Will" has no fewer than 4 stacks, the Trailblazer's Basic ATK becomes enhanced, dealing DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.\nWhen the Trailblazer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, apply a Shield to all allies that absorbs DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. The Shield lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When attacked, stacks "Magma Will." When "Magma Will" is at no fewer than 4 stacks, Basic ATK gets <color=#f29e38ff>enhanced</color>. After using Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, provides a Shield for team.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Call of the Guardian
skills.description: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, provides a Shield for this unit at the start of the next battle.

skills.name: Ice-Breaking Light
skills.description: Consumes 4 stacks of "Magma Will" to enhance Basic ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG to equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes "Magma Will," then deals Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

eidolons.name: Earth-Shaking Resonance
eidolons.description: When the Trailblazer uses their Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF. When the Trailblazer uses their enhanced Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF.

eidolons.name: Time-Defying Tenacity
eidolons.description: The Shield applied to all allies from the Trailblazer's Talent will block extra DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Trail-Blazing Blueprint
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Nation-Building Oath
eidolons.description: At the start of the battle, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Magma Will.

eidolons.name: Spirit-Warming Flame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: City-Forging Bulwarks
eidolons.description: After the Trailblazer uses enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate, their DEF increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

skills.description: Increases the Trailblazer's DMG Reduction by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and gains 1 stack of Magma Will, with a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to Taunt all enemies for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: Reduces DMG taken and gains Magma Will, with a high chance to Taunt all enemies.

30000001.name: Base Chance
30000001.desc: The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit. \nThe final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: War-Flaming Lance
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's DEF to all enemies. The next Basic ATK will be automatically enhanced and does not cost Magma Will.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals Fire DMG to all enemies and enhances this unit's next Basic ATK.

skills.name: Treasure of the Architects
skills.description: Each time the Trailblazer is hit, they gain 1 stack of "Magma Will" for a max of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s).\nWhen "Magma Will" has no fewer than 4 stacks, the Trailblazer's Basic ATK becomes enhanced, dealing DMG to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.\nWhen the Trailblazer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, apply a Shield to all allies that absorbs DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. The Shield lasts for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: When attacked, stacks "Magma Will." When "Magma Will" is at no fewer than 4 stacks, Basic ATK gets <color=#f29e38ff>enhanced</color>. After using Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, provides a Shield for team.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Call of the Guardian
skills.description: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, provides a Shield for this unit at the start of the next battle.

skills.name: Ice-Breaking Light
skills.description: Consumes 4 stacks of "Magma Will" to enhance Basic ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG to equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes "Magma Will," then deals Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to enemies adjacent to it.

eidolons.name: Earth-Shaking Resonance
eidolons.description: When the Trailblazer uses their Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF. When the Trailblazer uses their enhanced Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF.

eidolons.name: Time-Defying Tenacity
eidolons.description: The Shield applied to all allies from the Trailblazer's Talent will block extra DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's DEF plus <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Trail-Blazing Blueprint
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Nation-Building Oath
eidolons.description: At the start of the battle, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Magma Will.

eidolons.name: Spirit-Warming Flame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: City-Forging Bulwarks
eidolons.description: After the Trailblazer uses enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate, their DEF increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. Stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

description: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

skills.name: Swing Dance Etiquette
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Halftime to Make It Rain
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to single enemy targets with 5 Bounces in total.

skills.name: <unbreak>All-Out</unbreak> <unbreak>Footlight Parade</unbreak>
skills.description: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies with the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the <u>Weakness Broken state</u>, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect. Allies with Backup Dancer have their <color=#f29e38ff>Break Effect increased</color> and additionally deal <color=#f29e38ff><u>Super Break DMG</u></color> 1 time when they attack enemy targets that are <u>Weakness Broken</u>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

skills.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
skills.description: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.
skills.simpleDescription: The Trailblazer regenerates Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Now! I'm the Band!
skills.description: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of the next battle, increases all allies' Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Best Seat in the House
eidolons.description: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s).

eidolons.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
eidolons.description: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dove in Tophat
eidolons.description: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
eidolons.description: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy target and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to single enemy targets with 5 Bounces in total.

skills.name: <unbreak>All-Out</unbreak> <unbreak>Footlight Parade</unbreak>
skills.description: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies with the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the <u>Weakness Broken state</u>, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u>.
skills.simpleDescription: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect. Allies with Backup Dancer have their <color=#f29e38ff>Break Effect increased</color> and additionally deal <color=#f29e38ff><u>Super Break DMG</u></color> 1 time when they attack enemy targets that are <u>Weakness Broken</u>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

10000015.name: Super Break DMG
10000015.desc: Super Break DMG increases with higher Break Effect, higher Toughness Reduction of the attack, and higher character levels.\nSuper Break DMG cannot CRIT Hit and is not affected by DMG Boost effects.\nSuper Break DMG is also considered Break DMG.

skills.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
skills.description: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.
skills.simpleDescription: The Trailblazer regenerates Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Now! I'm the Band!
skills.description: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: At the start of the next battle, increases all allies' Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Best Seat in the House
eidolons.description: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s).

eidolons.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
eidolons.description: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dove in Tophat
eidolons.description: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
eidolons.description: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Together, Mem!
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Mem. Grants Mem <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons memosprite</u></color> Mem. Grants Mem <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>, then makes Mem deal massive Ice DMG to all enemies.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Almighty Companion
skills.description: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> and a Max HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. For every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Every time <color=#f29e38ff>a certain amount of Energy is regenerated</color> by all allies, Mem gains <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Memories Back as Echoes
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.\nAfter entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, <u>delays the action</u> of all enemies by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Trailblazer's ATK.\nOnly 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in the dimension <color=#f29e38ff>cease actions</color>. When entering battle against enemies in the dimension, <u>delays the action</u> of all enemies and deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
skills.description: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a <u>Joint ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a <u>Joint ATK</u> and respectively deal Ice DMG to all enemies. Then, Mem gains Charge.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

skills.name: I Choose You!
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>.

eidolons.name: Narrator of the Present
eidolons.description: Increases the CRIT Rate of ally targets with "Mem's Support" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When an ally target has "Mem's Support," the effect of "Mem's Support" also applies to the target's memosprite/memomaster. This effect cannot stack.

eidolons.name: Gleaner of the Past
eidolons.description: When ally memosprites (aside from Mem) take action, Trailblazer regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy. This effect can trigger a max of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Trailblazer's turn.

eidolons.name: Chanter of the Future
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dancer of the Muse
eidolons.description: When an ally target with 0 Max Energy actively uses an ability, Mem can also gain <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> Charge, and the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by this target via "Mem's Support" additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Seamster of the Ode
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bearer of the Revelation
eidolons.description: Ultimate's CRIT Rate is set at <unbreak>100%</unbreak>.
