1800701.name: Baddies! Trouble!
1800701.desc: Deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to all enemies.
1800701.simple_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG that Bounces a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). Deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies at the end.

1800703.name: Friends! Together!
1800703.desc: Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's CRIT DMG plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nIf the Charge has yet to reach <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".
1800703.simple_desc: Increases all allies' CRIT DMG.\nWhen taking action, automatically attacks. If the Charge reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, then immediately takes action and can use a new ability: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Advances the action</u></color> of one ally and deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color>.

1800705.name: Go, Mem, Go!
1800705.desc: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> Charge.

1800706.name: No... Regrets
1800706.desc: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
1800706.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, <u>advances the action</u> of Trailblazer.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

1800707.name: Lemme! Help You!
1800707.desc: <u>Advances the action</u> of one designated ally by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nFor every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of <u>True DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.\nWhen using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the <u>action advance</u> effect.
1800707.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Advances the action</u></color> of one ally and grants "Mem's Support": Additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color> after dealing DMG.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

name: {NICKNAME}
description: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

skills.name: Leave It to Me!
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: I Choose You!
skills.description: <u>Summons the memosprite</u> Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's Max HP, and grants Mem <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Together, Mem!
skills.description: <u>Summons memosprite</u> Mem. Grants Mem <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons memosprite</u></color> Mem. Grants Mem <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>, then makes Mem deal massive Ice DMG to all enemies.

10000018.name: Summon Memosprite
10000018.desc: Summon the memosprite to the field. If the memosprite is already on the field, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs the memosprite is afflicted with.

skills.name: Almighty Companion
skills.description: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> and a Max HP equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color>. For every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Every time <color=#f29e38ff>a certain amount of Energy is regenerated</color> by all allies, Mem gains <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Memories Back as Echoes
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.\nAfter entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, <u>delays the action</u> of all enemies by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of Trailblazer's ATK.\nOnly 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDescription: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in the dimension <color=#f29e38ff>cease actions</color>. When entering battle against enemies in the dimension, <u>delays the action</u> of all enemies and deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

skills.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
skills.description: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a <u>Joint ATK</u>, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK and <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> Charge.
skills.simpleDescription: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a <u>Joint ATK</u> and respectively deal Ice DMG to all enemies. Then, Mem gains Charge.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

skills.name: I Choose You!
skills.simpleDescription: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Summons the memosprite</u></color> Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem <color=#f29e38ff>Charge</color>.

eidolons.name: Narrator of the Present
eidolons.description: Increases the CRIT Rate of ally targets with "Mem's Support" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When an ally target has "Mem's Support," the effect of "Mem's Support" also applies to the target's memosprite/memomaster. This effect cannot stack.

eidolons.name: Gleaner of the Past
eidolons.description: When ally memosprites (aside from Mem) take action, Trailblazer regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy. This effect can trigger a max of <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Trailblazer's turn.

eidolons.name: Chanter of the Future
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Dancer of the Muse
eidolons.description: When an ally target with 0 Max Energy actively uses an ability, Mem can also gain <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> Charge, and the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by this target via "Mem's Support" additionally increases by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Seamster of the Ode
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nMemosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Bearer of the Revelation
eidolons.description: Ultimate's CRIT Rate is set at <unbreak>100%</unbreak>.

1800701.name: Baddies! Trouble!
1800701.desc: Deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's ATK to all enemies.
1800701.simple_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG that Bounces a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). Deals minor Ice DMG to all enemies at the end.

1800703.name: Friends! Together!
1800703.desc: Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mem's CRIT DMG plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>.\nIf the Charge has yet to reach <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".
1800703.simple_desc: Increases all allies' CRIT DMG.\nWhen taking action, automatically attacks. If the Charge reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, then immediately takes action and can use a new ability: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Advances the action</u></color> of one ally and deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color>.

1800705.name: Go, Mem, Go!
1800705.desc: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> Charge.

1800706.name: No... Regrets
1800706.desc: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
1800706.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, <u>advances the action</u> of Trailblazer.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

1800707.name: Lemme! Help You!
1800707.desc: <u>Advances the action</u> of one designated ally by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nFor every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of <u>True DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.\nWhen using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the <u>action advance</u> effect.
1800707.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff><u>Advances the action</u></color> of one ally and grants "Mem's Support": Additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><u>True DMG</u></color> after dealing DMG.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as using 1 attack.

name: {NICKNAME}
description: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

skills.name: Make Some Noise
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Let the Storm Rage On
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>."
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies and gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>."

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on them.\nIf the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.\nIf the target does not have Elation Skill, their <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains <u>Punchline</u>. Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally, and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on that target. If the target has Elation Skill, the <color=#f29e38ff>target additionally gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>"</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>immediately uses their Elation Skill</color>. Otherwise, their <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: That Smile Hits Different
skills.description: After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s).\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "<u>Certified Banger</u>" value among all allies.
skills.simpleDescription: After using an attack, regenerates Energy and gains <u>Punchline</u>.\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: We Are So Back!
skills.description:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, <color=#f29e38ff>increases all allies' Elation</color> when entering the next battle.

skills.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
skills.description: Deals <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> instances of DMG, with each instance dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u>, which is split evenly among all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals multiple instances of DMG, with each instance dealing minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> that is split evenly among all enemies.

10000028.name: Elation DMG

name: {NICKNAME}
description: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

skills.name: Make Some Noise
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Let the Storm Rage On
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>."
skills.simpleDescription: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies and gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>."

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
skills.description: Gains <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s), and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on them.\nIf the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s). If the enemy target is defeated before the Elation Skill is unleashed, then the Elation Skill is instead launched on a newly entering enemy target.\nIf the target does not have Elation Skill, their <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
skills.simpleDescription: Gains <u>Punchline</u>. Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally, and dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> on that target. If the target has Elation Skill, the <color=#f29e38ff>target additionally gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>"</color> and <color=#f29e38ff>immediately uses their Elation Skill</color>. Otherwise, their <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: That Smile Hits Different
skills.description: After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy and gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> <u>Punchline</u> point(s).\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "<u>Certified Banger</u>" value among all allies.
skills.simpleDescription: After using an attack, regenerates Energy and gains <u>Punchline</u>.\nWhen the Trailblazer holds "<u>Certified Banger</u>," their Skill additionally deals minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

10000029.name: Certified Banger
10000029.desc: Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.\nPunchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.\nThe duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
skills.simpleDescription: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: We Are So Back!
skills.description:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
skills.simpleDescription: After using Technique, <color=#f29e38ff>increases all allies' Elation</color> when entering the next battle.

skills.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
skills.description: Deals <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> instances of DMG, with each instance dealing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u>, which is split evenly among all enemies.
skills.simpleDescription: Deals multiple instances of DMG, with each instance dealing minor Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy. At last, deals Lightning <u>Elation DMG</u> that is split evenly among all enemies.

10000028.name: Elation DMG
10000028.desc: The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.\nElation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

eidolons.name: Believe In the Light
eidolons.description: After using Skill, the next Ultimate increases the amount of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" gained by ally targets by <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>. This effect can stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

eidolons.name: History in the Making...
eidolons.description: Ultimate additionally increases the Elation of one designated ally by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Into the Spotlight
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: Save the World. Just Because.
eidolons.description: When using Elation Skill, increases the DMG taken by enemy targets by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

eidolons.name: Love & Courage: Always in Style
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.\nElation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

eidolons.name: The Cosmic Legend Cometh!
eidolons.description: When using Elation Skill, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turns.
